3rd Accused

Siao Kyih Ying (          )
Hunan                                /// D.S-T. Fowler
H.Q.C.B.        6-9-41               Clark Y.C. Chien

Siao Kyih Ying (蕭閏英) alias Tseng Ding(丁庭)
29, Hunan, S/female, residing Lane 61 House 17 Love Lane.
I was born near the Small West Gate, Nantao.
My father, Siao Hwei Wen(蕭惠文) was then employed in the
Public Safety Bureau in Nantao. I did all my schooling in
Shanghai and at the age of 21 graduated from the Woo Fung(務本)
Girls' Middle School in Nantao.
I then became a teacher in the Sieu Zung Primary
School in Nantao and held that position until the outbreak
of Sino-Japanese hostilities.
About November 1937, through the introduction of
my sister Tsung Siao Sa(陳肅氏)(1st accused) I became a
member of the Shanghai District of the Blue Shirt Society.
I was in charge of the communications of my
district in that I collected and filed all communications and
kept them until such times as they were called for. I
received $200.00 per month.
From that time I have continued as such and
have made changes of address every two or three months.
I am still in charge of my group. Two others
worked under me, namely:
Siao Hsu Ying (蕭秀英) my elder sister;
2nd accused, Lai Kyi Nan(陸紀南) a distant
relative; 4th accused.
I also pay wages which I receive, per unknown
messenger from an unknown source, to the following persons:
1st accused: Tsung Siao Sa(陳肅氏) $80 per month
pages.zh:
第三被告

萧閏英（Siao Kyih Ying）
湖南 /// 侦探副督察福勒（D.S-T. Fowler）
总部刑事局 1941年9月6日 书记员 Y.C. Chien

萧閏英（Siao Kyih Ying），别名丁庭（Tseng Ding），29岁，湖南人，女，住爱文义路61弄17号。
我出生于南市小西门附近。
我的父亲萧惠文（Siao Hwei Wen）当时在南市公共安全局任职。我在上海完成所有学业，21岁时从南市务本（Woo Fung）女子中学毕业。
随后，我成为南市小钟小学（Sieu Zung Primary School）的教师，一直担任该职直到中日战事爆发。
约1937年11月，通过我姐姐陈肃氏（Tsung Siao Sa）（第一被告）的介绍，我成为蓝衣社上海区的一员。
我负责我区的通讯工作，收集并归档所有通讯文件，直至被调用。我每月收到200.00美元。
从那时起我一直如此工作，并每两三个月更换一次住址。
我仍负责我的小组。另有两人在我手下工作，即：
萧秀英（Siao Hsu Ying），我的姐姐；
第二被告，陆纪南（Lai Kyi Nan），远房亲戚；第四被告。
我还将从未知来源通过未知信使收到的工资支付给以下人员：
第一被告：陈肃氏（Tsung Siao Sa），每月80美元

pages.en:
-2-

2nd accused; Siao Hau Ying(蕭 豪 英 ) $105 per month.
4th accused; Loh Yi Man ( 陸 義 文 ) $106 per month.
5th accused; Tung I.h. ( 陳 立 ) $120 per month.
6th accused; Lee Lau Ying ( 李 流 英 ) $90 per month.
7th accused; Zau Pa' Wa(趙 八 華) $150 per month.

I do not know of the activities of the various
members or groups of the Blue Shirt Society. All correspondence
which passes through us from members to other persons is in
sealed envelopes and I am only concerned in the collection or d
delivery of same.

After my arrest I was taken to No. 76 Jessfield
Road on August 29, 1941, where I was briefly questioned. On
the morning of August 20th however I was very closely questioned
and gave replies as already made in this statement. I was
accused of with holding information and beaten by Chinese with
a leather strap. I however maintained as already stated. I
was asked to work for 76 Jessfield Road, but refused to do
this.

signed.
pages.zh:
-2-

第二被告：蕭豪英（Siao Hau Ying），月薪105元。
第四被告：陸義文（Loh Yi Man），月薪106元。
第五被告：陳立（Tung I.h.），月薪120元。
第六被告：李流英（Lee Lau Ying），月薪90元。
第七被告：趙八華（Zau Pa' Wa），月薪150元。

我不了解蓝衣社各成员或团体的活动情况。所有经由我们转交、由成员寄给其他人的信件均装在密封信封中，我仅负责收取或递送这些信件。

我被捕后，于1941年8月29日被带至极司菲尔路76号，在那里接受了简短讯问。然而在8月20日上午，我受到了严密讯问，并作出了本供词中已陈述的回答。我被指控隐瞒情报，并遭到中国人用皮带殴打。但我仍坚持前述说法。他们要求我为极司菲尔路76号工作，但我拒绝了。

签名。

pages.en:
Loh Kyi Nan （陸紀南）
Hangchow // J.S.I. Fowler
C. B. H. Q. -9-41 Clerk Chien Chi Yen

My name is Loh Kyl Nan alias Lee Liang (李梁), 19
Single, native of Hangchow, residing Lane 31 House 17 Love
Lane.

I was born in Hangchow. I began schooling at the age
of 6 and continued in various schools in Hangchow until the
outbreak of Sino-Japanese hostilities when I left with my
parents for Tsao Kyl (曹紀) in Kiangsu. In June 1940, I
came to Shanghai and lived together with Zung Siso Sz, 1st
accused; whilst my parents returned to Hangchow.

Through the introduction of a relation Siao Kyi Ying,
3rd accused, I became a member of the Blue Shirt Society
in July or August 1940.

I worked under Siao Kyi Ying who was in charge of the
communications of the group. I was concerned only with keep-
ing contact with Lee Lau Ying, 6th accused; and Zau Peh Wa,
7th accused; and delivering any letters etc to them and
accepting communications from them for other persons. Regard-
ing the latter I handed these either to Miss Zung or Miss
Tsang who used to call upon my home every morning and who
was responsible for their transmission and delivery to the
persons concerned.

My wages are $100.00 per month. I do not know of the
activities of other members of the society.

On being handed over to No.76 Jessfield Road after
my arrest I was questioned as to my activities but was only
able to give replies as per this statement.

I was asked to work for 76 Jessfield Road but this
I refused to do.

Signed :
pages.zh:
陸紀南（Loh Kyi Nan）
杭州 // J.S.I. Fowler
中央局总部 -9-41 书记员 錢志彥（Chien Chi Yen）

我叫陸紀南，别名李梁（Lee Liang），19岁，未婚，杭州人，现居爱文义路31弄17号。

我出生于杭州。6岁开始上学，在杭州的各所学校一直读到中日战事爆发，随后随父母前往江苏曹紀（Tsao Kyl）。1940年6月，我来到上海，与第一被告宗小姐（Zung Siso Sz）同住，而我的父母则返回杭州。

通过亲戚第三被告蕭紀英（Siao Kyi Ying）的介绍，我于1940年7月或8月加入了蓝衣社。

我在負責该团体通讯工作的蕭紀英手下工作。我只负责与第六被告李流英和第七被告趙柏華（Zau Peh Wa）保持联系，向他们递送信件等物品，并接收他们转交给他人的通讯信息。关于后者，我将这些信件交给宗小姐或曾小姐（Miss Tsang），她们每天早晨到我家拜访，负责将这些信息传递并送达给相关人员。

我的月薪为100.00元。我不了解社团其他成员的活动情况。

被捕后被移交给极司菲尔路76号时，我就自己的活动接受了讯问，但只能作出如本供词所述的回答。

他们要求我为极司菲尔路76号工作，但我拒绝了。

签名：

pages.en:
Hung Lih (陳立) alias Hung Ching Jih (陳俊傑)
// D.S.I. Forler
Haushan
H.Q.C.B. 3-9-41 D.S.I. Lo Shu Fa

Hung Lih (陳立) alias Hung Ching Jih (陳俊傑) 50,
native Haushi -, Single, residing Lane 113 House 81 Sinza Rd.
I was born in Haushing and lived there. In June 1924 I
had gone to Hangchow to purchase a present for my sister when
I was impressed into the Chinese Army which was calling for
recruits. I have remained in the army since and at present hold
the rank of Major in the 20th Division of the 25th Army stationed
at Foochow.
(錢東亮) In January 1941, my Commanding Officer Hien Tung Liang
ordered me and five others namely:-
Lieu Nyoh Tuh (刘玉德) 1st Lieutenant
Tsiang Tsing Kong (慶國) Sergeant Major
Lieu Foc Tsung (刘副春) Sergeant Major.
Lieu Kyl Ming (刘健民) Sergeant.
Wong Tsung Kwang (王正坤) Sergeant.
to proceed to Shanghai, with myself incharge, and contact one
named Ong Tsung Ying (江正英 ), officer in charge of the
Action Squad through one Lieu Voong Tsung (刘文忠), a member
of the Blue Shirt Society, I contacted Kong Tsung Ying at the
beginning of February. At that time I was staying temporarily in
lodging houses in the French Concession,,and learning the
different roads in Shanghai.

About March 20th I was told to proceed to Bubbling
Well and Moulmein Roads Corner where I met Wong San Siau Tse
(王三嫂子). a female member of the Society who acted as a
messenger. She, after seeing me and learning where I could be
located, left.
In May I moved to the Doong Fang Hotel, Hankow Road.
pages.zh:
陳立（Hung Lih），别名陳俊傑（Hung Ching Jih）
// D.S.I. Forler
海山（Haushan）
中央局总部 3-9-41 偵探督察 羅樹法（Lo Shu Fa）

陳立，别名陳俊傑，50岁，海兴（Haushi -）人，未婚，现居新闸路113弄81号。
我出生在海兴并居住在那里。1924年6月，我去杭州为姐姐购买礼物时，被正在招募新兵的中国军队强征入伍。此后我一直留在军中，目前担任驻福州的第25军第20师少校。
(錢東亮) 1941年1月，我的指挥官顯東亮（Hien Tung Liang）命令我和另外五人，即：
刘玉德（Lieu Nyoh Tuh）少尉
慶國（Tsiang Tsing Kong）上士
刘副春（Lieu Foc Tsung）上士
刘健民（Lieu Kyl Ming）中士
王正坤（Wong Tsung Kwang）中士
前往上海，由我负责，并通过蓝衣社成员刘文忠（Lieu Voong Tsung）联系行动队负责人江正英（Ong Tsung Ying）。我在二月初联系了江正英。当时我暂住在法租界的旅馆里，熟悉上海的各种道路。

大约3月20日，我被告知前往静安寺路与莫尔尼路（Moulmein Road）拐角处，在那里我见到了王三嫂子（Wong San Siau Tse），她是社团的一名女性成员，担任信使。她见了我，得知了我的落脚地点后便离开了。
5月，我搬到了汉口路的东方饭店。

pages.en:
-2-

and whilst there was visited by Kong Tsung Ying and Siao
Kyih Ying(3rd accused).

I have not seen Kong Tsung Ying since that time.
My pay $120.00, and that of the five men under me, was paid
by Siao Kyih Ying who also paid locomotion and lodging expenses.

On the 14th or 15th August Tsiang Tsing Kong and Lieu
Foo Tsung were instructed by Kong Tsung Ying to proceed to
Nanking where they still are as far as I know.

Since my arrival in Shanghai, neither I or the men
under me have been engaged actively in terroristic acts.

As far as I know, Lieu Nyoh Tuh; Lieu Kyi Ming and
Wong Tsang Kwung have not been arrested. I do not know their
present whereabouts or that of Kong Tsung Ying.

Signed:-
pages.zh:
-2-

在那里期间，江正英和第三被告蕭紀英（Siao Kyih Ying）曾来拜访我。

自那以后我再未见过江正英。我和手下五人的薪水均由蕭紀英支付，他还支付了交通和住宿费用。

8月14日或15日，江正英指示蔣慶國（Tsiang Tsing Kong）和刘福宗（Lieu Foo Tsung）前往南京，据我所知，他们至今仍在那里。

自抵达上海以来，我和我手下的人员均未积极参与恐怖活动。

据我所知，刘玉德、刘健民和王正坤未被逮捕。我不知道他们目前的下落，也不知道江正英的下落。

签名：

pages.en:
6th

Lee Lau Ying (李魯人) alias Tien Sien Yeu (全希愚)
// D.S.I. Fowler
C.B.H. .  -9-41  D.S.I. Lee Shu Fa

Lee Lau Ying alias Tien Sien Yeu 33, Kiangsu,
married, residing Lane 519 No. 1 Ferry Road.

I was born in Shanghai and after attending school
here until the age of 16, I worked until 21 in a shipping
Company in Nantao and then became unemployed for about three
years when, in 1931, I obtained a position as clerk with the
Finance Bureau of the Shanghai City Government which I held un-
til the outbreak of Sino-Japanese hostilities.

I became unemployed and remained so for more than a
year but with $600 which I had left, I set up a shoe business
in 1939 whereby I was able to make a living. I continued thus
until 1940 when I set up a shoe making business at my present
address where I employ two assistants.

In November 1940, I met one Zung at B18 (陳伯平)
a former official of the Shanghai City Government Finance
Bureau, on Nanking Road.

During ensuing conversations I spoke of difficult
times and asked Zung if he was able to get me a better position
in view of his former standing. He eventually told me that
there was work of a National Order which I could do at the
same time as doing my own business. I agreed to assist him in
anyway I could. I was told that all I would have to do would
be to transmit messages.

About the end of November Zung had me accompany him
to a teashop on Yu Ya Ching Road where he introduced me to one
named Ho (馬) from whom I would receive further instructions.

After an elapse of several days I was introduced to
pages.zh:
第六

李魯人（Lee Lau Ying），别名全希愚（Tien Sien Yeu）
// D.S.I. Fowler
中央局总部 . -9-41 偵探督察 李樹法（Lee Shu Fa）

李魯人，别名全希愚，33岁，江苏人，已婚，现居渡船路519弄1号。

我出生于上海，在此读书至16岁，随后在南市的一家轮船公司工作至21岁，之后失业约三年。1931年，我在上海市政府财政局获得了一份职员职位，一直任职到中日战事爆发。

我再次失业，持续了一年多。利用剩下的600元，我于1939年开办了一家鞋店，以此谋生。我一直经营至此，1940年在我现址开办了一家制鞋作坊，雇佣了两名助手。

1940年11月，我在南京路上遇到了前上海市政府财政局官员陈伯平（Zung at B18）。

在随后的交谈中，我谈到了时局艰难，并鉴于他以前的地位，询问他能否为我找一个更好的职位。他最终告诉我，有一项属于“国家秩序”的工作，我可以在经营自己生意的同时去做。我同意尽力协助他。被告知我只需要传递信息。

11月底左右，宗带我去了余姚路的一家茶馆，在那里他把我介绍给一位姓马（Ho）的人，我将从此人那里接受进一步指示。

几天后，我被介绍给

pages.en:
-3-
six other persons, namely:-
Sung Chang Yung (孫錦文)
**〔此处转录不清〕** Yi (王琪 )
Ling Nyeu **〔此处转录不清〕** NG (秦元鴻)
Talh ( 威 )
L o g ( 龍 )
One other, name forgotten
who were members of the intelligence section under **〔此处转录不清〕**.
I met these persons at agreed-u on times and places
where I was handed messages or letters which I in turn handed
to Mo or Loh Kyi Nan(4th accused). The latter visited my home
every day to collect or deliver messages. She also brought my
wages, $90.00 per month.
This continued until the time of my arrest. I do
not know where the other members mentioned live.
Regarding the ammunition (20 rounds Mauser, documents
and crops) seized at my home, they were given to me by Mo for
safekeeping in November 1940.
Other than carrying messages, I have not engaged in
any terrorist Acts. It was not until I had been a member for
some weeks that I learned I was a member of the Blue Shirt
Society.
I always knew the 4th accused Loh Kyi Nan as
Miss Chang.

Signed.
pages.zh:
-3-
另外六个人，即：
孫錦文（Sung Chang Yung）
王琪（Yi）〔此处转录不清〕
秦元鴻（Ling Nyeu ... NG）〔此处转录不清〕
威（Talh）
龍（Log）
另一人，姓名已忘
这些人都是隶属于〔此处转录不清〕的情报组成员。我在约定的时间和地点与这些人见面，接收他们交给我的信息或信件，然后转交给莫先生（Mo）或第四被告陸紀南。后者每天到我家收取或递送信息。她还带来我的工资，每月90.00元。
这种情况一直持续到我被捕。我不知道上述其他成员的居住地。
关于在我家中搜获的弹药（20发毛瑟枪子弹）、文件和农作物，是莫先生于1940年11月交给我保管的。
除了传递信息外，我没有参与任何恐怖活动。直到加入几周后，我才知道自己是蓝衣社的成员。
我一直称第四被告陸紀南为张小姐。

签名。

With G. C. Cuard

Zeu Peh We （周柏威）
// A.C.I. Fowler
Pootung
C. B. H. J. 9-3-41 Clerk C.Y. Chien

My name is Zeu Peh Wa slias Zeu Soong (周松), 26
native of Pootung, married, residing 1407 Avenue Road.
I was born in Pootung and attended school there
between the ages of 8 and 14. I then became apprentice in a
Sea food shop there for three years and for the next four
years ran my own business. The following year the Sino-
Japanese hostilities broke out and I joined the Kiangsu
and Chekiang Mobilisation Corps in Pootung. In December 1938
as a result of application for special training, I and seven
others were sent to Kyi An (吉安) in Honan Province.
Whilst there I was instructed in espionage and
sabotage work and given an elementary knowledge of the use
of chemicals for that work. I was then transferred to Chung-
king where I received further training in the making of high
explosive and incendiary bombs.

In May 1939, I and one other named Lieu (刘) left
Chungking and made our way to Shanghai where we were told
we must contact one named Lee at an address of Avenue Joffre
F.C. Some days after our arrival we met Lee who, we learned,
was an important member of the Blue Shirt Society.
Up to the time of my arrest Lieu and I lived at
various addresses in the French Concession and Settlement.
Our last address was 1407 Avenue Road where I was arrested.
I only knew the 4th accused Loh Kyi Han who used to visit us
to collect messages at some agreed-upon place. She also
brought my wages, $150.00.
During the time I have been in Shanghai I have made
pages.zh:
与 G. C. Cuard 一起

周柏威（Zeu Peh We）
// A.C.I. Fowler
浦东
中央局总部 J. 9-3-41 书记员 C.Y. Chien

我叫周柏威，别名周松（Zeu Soong），26岁，浦东人，已婚，现居爱文义路1407号。
我出生于浦东，8至14岁期间在那里上学。随后在当地一家海味店当了三年学徒，接下来的四年经营自己的生意。次年，中日战事爆发，我加入了浦东的苏浙动员委员会。1938年12月，因申请特别训练，我和其他七人被派往河南省吉安（Kyi An）。
在那里，我接受了间谍和破坏工作的指导，并学习了用于此类工作的化学品的初步知识。随后我被调往重庆，在那里接受了制造高爆炸药和燃烧弹的进一步训练。

1939年5月，我和另一位姓刘（Lieu）的人离开重庆，前往上海，被告知必须在法租界霞飞路的一个地址联系一位姓李的人。到达几天后，我们见到了李某，得知他是蓝衣社的重要成员。
直到我被捕为止，刘某和我住在法租界和公共租界的各个地址。我们最后的住址是爱文义路1407号，我在那里被捕。我只认识第四被告陸紀汉（Loh Kyi Han），她常在约定地点来访以收取信息。她还带来了我的工资，150.00元。
在上海期间，我制作了

pages.en:
I ce lary bombs : tw or three occasions but for what
purpose these were ultimately set, I do not know.
I do not know the present whereabouts of my deliberate
Lieu.

Signed :-
pages.zh:
冰炸弹：两三次，但这些炸弹最终用于什么目的，我并不知晓。
我不知道我的同伴刘某目前的下落。

签名：

pages.en:
Zau Wong Sz ( 趙 王 氏 )
// D.S.I. Fowler
Pootung
H.Q.C.B. 6th Sept.1941 Clerk Y.C. Chien

Zau Wong Sz alias Wong Ching Ngoo( 王 清 娥 ) 19,
native of Pootung, living together with Zau Pah Wa( 趙 柏 華 ),
7th accused, at No. 1407 Avenue Road.

I met Zau Pah Wa in May 1941 through the introduction of one named Zunr Kei( 〔此处转录不清〕 ). In June 1941 I went to live together with Zau Pah Wa at an address on Sinza Road. In August we moved to the present address.

Zau Pah Wa told me he worked in an exchange shop but I do not know where.

I do not know anything of any political group of which he may be a member.

I have never been concerned in politics in any way.

I have seen Zau Pah Wa go to the upstairs front room of 1407 Avenue Road on several occasions but do not know his reason for so doing.

Signed:
pages.zh:
趙王氏（Zau Wong Sz）
// D.S.I. Fowler
浦东
中央局总部 1941年9月6日 书记员 Y.C. Chien

趙王氏，别名王清娥（Wong Ching Ngoo），19岁，浦东人，与第七被告趙柏華（Zau Pah Wa）同居于爱文义路1407号。

我于1941年5月通过一位名叫 Zunr Kei（〔此处转录不清〕）的人介绍认识了趙柏華。1941年6月，我去新闸路的一个地址与趙柏華同居。8月，我们搬到了现在的地址。

趙柏華告诉我他在一家兑换店工作，但我不知道具体地点。

对他可能所属的任何政治团体，我一无所知。

我从未以任何方式参与政治。

我曾几次看到趙柏華去爱文义路1407号的前楼房间，但不知道他这样做的原因。

签名：

D. C. (Special Branch).

Headquarters
C.l.'isc.172/41        Crime Branch
                       1st September       41.
2

Further to:-Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie.
Arrest of persons alleged to be members of Blue
Shirt Society.

The watch maintained at Lane 61/17 Love Lane
vide diary 1 sheet 4 was withdrawn at 12 noon 29-8-41
at the request of the Gendarmerie.

A perusal by Special Branch of documents etc.
seized in the raids as described in diary 1 revealed
only pamphlets seized at Lane 519/10 Ferry Road and the
draft of a letter seized at Lane 1103/81 Sinza Road as
being of any importance. A copy of the translations is
attached.

Resultant from a report made by the Chief
tenant of No. 1407 Avenue Road to B'Well Station to the
effect he thought explosive mixtures were being stored
in the room next to that searched by a combined party
of S.M. Police and Japanese Gendarmerie on 28-8-41
vide diary 1 sheet 8, chemicals etc. as per attached
list were, on the instructions of D.C. (Crime and
Special Branches) handed over to the Japanese Gendar-
merie on the morning of August 30th.

The owner of this property was out at the
time of the initial raid and has not returned since.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / A.S.D. SPECIAL BRANCH / 1941）

（批：6/9. / bya / PJm / 1/9/41 2 9pm）

（签名：C.H. Bowden / D.C. I.）
pages.zh:
D. C. (特科)。

总部
C.l.'isc.172/41        刑事科
                       1941年9月1日
2

续：协助日本宪兵队。
逮捕涉嫌为蓝衣社成员的人员。

应宪兵队要求，爱文义路61弄17号的监视（见日记1第4页）于1941年8月29日中午12点撤销。

特科查阅了日记1所述突袭行动中搜获的文件等物品，发现只有渡船路519弄10号搜获的小册子和新闸路1103弄81号搜获的一封信件草稿具有重要性。译文副本附后。

由于爱文义路1407号的主要租户向静安寺巡捕房报告，认为在1941年8月28日由工部局警务处和日本宪兵队联合小组搜查的房间隔壁（见日记1第8页）储存有爆炸混合物，根据刑事科和特科副总监的指示，清单所列的化学品等物品于8月30日上午移交给日本宪兵队。

该房产的所有者在初次突袭时外出，此后尚未返回。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / A.S.D. SPECIAL BRANCH / 1941）

（批：6/9. / bya / PJm / 1/9/41 晚上9点）

（签名：C.H. Bowden / D.C. I.）

Summarized translation of a document sized during a raid
at Lane 1103/81 Sinza Road on August 29, 1941 (C.1 Misc.
172/41)

REPORT DATED MAY 29 ... ITTED BY CHIH YUNG
SENG (戚祖昇) ON THE SURRENDER OF REAR-
ADMIRAL WONG SHOU DING (王寿廷) ET AL
TO THE BOGUS REGIME

Rear-Admiral Wong Shou Ding, Chief of the Shanghai
Office of the Ministry of Navy of the National Government,
Yih Hwai Zung (葉懷仁), confidential secretary and supply
officer of that office, and two telegraph operators were
arrested at 5.30 a.m. March 28 by enemy gendarmes in conjunction
with the French Police. They were subsequently removed to
Hongkew and later taken to the bogus Special Service Group
Headquarters of 76 Jessfield Road at Hwa Tsung (華邨) alleyway
(at first they were put at the home of Au Tsoong Ming 夏仲明).

According to investigations, the arrest of Wong Shou
Ding et al is the result of a pre-arrangement concluded by Wong
Shou Ding and Yih Hwai Zung with the bogus regime to side with
the latter, and is enacted for the purpose of deceiving the
government, the Ministry of Navy and the public. Wong Shou
Ding's motive to side with the renegades arose from a censure
given by Admiral Chen Shao Kwen, Commander-in-chief of the Naval
Forces, and the cause of the censure is that Wong Shou Ding, in
connivance with Yih Hwai Zung, had rendered false accounts of
the manner in which huge sums of money were spent. Enraged at
being censured, Wong Shou Ding and Yih Hwai Zung secretly arranged
with renegade Li Wei Chi (李維治), Chief of the Supplies
Department of the Ministry of Navy of the bogus regime, for their
surrender. According to the pre-arrangement, Wong was to be
appointed, after his surrender, Minister of Navy in succession of
renegade Jen Yuan Tao, while Li Wei Chi also promised to solicit

1941年8月29日对新闸路1103弄81号突袭行动中查获文件的摘要译文（C.1 Misc. 172/41）

5月29日报告……由戚祖昇提交，关于海军少将王寿廷等人向伪政权投降一事

国民政府海军部上海办事处主任海军少将王寿廷、该办事处机要秘书兼补给官叶怀仁以及两名报务员，于3月28日凌晨5时30分被敌方宪兵会同法国警察逮捕。他们随后被带往虹口，之后被押至极司菲尔路76号华邨弄堂的伪方“特别服务团”总部（起初他们被关押在夏仲明家中）。

据调查，王寿廷等人被捕是王寿廷与叶怀宗同伪政权达成投靠后者的预先安排的结果，此举旨在欺骗政府、海军部及公众。王寿廷投靠叛徒的动机源于海军总司令陈绍宽上将对其进行的申斥，而申斥的原因是王寿廷伙同叶怀仁在巨额款项的使用方式上做了虚假账目。因受到申斥而恼怒，王寿廷和叶怀仁秘密与伪政权海军部军需处处长叛徒李维治安排投降事宜。根据预先安排，王寿廷投降后将接替叛徒任援道出任伪海军部长，同时李维治也承诺争取

pages.en:
the assistance of Rear-Admiral Yamamoto of the enemy navy to install
Wong as bogus Minister of Navy. All these arrangements were
concluded at the end of November through the medium of Li Wei
Chi's father and Yih Hwai Zung.

At this juncture Wong Shou Ding planned to embezzle a
huge sum of public funds to be remitted from Chungking before
joining the renegades. It was not until March when a sum of
$60,000.00 was remitted from Chungking and plus a balance of $10,000
the funds were deposited with the Kincheng Banking Corporation.
Seeing that the time was ripe, Wong rebelled and hence his arrest
at the hands of the enemy gendarmes. At the enemy gendarmerie
headquarters, Wong not only was not tortured but he also was well
treated and attended by a physician. He offered all his
knowledge about the naval secrets, artillery positions, activities
of mine layers, etc. to the enemy. He was subsequently removed
to No.76 Jessfield Road, and later put up at the home of Au Tsoong
Ming, Director of Kiangsu-Chekiang-Anhwei Sulphur and Saltpetre
Bureau.

However, the arrangement made in November for the
appointment of Wong Shou Ding as bogus Minister of Navy
miscarried. The renegades summoned him to a post in Nanking,
But Wong, disheartened at his failure to obtain a ministerial
position, preferred to stay in Shanghai. Wong now receives a
monthly salary of $800, Yih Hwai Zung $220, while the two telegraph
operators have been transferred for duty in Nanking. Wong
and Yih are now said to be penitent over their action.

It is suggested that drastic steps be taken against
these men as a deterrent to others.
pages.zh:
敌方海军山本少将的支持，以扶植王寿廷担任伪海军部长。所有这些安排均于11月底通过李维治之父和叶怀仁作为中介达成。

在此期间，王寿廷计划在加入叛徒阵营之前，侵吞一笔将从重庆汇来的巨额公款。直到3月份，当重庆汇来60,000.00美元，加上结余的10,000美元，这笔资金被存入金城银行。见时机成熟，王寿廷发动叛变，因此被敌方宪兵逮捕。在敌方宪兵队总部，王寿廷不仅未受酷刑，反而受到优待并有医生照料。他向敌人提供了所有关于海军机密、炮兵阵地、布雷舰活动等方面的情报。他随后被转移至极司菲尔路76号，后来住进江苏浙江安徽硫磺硝石局局长夏仲明的家中。

然而，11月达成的任命王寿廷为伪海军部长的安排未能实现。叛徒方面召他去南京任职，但王寿廷因未能获得部长职位而感到灰心，宁愿留在上海。据悉，王寿廷目前月薪800元，叶怀仁220元，而两名报务员已被调往南京任职。据说王、叶二人现在对他们的行为感到悔悟。

建议对这些人采取严厉措施，以儆效尤。

raid at Junc 519/10 arr, used on August , 1941
(Col .doc. 172/41)

Handbill containing a copy of a speech
addressed by General Chiang Kai-shek to soldiers
and citizens on the occasion of the 4th anniversary
of the outbreak of the local Sino-Japanese hostilities
on August 13, 1937. In this speech, General Chiang
dwells upon the present world situation and urges
the people in occupied areas to assist in the
economic war against Japan so as to hasten her
bankruptcy.

At 5 p.m. August 31, 1941 Sergeant Morishita of
the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters attended Crime
Branch Headquarters and related that a short time
previously a male Chinese named Tsah Zaung Tuh (蔡尚德)
47, Shanghai, had been arrested at the North
Railway Station as a result of his personal belongings
being searched and photographic copies of document
stating one named Tsah Zaung Ts (蔡尚之) was a member
of an anti-Japanese group.

A request was made to search the arrested man's
home Lane 228/31 Burkill Road.

Assistance rendered at 5.30 p.m. by D.S. Sameshima.
D.S.I. Ma Vni Faung, C.D.C. 84 and the undersigned.
Sinja Station and U.S.M.C. Headquarters were informed

the scene.

and the photographic copies of the document referred to
his younger brother Tsah Zaung Ts who had been killed
three years ago whilst fighting. He held the rank of
Commander.

1941年8月31日下午2时30分，井上警曹长和日本宪兵队（西区，极司菲尔路76号）成员来到刑事科总部，请求协助前往浙江路108弄37号锦鸣旅馆的两个房间，逮捕其中约20人，据称房间内藏有四或五支枪支。根据所得情报，这些人是反日团体成员。

由巡捕督察丁文芳、巡查岛崎、中国侦探警士40号、中国侦探警员84号及署名者提供协助。老闸捕房已获知此次行动意向。

小组于下午2时45分访问了64号房间，但该房间空无一人。未查获任何物品。随后访问了47号房间，并将以下四人拘留：-

1) 章美超 24岁，苏州籍，男/职员，受雇于刘半山（复兴政府驻上海军事部队少校）。非武装部队在上海。

2) 徐仲華 18岁，浦东籍，男/职员，同上。非武装部队在上海。

3) 章徐氏 21岁，浦东籍，第一名人之妻。

4) 陳美雲 16岁，浦东籍。第二名人之未婚妻。

pages.en:
1/2

A search of the room proved unavailing.
The four were brought to Crime Branch Headquarters
(C.I.) when the Gendarmerie called upon Lee Ih Chih
(李仁智), their informer. He attended C.B.H.Q. (C.I.)
but was unable to identify any of the four as being
concerned as alleged.
Questioning of the 1st and 2nd named revealed they
had been sent to Shanghai by Lieu Pau San from Pootung
to purchase uniforms and equipment for the military
forces there. On coming to Shanghai the females
accompanied them.
They allege that the informer, whom they know, had
requested a loan of money from Lieu Pau San but this had
been refused. Presumably the informer had given the
present information from spite.
There being nothing to warrant the detention of the
four persons, they were released at 4.45 p.m. August 31,
1941.

（签名：C. W. Sowden）
C. S. I.

pages.zh:
1/2

对房间的搜查一无所获。
当宪兵队传唤其线人李仁智（Lee Ih Chih）时，这四名嫌疑人被带至刑事调查处总部（C.I.）。他前往刑事调查处总部（C.B.H.Q. (C.I.)），但无法指认其中任何一人涉嫌所称之罪行。
经讯问，名列第一和第二的两人透露，他们是由浦东的刘宝山（Lieu Pau San）派往上海，为当地的军事部队购买制服和装备。抵达上海后，两名女子陪同他们同行。
他们声称，他们认识的这名线人曾向刘宝山借钱，但遭到拒绝。推测该线人是出于报复心理提供了目前的情报。
由于没有理由拘留这四人，他们于1941年8月31日下午4时45分获释。

Further to : Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 〔此处转录不清〕 p.m. on the 2nd September 1941 Sergeant Nagumo
of the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters accompanied by
a prisoner Tsu Chien Ying called at H.Q.C.B. C.I.
Offices and requested assistance to again visit No.130
Hwakee Avenue, Bubbling Well Road, wherein to keep a
watch between 6 p.m. and 9 p.m. for the purpose of
intercepting telephone calls if made to this address
by the wanted man Woo in an endeavour to arrange a ren-
dezvous between the prisoner Tsu and the wanted man Woo
to effect the arrest of the latter.

Necessary arrangements having been made with the
U.S.M. Corps and Bubbling Well Station the requested
assistance was rendered by U.S.I.s Konovaloff, Yang
Shih Kwang and D.S. Sameshima and between the hours
mentioned two telephone calls were received from Woo
and same were answered by the prisoner Tsu.

During the conversation between these two individuals
the prisoner expressed his desire to meet the caller
but the latter emphatically declined the invitation
therefore nothing has materialised and the watch was
discontinued at 9 p.m.

1941年9月2日下午〔此处转录不清〕时，日本宪兵队总部的成沼（Nagumo）警佐在一名名为朱剑英（Tsu Chien Ying）的囚犯陪同下，来到刑事调查处总部刑事科办公室，请求协助再次前往静安寺路130号华琪公寓（Hwakee Avenue, Bubbling Well Road），以便在下午6时至9时之间进行监视，目的是拦截通缉犯胡（Woo）可能拨打至该地址的电话，试图安排囚犯朱与通缉犯胡会面，从而逮捕后者。

在与美国海军陆战队及静安寺捕房作出必要安排后，由特别调查员科诺瓦洛夫（Konovaloff）、杨世光（Yang Shih Kwang）和副巡长同岛（Sameshima）提供了所请求的协助。在上述时段内，接到了胡打来的两个电话，均由囚犯朱接听。

在这两人的谈话过程中，囚犯表示希望与来电者见面，但后者坚决拒绝了邀请，因此未发生任何实质情况，监视于晚上9时停止。

At 2 p.m. on the 2nd September 1941 Sergeant
Sasaki and two other members of the Japanese Gendarmerie
accompanied by a male prisoner named Fong Kyi Kung (馮起鎮)

called at C.l. offices and requested further assistance

a female named Zung (陳 ). The latter, according to
the prisoner, is a member of the Blue Shirt Society and
was to meet him at this address at about 3 p.m. this
instant.

Kwang, D.S. Sameshima, C.D.C. 206 together with the
Gendarmes visited the address noted but no arrest of
the wanted female was effected.

Sinsa Station was informed of the impending

1941年9月1日下午3时30分，池田（Ikada）军曹在日本宪兵队总部其他成员以及一名名为梁幹（Liang Kan）的线人（22岁，苏州人）的陪同下，来到刑事调查处总部，请求协助前往爱文义路（Avenue Road）近大通路（Tatung Road）的清波里（Ching Poh Li）弄堂内的某处中国住宅，目的是尽可能逮捕一名名为王（Wong）的被通缉者，据称其为蓝衣社成员。

池田军曹进一步解释说，被通缉者很可能携带武器。

在与美国海军陆战队作出必要安排后，由督察克赖顿（Crighton）、副巡长吉永（Yoshinaga）、副巡长兼督察吴振模（Wu Chen Mo）和中国籍侦探主任第184号提供了所需的协助。

到达涉案地址爱文义路清波里（普福里）8号后，线人带领小队进入楼下前间，并指认其中一名名为：

董嘉瑞（Tung Chia Say），又名王全昆（Wong Chuen Kwen），34岁，扬州人，无业，居住于此。

即为被通缉者。

（印：特别分部）
（批注：L-3/9）

pages.en:
1/2

A search of this room revealed the following :-
1. One mauser pistol and two magazines. No number.
2. One "Belgium" .38 Revolver. No number.
3. Six cannister bombs.
4. Five bamboo sticks filled with gun cotton.
5. Forty two rounds of ammunition.
6. One inoculation certificate, issued at Hongkong
on the 10th April 1941 in name of Tung Chia Say.

Together with the arrested person the above seizures
were brought to Crime Branch Headquarters, where Sergeant
Major Ikada requested the immediate handing over of both.

The arrested man on being questioned admitted being a
member of the Blue Shirts Society, also to the fact that
he had previously met the Gendarmerie informer whilst
the latter had been serving in the same organisation.

In view of above disclosures and on the instructions
of D.C. (Crime & Special Branches) the arrested man
and seizures were handed over to Sergeant Major Ikada
against the usual receipt attached.

The guns, ammunition etc. have been submitted to the
Arms Identification Section for examination and the
result of same will be made the subject of a further
diary.

〔此处转录不清：左侧有手写批注痕迹，右下角有签名〕
pages.zh:
1/2

对该房间的搜查发现以下物品：
1. 毛瑟手枪一支及弹匣两个。无编号。
2. “比利时”产 .38口径左轮手枪一支。无编号。
3. 罐状炸弹六个。
4. 装满棉火药（gun cotton）的竹棍五根。
5. 子弹四十二发。
6. 接种证书一份，1941年4月10日签发于香港，姓名为董嘉瑞。

上述缴获物品连同被捕者被带至刑事调查处总部，池田军曹请求立即移交两者。

被捕者在接受讯问时承认自己是蓝衣社成员，并承认此前曾在该线人服务于同一组织期间与其见过面。

鉴于上述披露，并根据刑事及特别分部副总监（D.C.）的指示，被捕者及缴获物品已凭附后的常规收据移交给池田军曹。

枪支、弹药等已提交武器鉴定科进行检查，检查结果将另行记录在案。

Special Branch

Tung Chai Say (董嘉瑞) alias Wong Chuen Kwen. (王全)
// C.D.C. 57
Yangchow
C.B.R. . .      10-9-41       translate:    Y.C. Cheng.
                                xxxxxxxx

Tung Chai Say alias Wong Chuen Kwen, age 34, native
of Yangchow, Kiangsu, residing House No. 8 Chi Fu Li,
Avenue Road.

I was born in Hankow and came to Shanghai with my
parents when at the age of four. When I was six years old, I
began to attend a private school. At the age of sixteen, I
studied in the Sei Yoh Higher Primary School, while I was
living in House 538 Wuokang Li, Chengtu Road. From the age
of 16 to 19, I studied in the Y.M.C.A. Senior Middle School
situated on Szechuen Road, and graduated from this school at
the age of nineteen.

After my graduation from the aforementioned
school I became unemployed until the age of 24. In July 1931
I had obtained a post as a clerk in the Sung Sing Weaving &
Cotton Co. located at No. 421 Kiangsuee Road. I held the said
position until the outbreak of hostilities in the year 1937,
when I was living in House 8 Dah Zung Li, Dahtung Road. I
became unemployed again for three years.

In April 1940 I went to Hongkong to visit one of
my old classmates named Woo Tung, who is at present an
journalist in the Central News Agency located on Duh Poo Rd.,
Hongkong, and requested him to get a job for me, but as a result
he was unable to do so. Afterwards through the introduction
of a friend of mine named Ho Ying Kwei (馬寅官), I was
employed as a translator in the Sz Dai (時代) Book Store
located on Lah Bau Road (樂道), Kowloon. About a year later
due to the removing of this book store to Chungking, I ther

（左侧边缘手写批注及印章区域）
〔此处转录不清〕
pages.zh:
特别分部

董嘉瑞（Tung Chai Say），又名王全昆（Wong Chuen Kwen）。
// 中国籍侦探主任 57
扬州
刑事调查处卷宗 . .      1941年9月10日       翻译：Y.C. Cheng.
                                xxxxxxxx

董嘉瑞，又名王全昆，34岁，江苏扬州人，居住在爱文义路积福里8号。

我出生于汉口，四岁时随父母来到上海。六岁时，我开始上私塾。十六岁时，我住在成都路武康里538号，就读于西侨小学（Sei Yoh Higher Primary School）。从十六岁到十九岁，我在位于四川路的青年会中学（Y.M.C.A. Senior Middle School）读书，并于十九岁从该校毕业。

从上述学校毕业后，我一直失业直到二十四岁。1931年7月，我在江苏路421号的松盛纺织棉花公司（Sung Sing Weaving & Cotton Co.）获得了一份职员的工作。我担任该职位直到1937年战事爆发，当时我住在大通路达众里8号。此后我又失业了三年。

1940年4月，我前往香港拜访我的一位老同学吴东（Woo Tung），他目前是香港德辅道中央新闻社的记者，我请求他为我找份工作，但结果他未能办到。后来，通过我的朋友马寅官（Ho Ying Kwei）的介绍，我在九龙乐道（Lah Bau Road）的时代（Sz Dai）书店受雇为翻译。大约一年后，由于该书店迁往重庆，我 ther

（左侧边缘手写批注及印章区域）
〔此处转录不清〕

-2-

lost this job. Then I went to my classmate, Woo Tung again ,
and requested him to help me getting a job, whilst he replied
me that one of his friends named Woo Sheng(吴馨 ),being
living in Shanghai, would be able to introduce me to work on
investigation activities, and that I might receive a salary
of $60.00 per month; in the mean time I might find some other
business to do myself.

On 16-4-41 I returned to Shanghai from Hongkong.
On 20-4-41 I went to visit one Mei Soong Chuen(梅松筠),
living in the Foo Kei(闺 ) Studio on the eastern part of
Mohawk Road near Avenue Edward VII, while the latter in turn
brought me to see Woo Sheng.

During my interview with him, Woo Sheng told me
that my appointed work was to carry on the activities of
Action Squad of the Blue Shirt Society. I became a member of
their Blue Shirt Society, and my salary was $60.00 per month.
After about one month, I promoted to be a captain of the Action
Squad, and my monthly salary was increased to $80.00 . A sum of
$8.00 would be taken monthly from my salary for subscription,
therefore I could get a net salary of $72.00 every month, and
beside this sum of money, I could get $100.00 more for my
allowance. During my employment in the Action Squad of the
Blue Shirt Society for four months, I had nothing to do at all.
Seven other members were appointed to work under me, namely:-
Chu Sz Sing(邱水新), Sung Ts Ling(沈士林), Chang Hsiang
(张翔 ), Lee Ma(李茂), Wong Soong Ling(王松林), Chang
Ts Chee(张左琦) and Mei Soong Chuen(梅松筠).
pages.zh:
-2-

失去了这份工作。随后我又去找我的同学吴东（Woo Tung，音译），请求他帮我找份工作，而他回复我说，他有一位名叫吴馨（Woo Sheng）的朋友住在上海，能够介绍我从事调查活动的工作，并且我每月可领取薪金60.00美元；同时，我自己也可以另找些生意做。

1941年4月16日，我从香港返回上海。
1941年4月20日，我去拜访了一位名叫梅松筠（Mei Soong Chuen）的人，他住在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）附近莫霍克路（Mohawk Road，音译）东段的闺记（Foo Kei，音译）照相馆，而后者随即带我去见吴馨。

在与他会谈期间，吴馨告诉我，指派给我的工作是开展蓝衣社行动队（Action Squad of the Blue Shirt Society）的活动。我成为了他们蓝衣社的一员，月薪为60.00美元。大约一个月后，我晋升为行动队队长，月薪增至80.00美元。每月从我的薪水中扣除8.00美元作为会费，因此我每月的净收入为72.00美元，此外，我还能获得100.00美元的津贴。我在蓝衣社行动队任职的四个月期间，完全无事可做。另有七名成员被指派在我手下工作，他们是：邱水新（Chu Sz Sing）、沈士林（Sung Ts Ling）、张翔（Chang Hsiang）、李茂（Lee Ma）、王松林（Wong Soong Ling）、张左琦（Chang Ts Chee）和梅松筠（Mei Soong Chuen）。

pages.en:
-3-

Lo Mu, Wong Soong Ling and Chang Ts Chee were
transferred to Chungking in June this year, and Mei Soong
Cheun was dismissed from our Society owing to his improper
behavior in July this year, whilst a new member named Wong
Tsung Pao(alias Tsang Tsung Pao, who was arrested in the Dah
Shing Co.) was transferred to join our Society in July the
same year. On 29-8-41 Chu Sz Sing and Sung 's Ling were
transferred to Shanghai and Chang Hsiang was dismissed from
our Society due to his poor record.

At 3 p.m. on 1-9-41 I was arrested by the Central
Police at House 8 Ching Foh Li, Avenue Road, and then brought
to the Japanese Gendarmerie in Hongkong.

This is my true statement.

Signed;
pages.zh:
-3-

罗穆（Lo Mu，音译）、王松林和张左琦于今年六月被调往重庆，而梅松筠因今年七月行为不端被本社开除，同时一名名叫王宗保（Wong Tsung Pao，别名曾宗保 Tsang Tsung Pao，在大兴公司被捕）的新成员于同年七月调入本社。1941年8月29日，邱水新和沈士林被调往上海，张翔因表现不佳被本社开除。

1941年9月1日下午3时，我在爱文义路（Avenue Road）庆福里8号被中央捕房逮捕，随后被带至香港的日本宪兵队。

这是我的真实供词。

签名：

pages.en:
Tsang Tsung au (張春寶)
Nanzing // .D.S. 341
. B. V. . 1 - - 1 Translated .Y. Chien

My name is Tsang Tsung au alias Wong Yei Ling (黃也鈴)
age 24, native of Nanzin, Chekiang, Actor employed with
the staff Garden of the Sun Co., Nanking Road near Yi Ya Ching
Road.

I was born in Nanzing where at that time my father
owned a food shop. I started schooling at the age of 7 and
ceased it at the age of 12. Soon after I assisted my father
in the said food shop.

In September 1937 I came to Shanghai with a view to
locating my father's friend named Yih Foong Sau who was then
employed with the Sun Co. on Nanking Road. Having found him
(Yih Foong Sau), I requested his pleasure in teaching me how
to act. This he agreed and he also allowed me to sleep on the
stage. Up to the present I have held this position for more
than three years.

In May 1941 while I was in the Billiard Room of the Sun
Co., I came to contact with one named Lee Zu Shiu (李實秋).
As a result of meeting each other in the Billiard Room daily
we gradually became friendly. In June 1941 I met Lee Zu
Shiu accompanied by one named Tung Chi Say alias Wong Chuen
Kwen in the Sun Co., the latter being introduced to me by
Lee Zu Shiu. Then we (three) went to a nearby place and seated
together, murmuring about the high cost of living. Tung also
asked me of my monthly wages. I told him that my monthly
wages was $70.00, but after paying off my daily food with the
said sum, I felt very embarrassed in covering other expenses.
At that time he did not speak of the Blue Shirt Society.
pages.zh:
曾宗宝（Tsang Tsung au）
南京 // .D.S. 341
. B. V. . 1 - - 1 翻译者 Y. Chien

我叫曾宗宝，别名黄也铃（Wong Yei Ling），年龄24岁，浙江南浔（Nanzin，音译）人，受雇于南京路近爱雅清路（Yi Ya Ching Road，音译）的大舞台公司（Sun Co.）职员花园。

我出生在南浔，当时我父亲拥有一家食品店。我7岁开始上学，12岁辍学。不久后我便协助父亲经营上述食品店。

1937年9月，我来到上海，目的是寻找我父亲的朋友叶凤寿（Yih Foong Sau，音译），他当时受雇于南京路的大舞台公司。找到他（叶凤寿）后，我请他教我演戏。他同意了，并允许我睡在舞台上。到目前为止，我担任此职已超过三年。

1941年5月，当我在大舞台公司的台球室时，我结识了一位名叫李实秋（Lee Zu Shiu）的人。由于每天在台球室相遇，我们逐渐变得熟络。1941年6月，我在大舞台公司遇见了李实秋，他身边还有一位名叫董其思（Tung Chi Say，音译，别名黄全坤 Wong Chuen Kwen，音译）的人，后者是由李实秋介绍给我的。随后我们（三人）去附近一个地方坐下，低声谈论生活费用高昂的问题。董还问了我的月薪。我告诉他我的月薪是70.00美元，但在用这笔钱支付日常伙食费后，我感到难以应付其他开支。当时他并未提及蓝衣社。

pages.en:
- 2 -

On the afternoon on 11-7-41 Tung Chia Say came again
to the Sun Co. and met me in the 3rd theatre stage where
he whispered to me that he had a secret and special job
for me if I was willing to undertake it. On my agreeing to
do it, he asked me to go to a secluded place where he would
tell me distinctly. This was accordingly done. Then Tung
Chia Say informed me the job was to make enquiries into the
movements of any traitors for the Blue Shirt Society. As
this job had nothing to contradict my present job, I accepted
it and agreed to join his suggested society. Following this
he gave me $72.00 as my starting wages.

On 14-8-41 he came again to the Sun Co. but this time
prior to his leaving the resort he did not disclose any
secret to me.

At about 12 noon 30-8-41 I was walking on Tientsin
Road near Shanse Road where I happened to meet Tung Chia Say.
at the request of the latter I accompanied him to Room No.50
of the Ts Yuan Lodging House. On entering the said room I
found two boys and a short time later I was given by Tung
Chia Say a sum of $72.00. Having received the money I returned
to the Sun Co. and carried on my business.

At about 9 p.m. 1-9-41 I was arrested in the Roof Garden
of the Sun Co. by Japanese Gendarmes with assistance of the
S.M. Police together with Tung Chia Say, and conveyed to
Crime Branch Headquarters where I was subsequently handed over
to the Japanese Gendarmerie where I made a statement which
is corroborative with the facts I have so far related. It is
to be noted that although I have received two months' wages
yet I have not done any work.

Signed:
pages.zh:
- 2 -

1941年7月11日下午，董其思再次来到大舞台公司，并在第三剧场舞台见到我，他悄悄对我说，如果我愿意承担，他有一份秘密且特殊的工作给我。在我同意之后，他让我去一个僻静的地方，以便清楚地告诉我详情。于是照办了。随后董其思告知我，这项工作是为蓝衣社调查任何汉奸的行踪。由于这项工作与我目前的工作并无冲突，我接受了它，并同意加入他所建议的社团。接着他给了我72.00美元作为起始工资。

1941年8月14日，他再次来到大舞台公司，但这次在他离开该场所之前，并未向我透露任何秘密。

1941年8月30日中午12点左右，我正走在山西路附近的天津路上，碰巧遇到了董其思。应后者的要求，我陪他去了慈源旅社（Ts Yuan Lodging House，音译）50号房间。进入该房间后，我发现里面有两名男子，过了一会儿，董其思给了我72.00美元。收到钱后，我回到大舞台公司继续工作。

1941年9月1日晚上9点左右，我在大舞台公司的屋顶花园被日本宪兵在市警务处的协助下逮捕，同被捕的还有董其思，随后被押送至刑事侦缉处总部，之后我被移交给日本宪兵队，在那里我做了一份陈述，其内容与我迄今为止所述事实相符。需要注意的是，虽然我领取了两个月的工资，但我尚未做任何工作。

签名：

C. C. (Special Branch)
Secret/14

Headquarters
C.I. Misc. 177/41 Crime Branch
Sept. 16, 41
3

Further to : Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie
Headquarters on behalf of Nantao Gendarmerie

The loan of the two detained males :-
1) Tsao Koh Kwei (趙國輝), 26, Pootung.
2) Hia Ching Foh (謝景福), 27, Kiangsu
was, on instructions of D.C. (Crime & Special
Branches), extended on September 8, 1941. They
were returned to Crime Branch Headquarters (C.I.)
on September 12th.

Shankerke No. 801/41 dated 11-9-41, requests
the immediate handing over to the Gendarmerie of the
two males on the grounds that the 1st named as a member
of the Blue Shirt Society, shot and killed 1st Class
private Sakai on Ming Keh Road, Nantao, on July 31,
1941, and that through his admissions the weapon used
was recovered from an address in the French Concession.

That the 2nd named became a member of the Blue
Shirt Society in April 1941, and was employed in the
capacity of liaison officer.

Statements (copies attached) taken from both
males admit the foregoing.

A summary of the evidence for and against
their handing over to the Gendarmerie is attached.

D. S. I.
pages.zh:
C. C. （特务科）
机密/14

总部
C.I. Misc. 177/41 刑事侦缉处
1941年9月16日
3

续前：代表南市宪兵队向日本宪兵队总部提供协助

两名被拘留男性的借出：
1) 赵国辉（Tsao Koh Kwei），26岁，浦东。
2) 谢景福（Hia Ching Foh），27岁，江苏。
根据 D.C.（刑事及特务科）的指令，于1941年9月8日延期借出。他们于9月12日被归还至刑事侦缉处总部（C.I.）。

Shankerke No. 801/41号文件（1941年9月11日）要求立即将这两名男性移交给宪兵队，理由是第一名男子作为蓝衣社成员，于1941年7月31日在南市明克路（Ming Keh Road，音译）枪杀了一等兵酒井（Sakai），并且通过他的供述，作案武器已在法租界的一处地址被找回。

第二名男子于1941年4月成为蓝衣社成员，并担任联络员职务。

从这两名男子处取得的供词（副本附后）承认了上述事实。

关于将他们移交给宪兵队的赞成与反对证据摘要已附上。

D. S. I.

pages.en:
Tsao Koh Kwei (曹國貴)
Pootung // D.I. Soong Ping Tsung
C. B. H. Q. 13-9-41 translated C.Y. Chien

My name is Tsao Koh Kwei alias Tsao Hoong Tau (曹洪桃)
age 26, native of Zau Loo Village, Kao Misu, Pootung,
M/U employed, residing at House No. 1 Yue Ka Loong, Nantso.

At the age of 7 I began schooling in various schools
in Shanghai and at the age of 19 graduated from St. Francis
Xaviers College, Renzing Road. I then assisted my father in
his establishment known as the Tsao Sung Tei (曹森記) Lumber
Hong, situated at the Old West Gate, Nantao until the outbreak
of the Sino-Japanese hostilities when I left with my parents
for Pootung where we were engaged in farming.

In February 1941, I received a letter from one of my
classmates named Tsiang Sing Tso (蔣星初) requesting me to
come to Shanghai at 5 p.m. on the 20-2-41 in front of the
"Crystal Palace", Boulevard de Montigny, French Concession.
At the time stated I proceeded to the appointed place where
I met Tsiang in company with his friend. Through the intro-
duction of Tsiang, I hereafter knew his friend as one named
Foong. Both of them talked with me and asked me if I was
willing to join the Military Action Squad. At that time I did
not agree to their request, however I gave them my address
and then returned to Pootung.

In June 1941 I received a further letter from Foong,
requesting me to attend Room No. 28 of the Woo Shing lodging
house, Avenue Edward VII. On receipt of this letter, I went
to the appointed place where I met the man named Foong.
According to what he said, the formation of the Squad was
completed, the rent of houses was also arranged and the work
pages.zh:
曹国贵（Tsao Koh Kwei，此处中文名与上文赵国辉不同，依原文译出，但别名一致）
浦东 // 督察 宋秉忠（Soong Ping Tsung，音译）
刑事侦缉处总部 1941年9月13日 翻译者 C.Y. Chien

我叫曹国贵，别名曹洪桃（Tsao Hoong Tau），年龄26岁，浦东高庙（Kao Misu，音译）枣楼村（Zau Loo Village，音译）人，未婚，受雇，居住于南市岳家弄（Yue Ka Loong，音译）1号。

我7岁时开始在上海各所学校读书，19岁时毕业于仁记路（Renzing Road，音译）的圣方济各沙勿略学院（St. Francis Xaviers College）。随后我在位于南市老西门的父亲开设的曹森记（Tsao Sung Tei）木行协助工作，直到中日战事爆发，我随父母前往浦东，在那里从事农业劳动。

1941年2月，我收到一位名叫蒋星初（Tsiang Sing Tso）的同学的来信，要求我于1941年2月20日下午5点在法租界蒙太尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）“水晶宫”（Crystal Palace）前见面。在指定时间，我前往约定地点，在那里见到了蒋及其朋友。通过蒋的介绍，我此后知道他的朋友名叫冯（Foong，音译）。他们两人都与我交谈，问我是否愿意加入军事行动队。当时我没有同意他们的请求，但我给了他们我的地址，然后返回浦东。

1941年6月，我收到冯的另一封信，要求我前往爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）吴兴旅社（Woo Shing lodging house，音译）28号房间。收到信后，我前往指定地点，见到了名叫冯的人。据他说，行动队的组建已经完成，房屋的租金也已安排妥当，工作

pages.en:
- 2 -

would commence as from July. Soon after he let me to No.1
Yue Ka Loong, Nantao where I resided for several days. I
then returned to Pootung and brought my wife to Shanghai
and lived together in the said house, I received a monthly
pay of $100.00, being paid from Poong.

About 20-7-41 in compliance with the instructions of
Poong, I and my wife went to a room on the 4th floor of the
Great China Hotel, Yu Ya Ching Road. On arrival I was given
a pistol by Poong and told to take it home for safe-keeping
and wait for instructions. I took over the firearm and handed
same to my wife who concealed it on her body. Then we
returned home.

At about 9 a.m. on the 28-7-41, Poong sent a messenger
to my home, ordering me to meet him at about 3 p.m. in the
vicinity of the Crystal Palace Theatre. At the time mentioned
I proceeded to the rendezvous where I met him and was told
to murder any Japanese I met on 31-7-41. To this I consented
then we left the place.

At about 6 p.m. 31-7-41 one named Sih Yoong Fee, a
member of our squad came to my home and gave $5.00 worth of
rice to me as a gift. A moment later I concealed a pistol on
my body and went out together with him until we reached Peeng
Pang Road where we dispersed. On me arriving at Chung Hwa
Road, I saw a Japanese sentry posted to duty in front of the
Japanese Gendarmerie (Nantao Detachment). Having decided to
make this sentinel my victim, I produced my pistol and fired
a shot and then ran away west to east along Ming Tso Ka
pages.zh:
- 2 -

将从7月开始。不久后，他带我去了南市岳家弄1号，我在那里住了几天。随后我返回浦东，将妻子带到上海，并一起住在上述房屋中，我每月从冯那里领取100.00美元的薪水。

大约在1941年7月20日，按照冯的指示，我和妻子去了爱雅清路（Yu Ya Ching Road，音译）大华大酒店（Great China Hotel）四楼的一个房间。到达后，冯给了我一支手枪，让我带回家妥善保管并等待指示。我接过枪支，交给妻子，她将其藏在身上。随后我们回家。

1941年7月28日上午9点左右，冯派了一名信使到我家，命令我在下午3点左右在水晶宫大戏院附近与他见面。在提到的时间，我前往 rendezvous（会面地点）见到了他，并被告知要在1941年7月31日杀害我遇到的任何日本人。我对此表示同意，随后我们离开了那里。

1941年7月31日下午6点左右，我们要行动队的一名成员施永飞（Sih Yoong Fee，音译）来到我家，送给我价值5.00美元的大米作为礼物。片刻之后，我将一支手枪藏在身上，与他一同外出，直到我们到达彭旁路（Peeng Pang Road，音译）才分散。当我到达中华路（Chung Hwa Road）时，我看到一名日本哨兵在日本宪兵队（南市分队）门前执勤。决定以这名哨兵为目标后，我掏出手枪开了一枪，然后沿着明佐卡路（Ming Tso Ka，音译）由西向东逃跑。

pages.en:
- 3 -

After running about 200 yards from the scene of the shooting
I discovered a male Chinese coming towards me and he grappled
with me, hence I fired another shot wounding the male in
question, although I received a slight wound on my right
hand at that time. I continued to run until I reached a
refuse box on Foo Yeu Road near King Tso Ka where I met my
confident named Sih. I told him that I had received slight
wounds to my right hand, and requested him if possible to
get some cotton for me. This was accordingly done and my
wound was dressed. At that juncture I handed my weapon over
to Sih who in turn concealed same under a heap of refuse
nearby. I then made my way home.

At 5 a.m. the following day I left my home and engaged
a room in the Sai Ming lodging house on Rue Kraetzler and
lived there for several days and then I changed to the
Tsoong Chow lodging house, Shantung Road, where I lived for
another seven or eight days. After this I went to locate
Sih in the Sung Yoong Tai Furniture Shop on Rue Misery when
he informed me that the pistol which he had concealed under
a heap of refuse some time before had been recovered by him
and same was in his custody.

On 25th or 26th August 1941 I returned to Pootung
where I lived until September 1st when I came to Shanghai
to locate one named Zia Ching Feh at House 53 Lane 61 Shan-
tung Road from whom I might learn something regarding the
whereabouts of Peong. Zia Ching Feh instructed me to go to
the entrance of the Grand Theatre, Bubbling Well Road at 8 p.m.
pages.zh:
- 3 -

在离射击现场跑了约200码后，我发现一名中国男子向我走来并与我扭打，因此我又开了一枪，击伤了该男子，尽管当时我的右手受了轻伤。我继续奔跑，直到到达靠近金佐卡路（King Tso Ka，音译）的福佑路（Foo Yeu Road）上的一个垃圾箱旁，在那里我遇到了我的心腹施某。我告诉他我右手受了轻伤，并请他如果可能的话为我弄些棉花来。于是照办了，我的伤口得到了包扎。在那时，我将武器交给施某，他随即将其藏在附近的一堆垃圾下。随后我回家。

第二天凌晨5点，我离开家，在克雷茨勒路（Rue Kraetzler，音译）的赛明旅社（Sai Ming lodging house，音译）租了一个房间，在那里住了几天，然后搬到了山东路的周中旅社（Tsoong Chow lodging house，音译），在那里又住了七八天。之后，我去 misery 路（Rue Misery，音译）的松永泰家具店（Sung Yoong Tai Furniture Shop，音译）寻找施某，他告诉我，他之前藏在垃圾堆下的手枪已被他找回，并由他保管。

1941年8月25日或26日，我返回浦东，一直住到9月1日，当时我来到上海，在山东路61弄53号寻找一位名叫谢景福（Zia Ching Feh，音译，即前文之谢景福）的人，希望能从他那里得知冯的下落。谢景福指示我晚上8点去静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）的大光明大戏院（Grand Theatre）门口。

pages.en:
- 4 -

2-)-41 where I mi..t meet him. At the stated time while I
was waiting for Foon,, I was arrested by members of the
Japanese Gendarmerie with assistance of the S.M.P. officers
and conveyed to Crime Branch Headquarters where I was subse-
quently handed over to the Japanese Gendarmerie Nantao
Detachment for enquiries. The statement I have made is the
same as that made to the Gendarmerie.

Signed :
pages.zh:
- 4 -

2-)-41 我在那里与他见面。在约定时间，当我等待 Foon,,（原文不清）时，我被日本宪兵队成员在上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）警官的协助下逮捕，并被带往刑事侦缉处总部，随后我被移交给日本宪兵队南市分队进行讯问。我所作的陈述与向宪兵队所作的陈述相同。

签名：

pages.en:
Zia Ching Foo (謝景福)
Kingsai, Kiangsu, // D.S.I. Lieu Shang Teh
C. B. H. Q. 13-9-41 translated Clerk Y.C. Chang
xxxxxx

My name is Zia Ching Foo, age 27, native of Kingsai,
Kiangsu, S/Clerk employed by Doctor Chien Loong Tsaung, at
House 53, Lane 61, Shantung Road.

From the age of 9 I studied at Sungkiang. When at the
age of 14 I came to Shanghai and attended the Tsung Shiu (正修)
Middle School on Koh Hoo Road, Nantao. When I was 19 years,
I was employed as a clerk to Dr. Chien Loong Tsaung, living
at House 53, Lane 61 Shantung Road.

In April this year, Fung Yoh Poo, a friend of mine,
introduced me to one named Tsang Ding Tsoo alias Fung Chee
Tsung who was a captain of the 4th section of the Blue Shirt
Society.

After an elapse of one week, Fung Yoh Poo together
with Tsang Ding Tsoo came to my home, while the latter requested
me to collect and deliver letters for him, and in the mean-
time he promised to pay me a salary of $30.00 per month. I
agreed with his request.

About 14 letters, addressed to Tsang Ding Tsoo, were
sent to my home each month, and these letters were usually
taken away from my home by two persons, namely, Gah Yoong
Hsiang and Yang Ching Ching, both of whom were Chang Ding
Tsoo's friends. I don't know why I was arrested on the
4-9-41.

This is my true statement.

Signed:
pages.zh:
谢景福 (Zia Ching Foo)
江苏昆山 // 副督察长 刘尚德 (Lieu Shang Teh)
刑事侦缉处总部 1941年9月13日 翻译员 张永昌 (Y.C. Chang)
xxxxxx

本人名为谢景福，27岁，籍贯江苏昆山，受雇于山东路61弄53号钱龙庄 (Chien Loong Tsaung) 医生，担任书记员。

我9岁时在松江求学。14岁时来到上海，就读于南市高胡路 (Koh Hoo Road) 的正修中学。19岁时，我受雇于居住在山东路61弄53号的钱龙庄医生，担任书记员。

今年四月，我的朋友冯耀普 (Fung Yoh Poo) 将我介绍给一名叫曾定佐 (Tsang Ding Tsoo)，别名冯其宗 (Fung Chee Tsung) 的人，他是蓝衣社第四组的组长。

一周后，冯耀普与曾定佐来到我家，后者请求我为他收集和传递信件，同时承诺每月支付我30元薪水。我同意了他的请求。

每月约有14封寄给曾定佐的信件送到我家，这些信件通常由两个人从我家取走，即葛永祥 (Gah Yoong Hsiang) 和杨景情 (Yang Ching Ching)，两人都是曾定佐的朋友。我不知道为何在1941年9月4日被捕。

这是我的真实陈述。

签名：

Further to:-Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie
Headquarters on behalf of Nantao Gendarmerie

At 10.30 a.m. 4-9-41 Sergeant Matsumoto and
three other members of the Japanese Gendarmerie accom-
panied by a prisoner named Yang Ching Ching (楊景情)
whom they had arrested in French town on 2-9-41 in
connection with the case which is the subject of this
file, came to C.B.H.Q. (C.I.) and requested assistance
to visit Lane 61, House 53, Shangtung Road to arrest
one named Zia Ching Foh employed at this address as a
clerk to a Chinese Style doctor named Dr. K. Chen.

Assistance was given by D.I. Pryde, D.S.I.
Lieu Shang Tsah, D.S. Sugimoto, and C.D.C. 57 and the
wanted man arrested at the stated address. The following
are his full particulars:-

Zia Ching Foh(謝景福) 27, Kiangsu, S/Doctor's
clerk, Lane 61, House 53 Shangtung Road.

Four sealed letters addressed to Tsang Ding
Moo(張定之) c/o the accused were seized. On being
opened nothing incriminating was found in them. As
Tsang Ding Moo is detained by the Gendarmerie in conn-
ection with this case, the letters have been handed over.
The arrested man has also been handed over for seven
days against the attached receipt.

（左侧批注及印章：）
S.I.

续：应南市宪兵队之请，协助日本宪兵队总部

1941年9月4日上午10时30分，松本 (Matsumoto) 警曹及其他三名日本宪兵队成员，陪同一名名为杨景情 (楊景情) 的囚犯来到刑事侦缉处总部 (C.I.)。该囚犯系因与本档案所述案件有关，于1941年9月2日在法租界被捕。他们请求协助前往山东路61弄53号，逮捕在该地址受雇于中式医生 K. Chen 医生 (Dr. K. Chen) 担任书记员的一名名为谢景福 (Zia Ching Foh) 的男子。

普赖德 (Pryde) 督察、副督察长刘尚察 (Lieu Shang Tsah)、杉本 (Sugimoto) 副督察以及第57号华籍侦探长提供了协助，并在上述地址逮捕了该通缉犯。其详细资料如下：

谢景福 (Zia Ching Foh)，27岁，江苏人，职业为医生书记员，住址：山东路61弄53号。

查获了四封寄给由被告人转交张定之 (Tsang Ding Moo) 的密封信件。拆开后未发现任何罪证。由于张定之 (Tsang Ding Moo) 因此案被宪兵队拘留，这些信件已移交。被捕男子也已凭所附收据借出七天。

（左侧批注及印章：）

B.L.

C.I.Miss.177/41    Headquarters
                   Crime Branch
                   September 3rd    41

1

<u>Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters</u>
<u>on behalf of Nantao Gendarmerie</u>

At 7.30 p.m. September 2, 1941, Sergeant Sato
of the Gendarmerie Headquarters attended Crime Branch
Headquarters (C.I.) together with Sergeant Tsuzuno
and four others of the Nantao Detachment of Gendarmerie
and requested assistance on behalf of the latter to visit
the vicinity of Bubbling Well and Park Roads between
8 p.m. and 8.30 p.m. even date to try and effect the
arrest of a male implicated in the Murder of a Japanese
Gendarme some weeks previously in Nantao.

The Gendarmerie had in custody Ta Yoong (朱雄)
25, Sungkiang, S/Unemployed, residing Nantao whom they
had arrested on 31-8-41 in Nantao at the Old West Gate.
This person admitted being concerned.

On the 2-9-41, the Gendarmerie arrested one named
Sih (薛) who also admitted being concerned and stated
he was going to meet another confederate at the afore-
mentioned rendezvous. Inasmuch Ta Yoong knew the wanted
man he was brought along to identify him on the road.

Assistance was rendered by D.S. Sameshima, J.I. So
Ping Tsung, C.D.C. 206 and the undersigned.

Sinsa Station and the U.S.M.C. Headquarters were

<u>应南市宪兵队之请，协助日本宪兵队总部</u>

1941年9月2日下午7时30分，宪兵队总部的佐藤 (Sato) 警曹会同宪兵队南市分队的辻野 (Tsuzuno) 警曹及其他四人来到刑事侦缉处总部 (C.I.)，代表后者请求协助，于当晚8时至8时30分期间前往静安寺路与公园路附近区域，试图逮捕一名数周前在南市参与谋杀一名日本宪兵的男性嫌疑人。

宪兵队羁押着朱雄 (Ta Yoong)，25岁，松江人，无业，居住于南市。此人于1941年8月31日在南市老西门被捕。此人承认涉案。

1941年9月2日，宪兵队逮捕了一名姓薛 (Sih) 的男子，他也承认涉案，并称他将前往上述接头地点与另一名同伙会面。由于朱雄认识该通缉犯，故将其带往现场以便在路上指认。

鮫岛 (Sameshima) 副督察、初级督察苏炳宗 (So Ping Tsung)、第206号华籍侦探长及签署人提供了协助。

informed of the intended visit. The latter did not
attend the scene at the request of Police.

At 8.10 p.m. the following person was taken into
custody after being pointed out at Bubbling Well Road
near Park Road :-

Tsoo Koh Kwei (趙國桂) 26, Pootung,
M/Unemployed, residing Pootung.
(C.I. Number 177/41)

Brought to Crime Branch Headquarters (C.I.) he
admitted being a member of a guerilla party in Pootung
and today (2-9-41) he was in Pootung when he received
a message, per another person, from another member named
Loh to meet Loh at B'Well-Park Roads between 8 p.m. and
8.30 p.m. 2-9-41.

He denied being concerned in the Murder as alleged.

He does however bear a recent scar on the back of
his left hand. The Gendarmerie aver this is the result
of a shot fired at him by another Gendarme at the time
of the murder when he made good his escape.

A request was made for his handing over on loan
for the purpose of interrogation. This was agreed to
for a period of one week, against receipt. He is to be
returned on or before September 8th.

3/9/41
（签名）
D. W. R.

此次行动的通知。后者应警方要求未前往现场。

晚上8时10分，在公园路附近的静安寺路上，经指认后，以下人员被拘留：

赵国桂 (Tsoo Koh Kwei)，26岁，浦东人，男，无业，居住于浦东。
(C.I. 编号 177/41)

将其带至刑事侦缉处总部 (C.I.) 后，他承认是浦东某游击队的一员，并于当天（1941年9月2日）在浦东收到另一名成员罗 (Loh) 通过他人传来的消息，要求他于1941年9月2日晚8时至8时30分在静安寺路-公园路路口与罗会面。

他否认涉嫌所谓的谋杀案。

然而，他的左手背有一处新近留下的疤痕。宪兵队声称，这是他在谋杀发生时逃脱时，被另一名宪兵开枪射击所致。

宪兵队请求将其借出以进行讯问。此请求已获同意，借期为一周，凭收据执行。他须于9月8日或之前归还。

1941年9月3日
（签名）
D. W. R.

seizure of a quantity of documents, which are now being

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 12.30 a.m. September 8, 1941 Sub-Lieutenants
Katoda and Ikeda attended Crime Branch Headquarters (C.l.)
and requested simultaneous assistance to visit two
addresses and arrest two males named Lieu and Tsu and
also seize a quantity of ether alleged to be destined
for Chungking.

A party consisting of D.S. Yamakura, D.S.I. Yang
Shih Kwang and C.D.S. 341 and C.D.C. 62 and the under-
signed accompanied by Sub-Lieutenant Katoda and six
other members of the Gendarmerie at 1.20 a.m. 8-9-41
visited House 9 Lane 264 Shanhaikwan Road and, at the
request of the Gendarmerie, arrested

Lieu You Liang (刘孚良) alias Eugene F. Lieu
37, native of Ningpo, Married Owner/Manager of
the National Chemical Supply Co., 44 Wuhu Road.
(C.l. Number 181/41)

A search of the rooms resulted in order forms,
invoices re chemicals supplied to, and received from,
other business firms in Shanghai and also invoices re
goods supplied by accused to his Chungking and Kweiming
offices and agent in Hongkong. These were detained for
perusal.

A party of U.S. Marines attended the scene.

由警佐Yamakura（音译）、副督察杨世光（Yang Shih Kwang）、华籍侦探341号和华籍巡长62号以及签署人组成的队伍，在Katoda（音译）少尉和另外六名宪兵队成员的陪同下，于1941年9月8日凌晨1时20分前往山海关路264弄9号，应宪兵队要求逮捕了：

刘孚良（Lieu You Liang），别名Eugene F. Lieu
37岁，宁波人，已婚，芜湖路44号国家化学供应公司（National Chemical Supply Co.）业主/经理。
（C.l. 档案号 181/41）

对房间的搜查发现了订单、关于向上海其他商业公司提供及从该公司接收化学品的发票，以及关于被告向其重庆和昆明办事处及香港代理人供货的发票。这些文件被扣留以备查阅。

一队美国海军陆战队士兵抵达现场。

Sinja Station was informed of the intended visit.
At visit was also paid to House No.10 in the same

At 1.20 a.m. a second party consisting of Sub-

merie, D.I.s Pryde and Kobayashi and Soong Ping Tsung
and C.D.C. 57 visited the National Chemical Co. 44

2) Tsou Hwa Tsang (牛懷璋) 39, wuhu,

on the premises.
(C.I. Number 182/41)
Copies of a number of cables originating from
Kweiyang, Chungking and Chengtu were seized. These
refer to chemicals and patent medicines supplied in
the past.
A quantity of ether totalling about 4200 to 4300
lbs was found stored in the godown in 15 iron drums
and in 1 lb bottles. This ether was the source of
disquiet on the part of the Gendarmerie who alleged
same was to be transported to Chungking according to
information received by them.
Seventeen ledgers and a quantity of books and
documents were seized for perusal.
In view of no responsible person being left on
the premises, the godown was locked and the keys to
pages.zh:
1/2

新闸捕房已获知此次行动意向。
随后也对该弄堂10号进行了访问，但发现地址有误。
凌晨1时20分，由Ikeda（音译）少尉和另外三名宪兵队成员、督察Pryde（音译）和小林（Kobayashi，音译）以及宋秉宗（Soong Ping Tsung，音译）和华籍巡长57号组成的第二支队伍，前往芜湖路44号国家化学公司（National Chemical Co.），并在该处逮捕了：

2) 牛怀璋（Tsou Hwa Tsang），39岁，芜湖人，
该公司会计，居住于 premises（该址）。
（C.I. 档案号 182/41）

查获了多份发自贵阳、重庆和成都的电报副本。这些电报涉及过去供应的化学品和专利药品。
发现仓库内储存有总量约4200至4300磅的乙醚，装在15个铁桶和1磅装的瓶子中。这批乙醚是引起宪兵队不安的来源，他们根据所获情报声称，这批乙醚将被运往重庆。
十七本账簿和大量书籍及文件被扣押以备查阅。
鉴于现场没有留下负责人，仓库被锁上，钥匙交由

pages.en:
1/3

same kept at C.·.H·.Q. (C.l.).

The first named denies being in anyway concerned
in politics and insists his business is his own which he
runs as wholesale and retail. He denies having sent
ether to outports at any time. The only things he sends
to outports are patent medicines. Three thousand lbs
of the ether have already been ordered and awaiting the
purchaser taking delivery. Account books show 1,103 lbs
on stock.

The second accused has worked for the 1st accused
since he started the business nine years ago.

The 1st accused is also a share holder in the
Universal Dispensary Co. Ltd, Lane 328 House 8 Foochow
Road. On the 2nd and 19th July 1941 he sent medicines
etc to his Chungking office, through this company who
have an export department.

In order to check as to what had been sent, a visit
was paid to the dispensary at 5.45 a.m. where copies of
Customs' declarations were perused and also detained
pending confirmation. Other than medicines, nothing of
a nature alleged by the Gendarmerie was found to
have been sent.

The two males are being detained at C.B.H.Q. (C.l.)
pending further developments.

（签名）
D. S. I.
pages.zh:
1/3

中央总部（C.l.）保管。

第一名被告否认与政治有任何关联，并坚持认为他的生意是他自己的，以批发和零售方式经营。他否认曾将乙醚发往外地口岸。他发往外地口岸的唯一物品是专利药品。三千磅乙醚已被订购，正等待买方提货。账本显示库存为1,103磅。

第二名被告自九年前第一名被告开始经商以来一直为其工作。

第一名被告也是福州路328弄8号万能大药房有限公司（Universal Dispensary Co. Ltd）的股东。1941年7月2日和19日，他通过这家设有出口部的公司向其在重庆的办事处发送了药品等物资。

为了核实发送了什么物品，于凌晨5时45分访问了该药房，查阅了海关申报单副本，并在确认期间予以扣留。除药品外，未发现宪兵队所称性质的其他物品被发送。

两名男子正被拘留在刑事科总部（C.l.），以待事态进一步发展。

（签名）

Ying Yi Ts (应懿慈)
Hangchow // D.I. Soon: Ying Tsung
F.Q.C.B. 2-9-41 translated Z. P. Tsang.

My name is Ying Yi Ts, age 38 years, native of
Hangchow, married and living in room 508, No. 320 Weihaiwei
Road. I am at present employed as an accountant in Henley
Import & Export Co. located at the above address.

Formerly, I worked at the Chekiang Industrial Bank
in Tientsin but left the job in 1938. I came to Shanghai
and remained unemployed until June 1939 when I proceeded
to Kwenming and obtained a job there with the Accountant's
Office of the Jien Hwa Building Contractors. However, during
June 1940 I resigned from this position owing to the high
cost of living and returned to Shanghai.

In the beginning of August 1940, through the
introduction of a friend named Ling Ping Doo, I became employed
as an accountant at Henley Import & Export Co. with a monthly
pay of $200.00 and approximately $100.00 allowance. The owner
of this company is one named Loh Ming Kyn and it deals in
import and export trade of various materials, most of which
are hardware, such as brass-plates etc. The purchasing of the
goods was undertaken by Loh Ming Kyn and an employee named
Dau Ming Shi. Shipping arrangements relating to the goods.
were conducted by another employee named Kyong Ts Tsoong.
As far as I know the goods were not military supplies and
were shipped usually to Hongkong or Rangoon. I cannot say
whether these goods were ultimately transported from there
to Chungking. This company had bought up various materials
to the extent of $1,000,000.00 for the past year or so. After
having worked there for 2 or 3 months I learned that this com-
pany was a subsidiary office of the "Yah Sing" Hong at
pages.zh:
应懿慈（Ying Yi Ts）
杭州 // 督察 Soon: Ying Tsung（音译）
F.Q.C.B. 1941年9月2日 译者 Z. P. Tsang（音译）。

我叫应懿慈，38岁，杭州人，已婚，现居威海卫路320号508室。我目前在上述地址的亨利进出口公司（Henley Import & Export Co.）担任会计。

此前，我在天津的浙江实业银行工作，但于1938年离职。我来到上海，一直失业直到1939年6月前往昆明，并在那里获得了建华建筑承包商（Jien Hwa Building Contractors，音译）会计处的职位。然而，在1940年6月，由于生活费用高昂，我辞去了该职位并返回上海。

1940年8月初，通过一位名叫凌平度（Ling Ping Doo，音译）的朋友介绍，我受雇于亨利进出口公司担任会计，月薪200.00美元，津贴约100.00美元。该公司的老板名叫罗明钦（Loh Ming Kyn，音译），经营各种材料的进出口业务，其中大部分是五金器材，如铜板等。货物的采购由罗明钦（Loh Ming Kyn）和一名叫杜明石（Dau Ming Shi，音译）的员工负责。与货物有关的运输安排由另一名员工孔祖松（Kyong Ts Tsoong，音译）负责。据我所知，这些货物不是军需品，通常运往香港或仰光。我无法说明这些货物最终是否从那里运往重庆。这家公司在过去一年左右的时间里购买了价值1,000,000.00美元的各种材料。在那里工作了2或3个月后，我得知这家公司是位于

pages.en:
Houf o.4, and that the latter firm was connected with the
Purchasing Office of the National Resources Committee of the
Finance Dept., Chungking Government. Apart from the foregoing,
I know nothing else, as I am only the accountant of this
company.

Signed:
pages.zh:
侯家桥4号（Houf o.4，原文不清，疑为侯家桥）的“亚兴”洋行（"Yah Sing" Hong）的分支机构，而后者与重庆政府财政部国家资源委员会采购处有关联。除此之外，我一无所知，因为我只是这家公司的会计。

1

协助日本宪兵队

1941年9月3日晚上11时30分，马诺（Mano）警曹长及另外三名日本宪兵队成员，随同一名于1941年9月7日在虹口被捕的中国囚犯龚子环（Chong Tan Wei），来到刑事处总部（C.B.H.C.），请求协助在两个不同地址逮捕两名男子，即：-

威海卫路320号307及308室，逮捕应葉慈（Ying Nyi Ts）；以及
威海卫路常怡里（Chang Iing Li）265号或265号，逮捕陶令熙（Dau Ling Shi）。

宪兵队称，这两人均为重庆政府军事委员会财务与供应处的成员。

普赖德（Pryde）督察、宋平宗（Seong Ping Tsung）督察、杉本（Sagimoto）副督察以及华籍侦探21号和282号提供了协助。

在第一个地址，逮捕了应葉慈（Ying Nyi Ts），38岁，杭州人，系亨利进出口公司（Henley Import and Export Co.）男会计，该公司位于威海卫路320号307和308室。其中一间房间由该男子用作住所，另一间则用作亨利公司的办公室。

查获了大量档案和文件。粗略查阅显示，该公司从事包括机械和电气

Asstnce to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 3.30 p.m. September 13, 1941, present
Major Nambu of the Gendarmerie requested assistance to
visit the vicinity of Connaught and Yenching roads where,
according to his information, one named Tsang( 张 ), a
member of a terrorist group, would pass.
Assistance was rendered by D.I. Song Ping
Tsung, D.S. Yoshinaga, C.D.C. 206 & 212 and the under-
signed at 4.30 p.m.
Gordon Road Station and U.S.M.C. Headquarters
were informed of the intended visit. The latter did not
attend the scene at the request of police.
After a wait of 10 minutes, the informer
to the Gendarmerie contacted another informer in the
vicinity and learned the wanted man would not pass that
point and that he had gone elsewhere.
The party then withdrew.

G.W. Dowle
D. S. I.

协助日本宪兵队

1941年9月13日下午3时30分，宪兵队南布（Nambu）少校在场，请求协助前往康纳特路（Connaught Road）和燕京路（Yenching Road）附近区域，据其情报，一名名为张（Tsang）（ 张 ）的恐怖组织成员将经过此地。
下午4时30分，宋平宗（Song Ping Tsung）督察、吉永（Yoshinaga）副督察、华籍侦探206号和212号以及签署人提供了协助。
戈登路站和美国海军陆战队总部已获知此次行动意向。后者应警方请求未前往现场。
等待10分钟后，宪兵队的线人在该区域联系了另一名线人，得知通缉犯不会经过该地点，且已前往他处。
随后队伍撤离。

G.W. Dowle
高级副督察

1

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

With reference to the attached translation of
a telegram received from the Gendarmerie in Canton by
the Gendarmerie at Shanghai, at 4.30 p.m. on the 12th
September 1941 Sergeant Takahashi and two other members
of the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters called at C.I.
H.Q.C.B. and requested assistance to visit the Dah Tung
(大東) Book Co., at 310 Foochow Road for the purpose of
locating a manager of this concern. The Gendarmes stated
they wished the manager, if located, to be taken to C.I.
Offices and questioned regarding the shipment, printing
and distribution of books as requested per the telegram
received. The original of the telegram was not produced
by the Gendarmes.

The necessary assistance was rendered by D.S.I.
Cornwell, C.D.S. 230 of the Special Branch, D.S. Sameshima
C.D.C. 21 and the undersigned who together with the Gen-
darmes visited the Dah Tung Book Co. at 4.45 p.m. but the
manager could not be located as he was absent at the time.
At the request of Sergeant Takahashi a message was left
with the shop staff requesting the manager to call at
C.I. offices in the morning of the following day.

协助日本宪兵队

关于附上的由上海宪兵队收到的来自广州宪兵队的电报译文，1941年9月12日下午4时30分，高桥（Takahashi）警曹长及另外两名日本宪兵队总部成员来到刑事处总部刑事分部（C.I. H.Q.C.B.），请求协助前往福州路310号的大东（Dah Tung）书局，目的是寻找该机构的经理。宪兵表示，如果找到经理，希望将其带至刑事处办公室，就收到的电报中要求的书籍运输、印刷和分发情况进行讯问。宪兵未出示电报原件。

特务处的高级副督察康威尔（Cornwell）、华籍侦探230号、副督察鲛岛（Sameshima）、华籍侦探21号以及签署人提供了必要的协助，并与宪兵一同于下午4时45分访问了大东书局，但因经理当时不在，未能找到。应高桥警曹长的要求，给店员留了一封信，请经理于次日上午到刑事处办公室。

（左侧手写批注：S.I / & L / 10 Cl H'）

At 17.40 p.m. on the 13th September 1941 in
response to telegram one named Yang Ching Ling (颜锦麟)
Bookkeeper of the Dah Tung Book Co., came to C.I. Offices
where he was allowed to be questioned by the Gendarmes.

He stated the books referred to in the telegram
were shipped by the Dah Tung Book Co., Shanghai Branch
to the Head Office in Hongkong on the 15-8-41 but he
pleaded no knowledge as to how these books were dealt with
by the Head Office in Hongkong.

Also, at the request of the Gendarmerie samples
of the books shipped to Hongkong were produced by the
Dah Tung Co. for perusal.

Yang Ching Ling was allowed to go free at 3.30
p.m. .

Han Zang Tuh (韓尚德)
Wusih // P.I. Soong Ping Tsung
translated C.Y. Chien
C. B. H. Q. 15-9-41

My name is Han Zang Tuh, age 27, native of Keu Loo
Kyih, Wusih, M/Unemployed, N.F.A. in Shanghai.

At the age of 11 I studied in the Keu Loo Primary
School in my native place for about three years, then I
assisted my parents in the making of incense.

Owing to the high cost of living and financial trouble
then experienced, I, through the introduction of one named
Wong Foo Yoong (黃富雲), Head of the Village, secured
employment as a tax-collector of the Village Guild in
about April 1941, with a monthly pay of $35.00. All the
taxes I have collected were handed over to Wong Foo Yoong
who in turn distributed it to the Keu Loo Kyih Defence
Corps. The said corps consisted of 16 persons, each was
given $35.00 per month. The Village Guild is under the
Division Guild, which in turn is under Hsien Guild, the
Hsien Guild being controlled by the 6th Division of the New
4th Army.

In view of the recent "Extermination of Terrorists
Movement" adopted by the Japanese Military Forces in my
native place, one of my fellow countrymen named Siao Koh
Ping told me in the beginning of August 1941 to come to
Shanghai to avoid being arrested, hence I and Chow Kah Wen
(周克文) left my native place and reached Shanghai on August
26th. On arrival, I took up my abode in the Wong Hoong lodging
house for one day, then in the Dollar Hotel for about seven or
eight days. I also engaged a room in the Yee Kee lodging
house for four or five days; finally I changed to the Sung
pages.zh:
韩尚德（Han Zang Tuh）（韓尚德）
无锡 // 督察 宋平宗
翻译 钱（C.Y. Chien）
刑事处总部 1941年9月15日

我叫韩尚德，27岁，原籍无锡甘露区（Keu Loo Kyih），男，无业，在上海无固定住址。

11岁时，我在家乡的甘露小学学习了约三年，之后协助父母制作香烛。

由于生活成本高企及当时遭遇的经济困难，我通过村长黄富云（Wong Foo Yoong）的介绍，于1941年4月左右获得了一份村公会收税员的工作，月薪35.00元。我所收取的所有税款都交给了黄富云，由他再分配给甘露区自卫团。该自卫团由16人组成，每人每月发放35.00元。村公会隶属于区公会，区公会又隶属于县公会，而县公会由新四军第六师控制。

鉴于日军在我家乡近期采取的“肃清恐怖分子运动”，我的同乡萧国平（Siao Koh Ping）于1941年8月初告诉我来上海以避免被捕，因此我和周克文（Chow Kah Wen）离开家乡，于8月26日抵达上海。到达后，我在万宏旅馆住了一天，然后在美元酒店住了大约七八天。我也在义记旅馆租了一个房间住了四五天；最后我搬到了松

pages.en:
- 2 -

Kiang lodging house, while Chow Kuh Wen lived in the Meng
Yue lodging house.

At about 6 p.m. on the 13-9-41 one named Siao Foo
Sung, brother of Siao Koh Ping, in company with the Japanese
Gendarmerie with assistance of the S.M.P. officers attended
the Sung Kiang lodging house and placed me under arrest.
Siao Foo Sung asked me the whereabouts of Chow Wen Kong
and I told him that Chow had gone out some time previously
and had not returned. Chow Wen Kong is the Chief of the
Jing Man District, Wusih.

This is my true statement.

Signed :
pages.zh:
- 2 -

江旅馆，而周克文住在孟悦旅馆。

1941年9月13日下午6点左右，萧国平的弟弟萧福松（Siao Foo Sung）陪同日本宪兵队，在上海公共租界警务处警官的协助下，来到松江旅馆将我逮捕。萧福松问我周文恭（Chow Wen Kong）的下落，我告诉他周此前已外出，尚未回来。周文恭是无锡静安区（Jing Man District）区长。

这是我的真实陈述。

He also acted as chief Secretary of the Tai Chaung

To : Su g W.i (湯仲毅 )
// C. D. C. 57
translate .
xxxxx.xxx Clerk Y.C. Chang.

Kading
C.B.H.Q. 1-10-41

My name is Tong Su g W.i, age 24, native of Kading.

I was born in Kading. At the age of 6 I began to attend
the Chu g Sing Primary School, located at Loo Dewn , Kading.
At the age of 12 I studied in the Kaling Middle School. When
at the age of 15 I came to Shanghai and lived in the Tien Fah
Hsiang Grocer's Shop, located on Koon Hoo Shing Rd., Chapei,
which was owned by my father. When I was 18 years old, I became
an apprentice in the Association for Domestic Industry, and at
the age of 20 I became employed as a clerk in the wholesale
section of the Association for Domestic Industry.

On 13-8-39 owing to the Sino-Japanese hostilities, the
Association for Domestic Industry was temporarily suspended
and I secured a position as wartime journalist for the Sin Wan
Pao for about one month. Then due to sickness I resigned from
this job. After about one month I recovered from my illness
and became a member of the Comfort and Consulation Committee.
Two months later I returned to work in the Association for
Domestic Industry and in the meantime joined the Yih Yio
Association acting as the vice-president of the Educational
Committee for about two terms.

In May 1940 I resigned my job from the Association for
Domestic Industry and became employed as the go-down chief of
the Shanghai Wood Affairs Company.

In November 1940 I resigned from this job also, when,
through the introduction of one named Tsu Tsoo Chung, a member
of the Association for Domestic Industry, I joined the New
4th Route Army at Zangshou and carried on propaganda
pages.zh:
致：汤仲毅 (Su g W.i)
// C. D. C. 57
翻译。
xxxxx.xxx 书记员 Y.C. Chang。

嘉定
刑事科总部 1941年10月1日

我叫汤仲毅（Tong Su g W.i），24岁，嘉定人。

我出生于嘉定。6岁时，我开始在位于嘉定罗店（Loo Dewn）（音译）的崇信小学就读。12岁时，我在嘉定中学读书。15岁时来到上海，住在闸北昆和兴路（Koon Hoo Shing Rd.）（音译）的天发祥杂货店，该店为我父亲所有。18岁时，我在国货公司当学徒，20岁时受雇于国货公司批发部任职员。

1939年8月13日，由于中日战事，国货公司暂时停业，我在《新闻报》找到一份战时记者的工作，为期约一个月。后因病辞职。约一个月后病愈，我成为慰劳委员会成员。两个月后，我回到国货公司工作，其间加入益友社，担任教育委员会副主席约两届。

1940年5月，我辞去国货公司的工作，受雇于上海木材公司任仓库主管。

1940年11月，我也辞去了这份工作，后经国货公司成员朱佐中（Tsu Tsoo Chung）（音译）介绍，我在张渚（Zangshou）（音译）加入新四军，并在曾州（Zengchow）（音译）星河区（Sing Ho District）（音译）从事宣传

pages.en:
-2-

Activities in the Sing Ho District of Zengchow for about
one month.

In the beginning of January 1941 I became a liason officer
of the Soochow City Government, while at the end of March 1941
I went to Tai Chaung, where I acted as the Chief Secretary of
Tai Chaung City Government for about five months.

In July 1941 the Japanese started to carry on the
extermination of terrorists' movements, the City Government of
Tai Chaung was disbanded. I then came to Shanghai and lived
in the Dormitory of the Association for Domestic Industry on
Hankow Road for nearly one month.

In the beginning of September 1941, one named Yen Juin
Sung, a member of the Association for Domestic Industry, told
me that one of his friends named Siao had requested him to
introduce him to a chemical Engineer for the manufacture of
bombs. He asked me to recommend one for his friend Siao. As
Tsung Pei Yuin, a friend of mine, had an acquaintance (name
unknown) who had graduated from the Chao Tung University and had
received a good education in chemistry, we then agreed to meet
in the Hwei Ping Lur Restaurant, 419 Foochow Road on 14-9-41.

On the appointed date (14-9-41) Siao, Yen Juin Sung
and myself arrived at the Hwei Ping Lur Restaurant one after
another, while Tsung Pei Yuin did not come to this rendezvous.
At 6.10 p.m. the same day, a party of Foreign and Chinese
detectives together with some Japanese wearing plain clothes
visited the Hwei Ping Lur Restaurant and arrested all of us
( Siao, Yen Juin Sung and myself) to the Police.
pages.zh:
-2-

活动约一个月。

1941年1月初，我成为苏州市政府的联络员，而1941年3月底，我前往太仓，在那里担任太仓市政府秘书长约五个月。

1941年7月，日本人开始开展肃清恐怖分子运动，太仓市政府解散。随后我来到上海，在汉口路的国货公司宿舍住了近一个月。

1941年9月初，国货公司成员严润蓀（Yen Juin Sung）告诉我，他的一个姓萧的朋友请求他介绍一位化学工程师制造炸弹。他请我为他的朋友萧某推荐一人。由于我的朋友宗佩元（Tsung Pei Yuin）（音译）认识一位（姓名不详）毕业于交通大学并在化学方面受过良好教育的人，我们便约定于1941年9月14日在福州路419号汇平楼餐厅会面。

在指定日期（1941年9月14日），萧某、严润蓀和我先后到达汇平楼餐厅，而宗佩元未赴约。当天下午6点10分，一队中外侦探连同几名便衣日本人来到汇平楼餐厅，将我们所有人（萧某、严润蓀和我）逮捕至警局。

pages.en:
-3-

On 15-9-41 Ye. Jui Su g and myself were transferred
from the Police to the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters,
Hongkew. On 16-9-41 we were further transferred from Hongkew
to the Japanese Gendarmerie, Soochow for a period of about
six days, then we were subsequently escorted to the Special
Service Section in Soochow for about seven days. On the
29-9-41 both of us (Ye. J. I S u and myself) were returned
to Shanghai from Soochow. This is my true statement.

Signed:
pages.zh:
-3-

1941年9月15日，严润蓀（Ye. Jui Su g）和我从警局被移交给虹口日本宪兵队总部。1941年9月16日，我们从虹口被进一步转送至苏州日本宪兵队，为期约六天，随后又被押送至苏州特务科约七天。1941年9月29日，我们两人（严润蓀和我）从苏州被送回上海。这是我的真实供词。

pages.en:
Yen Juin Sung (嚴筠蓀)
Soochow // C.D.C. 21
C.B.H.Q. 1-10-41 Clerk C.Y. Chien

My name is Yen Juin Sung alias Yen Ts Ying, age 27,
native of Doong Ding Shan, Soochow, M/Accountant employed by
the Association for Domestic Industry, 309 Honan Road and
residing at Lane 341/7 Hankow Road.

I was born in Doong Ding Shan, Hankow. At the age of
7 I began schooling in the place of my nativity up to the
age of 12 when I came to Shanghai and continued my studies in
the Chi Koh Midile School, Chapei. After my graduation from
the aforementioned school at the age 17, I became employed as
an apprentice for about two years in the Yue Lung Silk Shop, on
Nanking Road which was owned by my uncle named Yen Yih Tsing.
As a result of business depression the silk shop was closed.

Through the introduction of my previously mentioned uncle,
I secured employment as a salesman in the General Office of the
Association for Domestic Industry, 309 Honan Road. After working
for about three years I was recommended by one named Lee Sing
Fu (李新甫), manager of the Association for Domestic
Industry and appointed to be the accountant, and this job I
have held for about five years.

In May 1940 I began to study in the China Radio Engineer-
ing School, Avenue Edward VII, after my daily office hours and
I came to know the following three classmates; 1) Wang Jih,
2) Lieu Hsu, and 3) Loh Yie Nyi, who, after finishing their desi-
red course went to engage themselves for military services in
the New 4th Army, stationed in Kompo.

On or about March 1941, the third named Leh Yie Nyi
wrote to Siao Han Wen requesting him to bring experts in radio
pages.zh:
严润蓀 (Yen Juin Sung)
苏州 // C.D.C. 21
刑事科总部 1941年10月1日 书记员 C.Y. Chien

我叫严润蓀，又名严茨英（Yen Ts Ying）（音译），27岁，苏州东定山（Doong Ding Shan）（音译）人，会计师，受雇于河南路309号国货公司，居住在汉口路341弄7号。

我出生于汉口东定山（Doong Ding Shan）。7岁时开始在家乡求学，直至12岁来到上海，继续在闸北稽古中学（Chi Koh Midile School）（音译）读书。17岁从上述学校毕业后，我在南京路我叔叔严亦清（Yen Yih Tsing）（音译）所有的悦隆丝绸店当了约两年学徒。由于生意萧条，丝绸店关闭。

通过前述叔叔的介绍，我在河南路309号国货公司总经理室找到了一份销售员的工作。工作约三年后，经国货公司经理李新甫（Lee Sing Fu）推荐，我被任命为会计师，此职位我已担任约五年。

1940年5月，我开始在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）中国无线电工程学校利用下班时间学习，并结识了以下三位同学：1) 王吉（Wang Jih），2) 刘旭（Lieu Hsu），以及 3) 罗义尼（Loh Yie Nyi），他们在完成所需课程后，前往高邮（Kompo）（音译）的新四军服役。

1941年3月左右，上述第三人罗义尼写信给萧汉文，请求他带无线电专家

pages.en:
-2-

to Kompo. On receipt of this letter, Siao Han Wen came to me
and asked me to look for such experts. On meeting my refusal, he
left my place.

In June 1941, I received a letter from Siao Han Wen in
Soochow asking me to lend him some money so that he could come
to Shanghai. I replied I was unable to do so.

In September 1941, (exact date forgotten), Siao Han Wen
came to me stating that he had just arrived from Soochow and
asked me to make some bombs for him. He also told me that the
bomb which caused the destruction of the Soochow Department
Store on August this year was his own make, but I insisted that I
could not make bombs, hence our conversation ended.

Several days later (about 13th September) Siao Han Wen
again came to me and asked me to pick any of my friends who were
willing to make bombs for him, but I said no. He then requested
me to introduce him to my friends who would teach him how to
make bombs, so that he could make himself. This I agreed to and
I introduced my friend Tong Sung Nyi (1st accused) who in turn
would ask from another one (name unknown to me), hence a rendez-
vous was arranged in the Wei Ping Lur Restaurant, Foochow Road
at 6 p.m. on the September 14th 1941. I went to the place in
due time and met the persons concerned and it was the time when
we were about to take meals that the Japanese Gendarmes with
the assistance of the S.M. Police arrived and placed us under
arrest. A search was made in my house and then brought to the
station where I was handed over to the Japanese Gendarmerie.
On the 16th September we were subsequently escorted to the
pages.zh:
-2-

去高邮。收到这封信后，萧汉文来找我，请我寻找此类专家。见我拒绝，他便离开了我的住处。

1941年6月，我收到萧汉文从苏州寄来的信，向我借钱以便他来上海。我回复说我无法做到。

1941年9月（具体日期遗忘），萧汉文来找我，称他刚从苏州抵达，并请我为他制造一些炸弹。他还告诉我，今年8月造成苏州百货公司毁损的炸弹是他制造的，但我坚持说我不会制造炸弹，因此我们的谈话结束了。

几天后（约9月13日），萧汉文再次来找我，请我挑选任何愿意为他制造炸弹的朋友，但我说不。随后他请求我向他介绍能教他如何制造炸弹的朋友，以便他自己制作。我同意了，并介绍了我的朋友汤仲谊（第一被告），而他则会向另一个人（姓名我不详）询问，因此约定于1941年9月14日下午6点在福州路卫平楼（Wei Ping Lur）餐厅会面。我按时到达该地并与相关人员见面，就在我们要用餐时，日本宪兵在上海公共租界工部局警务处的协助下到达并将我们逮捕。我家被搜查，随后我被带到警局并移交给日本宪兵队。9月16日，我们随后被押送至

pages.en:
-3-
Japanese Gendarmerie in Soochow for enquiries and returned to
Shanghai on the 2 th. The statement I have made is similar to
that made to the Japanese Gendarmerie.

Signed:
pages.zh:
-3-
苏州日本宪兵队进行讯问，并于2日（原文如此，疑为29日或20日之误，照实译出）返回上海。我所作的供词与向日本宪兵队所作的供词相似。

                    September 15th        41

1

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie
Arrest of alleged terrorists

Nagaoka of the Gendarmerie (Western Branch) attended

to visit several addresses to effect the arrest of

（批：S! / &L / 15 9 H）

Assistance rendered by D.S. Sameshima, D.S.I.

where another member was thought to be living. The

总部
C.l.Misc.191/41    刑事科
                    1941年9月15日

1

协助日本宪兵队
逮捕涉嫌恐怖分子

1941年9月14日下午5点30分，宪兵队（西区分队）长冈（Nagaoka）警士来到刑事科总部，请求协助前往数个地址以逮捕涉嫌恐怖分子。

（批注：S! / &L / 15 9 H）

由特务科督察长（D.S.I.）鲛岛（Sameshima）、特务科督察（D.S.）刘尚扎（Lieu Shang Tsah）（音译）、C.D.C. 21及252以及下述人员于下午6点15分提供协助，当时一行人走访了福州路419号汇美楼（Hwei Ping Lur）餐厅，并逮捕了以下三人：-

1. 汤仲谊 (Tong Sung Nyi)，又名汤灿光 (Tong Yue Kwang)
   24岁，嘉定人，男/无业，前河南路309号国货公司职员，居住于汉口路341弄7号。
   (C.l. 编号 185/41)

2. 严润蓀 (Yen Juin Sung) 27岁，苏州人，男/职员
   受雇于河南路309号国货公司，居住于汉口路341弄7号。
   (C.l. 编号 186/41)

3. 萧汉文 (Siao Han Wen)，又名萧生祥 (Siao Sung Chiang)
   23岁，苏州人，女/无业印刷工，居住于上海非指定区域（N.F.A.）。

随后走访了福州路5号636弄振华（Tseng Hwa）旅馆226室，据信另一名成员住在那里。该

（左侧边缘有模糊手写批注及印章痕迹，难以辨认，此处转录不清）

pages.en:
1/2

occupant was absent but one letter and two photographs
of the wanted male were found in the room. These were
detained.

At 6.45 p.m. a visit was paid to the home of
1st and 2nd named, Lane 341/7 Hankow Road where a search
was made in the upstairs room occupied by them. This
resulted in one Ronso set; one case containing tools
and parts for radio; one box containing medicines and
personal articles and one leather box containing diaries
for four years and personal letters being seized. The
latter is the property of the 1st named. The radio
parts and tools are those of 2nd named who has been
taking lessons for 6 months. The other property is that
of the "Association for Domestic Industry" who rent the
room for its employees.

The 1st named left the Association 8 months ago
to become a teacher in Kading but returned to Shanghai
in August because of conditions there and has lived in
the Association's room since then because he is a friend
of 2nd named who has worked there for seven years. Third
named is a friend of 2nd named.

All three deny being concerned in politics or
having taken part in anti-Japanese activities.

Questioning of the three by Sergeant Nagasaka
pages.zh:
1/2

住客不在，但在房间内发现了通缉男子的一封信和两张照片。这些物品被扣留。

下午6点45分，走访了第一和第二被告的住所，即汉口路341弄7号，并对他们居住的楼上房间进行了搜查。结果查获收音机一套；装有无线电工具和零件的手提箱一只；装有药品和个人物品的盒子一个；以及装有四年日记和个人信件的皮箱一个。后者属于第一被告。无线电零件和工具属于第二被告，他已上课六个月。其他财产属于“国货公司”，该公司为其员工租赁此房间。

第一被告八个月前离开国货公司去嘉定当老师，但因当地情况于八月返回上海，此后一直住在国货公司的房间里，因为他是第二被告的朋友，第二被告已在那里工作了七年。第三被告是第二被告的朋友。

三人都否认参与政治或参加反日活动。

长坂（Nagasaka）警士对三人的讯问

pages.en:
1/3

resulted in him being satisfied that the third named
was not concerned and agreed to his release. He was
released at 10 p.m.

A request was made that the 1st and 2nd named
be detained pending further investigation by the Gendar-
merie. This was agreed to. The seizures are being
examined. Meanwhile, there does not appear to be a great
deal of evidence at present to substantiate the allegat-
ions as made.

〔此处有手写签名〕
D. S. I.

15 7/4
pages.zh:
