Zee Zung Ling (徐仁林) alias Zee Zau Tseu (徐治周)
Honan                                          /// D.S.I. Zia Vai Faung
C.B.H.Q.              13-11-41                 translated      Y. C. Chang.
                                               XXXXXXXX

Zee Zung Ling alias Zee Zau Tseu, age 33, Honan, Single
N.F.A. in Shanghai.

I was born in Zung Chow, Honan Province. At the age of
8 years I attended a Primary School, here I studied for four
years. At the age of 12 I became an apprentice in a Silver Shop
located in the city of Zung Chow for one year only, then I
helped my father to work in the farm up to the age of 18 years.

When I was 19 years old, I joined the army at Zung
Chow and became a soldier under General Wu Pei Foo for three
months. The army was then reformed into 47th Division, wherein
I was a soldier under the Commander named Zung Diao Yuen (陳調元).
After a period of one year this army was reformed again into
the 55th Division, which, in the year 1931, was ordered to ad-
vance to Kiangse Province for purpose of harrassing the Communis
troops. On 25-8-37 our Division was ordered to come to Shanghai
and was stationed in the Gee Chong Go-down at Potung. The
Commander of this Division was one named Lee Goong Sui (李松山).

When the Chinese army retreated from Chapei, our
Division was ordered to remove to Nantao, where our Division
together with the Chinese police squad fought a rear-guard
action. About one week later, as the main body of the Chinese
troops had been successfully withdrawn, our Division (more than
1000 troops) were ordered to evacuate to the French Concession
and stationed in the Yah Ts College on Rue Pere Robert, where
our arms and ammunition were then taken from us.

At the end of the year 1939, I was set free due to
sickness. After an elapse of about 2 or 3 days, I met in the
pages.zh:
徐仁林（Zee Zung Ling），又名徐治周（Zee Zau Tseu）
河南                                          /// 副督察长 谢伟芳 (Zia Vai Faung)
罪案科总部              1941年11月13日                 翻译      张Y.C. (Y. C. Chang.)
                                               XXXXXXXX

徐仁林，又名徐治周，33岁，河南人，未婚
在上海无固定职业。

我出生于河南省郑州。8岁时进入一所小学，在此学习了四年。12岁时，我在郑州市的一家银楼当学徒，仅为期一年，之后我便帮助父亲在农场干活，直到18岁。

19岁时，我在郑州参军，在吴佩孚将军麾下当了三个月的士兵。随后该部队改编为第47师，我在名为陈调元（Zung Diao Yuen）的指挥官手下服役。一年后，该部队再次改编为第55师，并于1931年奉命开赴江西省，旨在骚扰共产党军队。1937年8月25日，我师奉命前往上海，驻扎在浦东的吉昌仓库（Gee Chong Go-down）。该师的指挥官名叫李松山（Lee Goong Sui）。

当中国军队从闸北撤退时，我师奉命撤往南市，在那里我师与中国警察小队一起进行了后卫战。大约一周后，随着中国军队主力成功撤离，我师（一千余人）奉命撤入法租界，驻扎在罗伯特神父路（Rue Pere Robert）的雅茨学院（Yah Ts College），我们的武器弹药随即被收缴。

1939年底，我因病获释。过了大约两三天后，我在

pages.en:
- 2 -

vicinity of the Great World Amusement Resort an acquaintance
named Chang Duh Koong, being a native of Honan also. He asked
me what occupation I had. I replied that formerly I was a
soldier but unemployed just then.
He told me that he was a member of a Guerilla Unit in
the vicinity of Quinsan, and his work was to recruit new
members in Shanghai. He asked me whether I was willing to join
them also, and I replied him in the affirmative. During the
moment of our talking, he introduced me to a man(name unknown)
and he also appointed me to interview him at the same place at
12 noon the following day.
At the appointed time and place I met this man who
told me that Chang Duh Koong requested me to proceed to the
Guerilla District in Quinsan at once. I immediately followed
this man to Boon Liang Village (About 30 li east from Quinsan
where I, being registered, became a member of the Guerilla Unit
and then carried on guerilla activities along Quinsan, Taichong,
Kahding and Tsingpoo. There were more than 1000 members in this
Guerilla Unit. In June last year I was promoted to be the
Chief of the 1st Squad of the Guerilla Unit. The expenses for
our Guerilla Unit were gained by the taxes collected from the
people at Quinsan.
On the 3rd of October 1941 I was ordered to go to
Zoeng Ku Village, Tsingpoo, for purpose of negotiating with
both the Self-Defence Corps and the Public Safety Bureau, and
ask them to unite with us. All members of the Self Defence Corps
and Public Safety Bureau agreed with the exception of the Chief
of the P.S. Bureau, who refused to do so. I quarreled with him
pages.zh:
- 2 -

大世界游乐场附近遇到了一位名叫张德公（Chang Duh Koong）的熟人，他也是河南人。他问我从事什么职业。我回答说以前是军人，但目前失业。
他告诉我，他是昆山附近一支游击队的成员，他的工作是在上海招募新成员。他问我是否愿意加入他们，我给予了肯定的答复。在我们交谈期间，他把我介绍给一个男人（姓名不详），并让我第二天中午12点在同一个地方去见这个人。
在约定的时间和地点，我见到了这个人，他告诉我张德公要求我立即前往昆山的游击区。我立刻跟随这个人前往本良村（Boon Liang Village，位于昆山东面约30里），在那里我登记注册，成为游击队的一员，随后在昆山、太仓、嘉定和青浦一带开展游击活动。这支游击队有一千多名成员。去年六月，我被提升为游击队第一分队队长。我们游击队的经费来源于向昆山百姓征收的税款。
1941年10月3日，我奉命前往青浦的张库村（Zoeng Ku Village），目的是与自卫团和公共安全局进行谈判，要求他们与我们联合。自卫团和公共安全局的所有成员都同意了，除了公共安全局局长拒绝这样做。我与他发生了争吵，

pages.en:
- 3 -

and as a result I fought with him. He took hold of my pistol
and fired onesshot which struck my left shoulder.

On 14-10-41 I came to Shanghai and booked Room 414 of
Wo, Koong Hotel, located at 152 Fokien Road, where I lived
trying to heal my bullet wound.

At 1 a.m. on 9-11-41 I was arrested in the said room
and handed over to the Japanese Gendarmerie for enquiries. I
confessed what I had done. This statement is similar to that
I made in the Japanese Gendarmerie.

Signed:
pages.zh:
- 3 -

结果与他打了起来。他夺过我的手枪，开了一枪，击中了我的左肩。

1941年10月14日，我来到上海，入住福建路152号的伍宫酒店（Wo, Koong Hotel）414房间，住在那里治疗枪伤。

1941年11月9日凌晨1点，我在上述房间被捕，并被移交给日本宪兵队进行审讯。我供述了我的所作所为。这份供词与我在日本宪兵队所作的供词相似。

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 12.30 a.m. November , 1941, Sergeant Major
Ikeda attended Crime Branch Headquarters (C.l.) and
requested assistance to visit room 414 of the Woo Kong
Hotel, 152 Hokien Road to effect the arrest of one
Zee Zau Tsu (徐紹周) alleged to be the Vice-Commander
of the 8th branch detachment of the Loyal & Salvation
Army.

An informer Tsu Hang Tsang (周漢章) was able to
identify the wanted male.

Assistance was rendered by D.S. Sugimoto, D.S.I.
Zia Van Faung, C.D.C. 184 and the undersigned at 12.40
a.m. and the room in question visited and the following
male arrested therein :-

Zee Zung Ling (徐仁林) alias Zee Zau Tsu,
35, Honan, Single, N.Y.A. in Shanghai.
(C.l. Number 261/41)

Brought to C.B.H.Q. (C.l.) he admitted being a
Battalion Commander of the 8th branch detachment of
the Loyal & Salvation Army operating in Tsingpoo and
vicinity. About one month before he received a bullet
wound in the left shoulder during an affray with troops
of the Wang Ching Wei Regime. He came to Shanghai to have
the wound attended to.

1) 李东林（Lee Tung Ling），又名刘楼（Lau Leu）。
2) 莫宗清（Mo Tsung Ching），又名莫S（Mo S）。
3) 毛宗中（Mao Tsung Chung），又名毛楚（Mao Chu）。
于1941年11月14日凭收据借给宪兵队，为期一周，用于审讯。

此外，根据D.C.（罪案科和特别处）的指示，孟宪裕（Mang Siew Yoo）（如日志1第4页所述被拘留）也同时被送回宪兵队。

已获取三名被告和孟宪裕的供词（副本附后）。他们否认参与反日活动。

第一被告李王林有四次前科。他最后一次出狱是在1932年8月31日。其他人无前科。

（左侧手写批注：S/ 8- / 1941年11月16日）
（左侧印章：索引编制者 (S.B.) 登记处 日期 1941年11月18日）
（左下角手写：6/17/11 . A/17/11.）
（右下角签名：C.H. Bowler 副助理督察长）

pages.en:
Mang Ah S （〔此处转录不清〕）
Kompo // D.S.I. Lee Shu Fah
C. B. U. . 13-11-41

My name is Mang Ah S alias Mang Sien Poo, 35, Kompo,
residing No.? Jessfield Road.
About three years ago I and eight others jointly
started a firewood business, each paying $500. We meet daily
in the Tung Shing Yuan Teashop on Penang Road for the purpose
of discussing business.
At about 11 a.m. 11/11/41 after having taken some
food in the Wah Sing Kwan Foodshop on Penang Road, west of the
Tung Shing Yuan Teashop, I and two of the partners named
Zung Tung Dee and Fu Siao Tsung (〔此处转录不清〕) left the foodshop
with intent to go to Jetty No.127 on West Soochow Road. As
we three reached the corner of Penang and Moji Roads, suddenly
seven men, six of whom were dressed in short jackets and
trousers and one in long gown, all armed with pistols, came
up to us and forced us to go on a boat moored between Jetties
No.127 and 130. One of the seven men spoke Japanese.
We were ferried directly across the creek to Chapel
and then were made to walk to the Headquarters of the 21st
Detachment of the Japanese Gendarmerie near Sucheng Road Bridge.
Upon arriving there one of the men (name etc unknown but whom
I could identify) who kidnapped us informed me that he formerly
resided on a boat on Soochow Creek but was chased away by the
Japanese following the assassination of a Japanese soldier by
some unknown person who fired from among the boats. He further
accused me of having directed the assassin to the said boats.
When I denied the accusation I was beaten on my face and
buttocks. Finally I admitted.
pages.zh:
Mang Ah S （〔此处转录不清〕）
苦力 // 侦探警长 李树发
中央捕房. 1941年11月13日

我叫 Mang Ah S，别名 Mang Sien Poo，35岁，苦力，
居住在极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）?号。
大约三年前，我和其他八人共同
开始经营柴火生意，每人出资500元。我们每天
在槟榔路（Penang Road）的东兴园茶馆会面，以
讨论业务。
1941年11月11日上午11点左右，在位于
东兴园茶馆西侧槟榔路上的华胜馆食品店（Wah Sing Kwan Foodshop）
用餐后，我和两名合伙人，名为
Zung Tung Dee 和 Fu Siao Tsung（〔此处转录不清〕），离开食品店，
打算前往西苏州路（West Soochow Road）的127号码头。当我们
三人到达槟榔路与莫利哀路（Moji Roads）的拐角处时，突然
有七名男子向我们走来，其中六人身穿短夹克和
长裤，一人身穿长袍，均手持手枪，
强迫我们登上一艘停泊在127号和130号
码头之间的船只。这七人中有一人讲日语。
我们被直接摆渡过河至教堂街（Chapel），
然后被押步行至靠近苏城路桥（Sucheng Road Bridge）的
日本宪兵队第21分队总部。
到达那里后，绑架我们的其中一名男子（姓名等不详，但我
能认出他）告诉我，他以前住在苏州河上的一艘船上，但在
某不明身份者从船群中开枪刺杀一名日本士兵后，
被日本人赶走。他还指控我指引刺客前往上述
船只。当我否认这一指控时，我的脸部和
臀部遭到殴打。最后我承认了。

pages.en:
- 2 -

At about 4 p.m. I and the other two were removed to
Hongkew where I was further beaten and questioned as to whether
I was concerned in the offence and whether three other fire-
wood dealers named Lee Wen Ling (one of my partners in business)
Mao Chu and Mao S were my accomplices. Under force of violence
I had to admit to all these allegations. Whilst there I was
searched by one Chinese and $250 in notes and a wrist watch
were removed from my person. In the same evening I was taken
from Hongkew to S.M.P.Headquarters and the three men mentioned
above were arrested on information supplied by me.

I admitted my part in the assassination and implicated
the others merely to evade further unpleasantness. I was not
concerned in anyway neither, to the best of my knowledge were
any of the other persons arrested.

Signed :-
pages.zh:
- 2 -

下午4点左右，我和另外两人被转移至
虹口（Hongkew），在那里我遭到进一步殴打，并被审问是否
参与了该罪行，以及另外三名名为 Lee Wen Ling（我的商业
合伙人之一）、Mao Chu 和 Mao S 的柴火商是否是我的同伙。
在暴力胁迫下，我不得不承认所有这些指控。在此期间，
一名中国人对我进行了搜身，从我身上拿走了250元
纸币和一块手表。当晚，我被从虹口带至
上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）总部，根据我提供的
情报，逮捕了上述三人。

我承认参与刺杀并牵连他人，仅仅是为了
避免进一步的麻烦。我实际上并未参与，据我所知，
其他被捕人员也未参与。

签名 :-

pages.en:
Lee Wen Ling ( **〔此处转录不清〕** )
Kompo // D.S.I. Lee Shu Fah
C. B. F.Q. 13-11-41

My name is Lee Wen Ling, age 51, Kompo, residing 587
Haiphong Road.
I have been dealing in firewood for the past two
years in partnership with Mang Sien Foo and seven others.
We conduct our business at the Tung Shing Yuan Teashop on
Penang Road.
I have never been concerned in any anti-Japanese
activities nor do I know of any other person being concerned.
I did not witness the incident in which Mang Ah S and
two others were taken away by armed men but heard of it later.

Signed :
pages.zh:
Lee Wen Ling ( **〔此处转录不清〕** )
苦力 // 侦探警长 李树发
中央捕房 F.Q. 1941年11月13日

我叫 Lee Wen Ling，51岁，苦力，居住在
海防路587号。
过去两年里，我一直与 Mang Sien Foo 及其他七人
合伙经营柴火生意。
我们在槟榔路的东兴园茶馆开展业务。
我从未参与任何反日活动，也不知道
有任何其他人参与。
我没有目睹 Mang Ah S 和其他两人被武装人员
带走的事件，但后来听说了此事。

签名 :

pages.en:
Mao Tsung Ching （许沉爱）
// D.S.I. Lee Shu Fah
Kompo
C. B. H. 9.        13-11-41

My name is Mao Tsung Ching alias Mo S, age 35, Kompo.
I and my brother Mac Tsung Chung alias Mao Chu have
been partners in firewood business for the past 19 years,
with an office in Chapel prior to 1937. At present our
office is located at 460 Moji Road.
    At about 8 a.m. 11/11/41 whilst my brother and I were
at Jetty No.127 on West Soochow Road near Penang Road, I
saw seven men arrive in a boat. All of them dressed in short
jackets and trousers. They got out of their boat onto another
boat which was closer to the roadway and waited there. Five
of them were seen to carry pistols in their hands but no
one dared to interfere with them.
    At about 11 a.m. I saw Mang Ah S and two others (name
unknown, but I know them by sight) turn into West Soochow
Road from Penang Road, coming towards Jetty No.127. As soon
as they appeared the seven men who had been waiting on the
boat came on the roadway and took Mang Ah S and the other
two away by force. The three kidnapped persons were taken
across the creek to Chapel on the boat in which the seven
men had come. I thought it a case of kidnapping for ransom
but did not report to the Police considering the matter is
not concerning me.
    In the night of the same day Many Ah S led the Police
and Japanese Gendarmerie to my home and caused me to be
arrested, for reasons unknown to me. I have never been con-
cerned in anti-Japanese activities nor have my brother or any
of the other persons arrested to the best of my knowledge.
                                            Signed :
pages.zh:
Mao Tsung Ching （许沉爱）
// 侦探警长 李树发
苦力
中央捕房 H. 9.        1941年11月13日

我叫 Mao Tsung Ching，别名 Mo S，35岁，苦力。
我和我的兄弟 Mac Tsung Chung，别名 Mao Chu，
在过去19年里一直是柴火生意的合伙人，
1937年之前我们的办事处设在教堂街（Chapel）。目前我们的
办事处位于莫利哀路460号。
    1941年11月11日上午8点左右，当我和兄弟在
靠近槟榔路的西苏州路127号码头时，我
看到七名男子乘船抵达。他们都穿着短夹克和
长裤。他们从自己的船上下到另一艘更靠近
路边的船上，并在那里等待。可以看到其中五人
手中持有手枪，但无人敢干涉他们。
    上午11点左右，我看到 Mang Ah S 和另外两人（姓名
不详，但我面熟）从槟榔路转入西苏州路，朝
127号码头方向走来。他们一出现，一直在船上
等待的七名男子就走上路面，强行将 Mang Ah S 和另外
两人带走。这三名被绑架者被乘坐那七名男子
前来的船只摆渡过河至教堂街（Chapel）。我以为这是一起
绑架勒索案，但考虑到此事与我无关，未向警方报告。
    当天晚上，Mang Ah S 带领警察
和日本宪兵队来到我家，导致我被捕，原因
我不明。据我所知，我从未参与反日活动，
我的兄弟或任何其他被捕人员也未参与。
                                            签名 :

pages.en:
Mao Tsung Ching (前長慶) alias Mao Chu(許 力 )
Kompo // D.S.I. Lee Shu Fah
H.Q.C.B. 13-11-41

Mao Tsung Ching alias Mao Chu, age 39, Kompo, residing
317 Moji Road.
I and my brother Mao Tsung Chung(前現慶) alias Mao S
have been partners in firewood business for the past 19 years,
with an office in Chapei prior to 1937, and at 460 Moji Road
since then.
At about 8 a.m. 11-11-41, when I was at Jetty No. 127 on
Wg Soochow Road near Penang Road together with my brother Mao S,
I saw six or seven persons come in a small boat and get on to
an empty boat moored endwise to the roadway. I did not notice
those men again until about 11 a.m. when I saw them coming out
from Penang Road bringing with them three firewood dealers
named Mang Ah S, Zung Tung Dee and Fu Siao Tsung. This time I
saw five or six of the men carrying pistols in their hands,
and the three persons who were apparently captives, were
each held by two men, one on either side. The whole party got
on to the small boat and went over to Chapei.
At the time the incident occurred I thought it an ordinary
case of kidnapping, but as one named Zung Ching Sai(陳金山),
a partner in business of the three kidnapped persons, was
present during the kidnapping, I did not trouble to report the
case to the Police, presuming that Zung Ching Sai would do so.
In the night of 11-11-41 I was arrested at my home for
reasons unknown to me. I have never been concerned in Anti-
Japanese activities, nor have any of the other persons arrested
to the best of my knowledge.

Signed:
pages.zh:
Mao Tsung Ching (前長慶) 别名 Mao Chu(許 力 )
苦力 // 侦探警长 李树发
中央捕房总部 1941年11月13日

Mao Tsung Ching，别名 Mao Chu，39岁，苦力，居住在
莫利哀路317号。
我和我的兄弟 Mao Tsung Chung(前現慶)，别名 Mao S，
在过去19年里一直是柴火生意的合伙人，
1937年之前我们的办事处设在闸北（Chapei），此后设在
莫利哀路460号。
1941年11月11日上午8点左右，当我和兄弟 Mao S 一起在
靠近槟榔路的西苏州路（原文为 Wg Soochow Road，疑为 West Soochow Road 之误）127号码头时，
我看到六七个人乘小船而来，登上了一艘
横向停靠在路边的空船。直到上午11点左右，我才再次
注意到这些人，当时我看到他们从槟榔路出来，带着
三名名为 Mang Ah S、Zung Tung Dee 和 Fu Siao Tsung 的柴火商。这次我
看到其中五六人手中持有手枪，那三名显然
是俘虏的人，每人身旁各有两名男子挟持。整群人
登上了小船，前往闸北（Chapei）。
事件发生时，我以为这是一起普通的
绑架案，但由于被绑架三人的商业合伙人
名为 Zung Ching Sai(陳金山) 的人在绑架现场，
我便没有费心向警方报告此案， presuming（推测） Zung Ching Sai 会这样做。
1941年11月11日晚，我在家中被捕，原因
我不明。据我所知，我从未参与反日
活动，其他被捕人员也未参与。

签名:

pages.en:
D. C. (Special Branch).

Headquarters
C.l. M nc .259/41    Crime Branch
                      November 12th      41

1

<u>Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie on
behalf of J.V.L.Party re arrest of persons
alleged to have been concerned in attacks
on Japanese Marines.</u>

At 12 midnight November 11, 1941, Sergeant Sasaki
of Gendarmerie Headquarters attended J.R.H.Q. (C.l.)
and requested assistance on behalf of Warrant Officer
Sasaki of the Japanese Naval Landing Party Headquarters
to visit two addresses to effect the arrest of persons
implicated in attacks on Japanese Marines on Stone
Bridge (Chapel) on or about 5th May 1941.

They had in custody one named Wang Sien Foo (王仙福)
whom they had arrested sometime previously in territory
under their control.

Assistance was rendered by D.S.I. Yang Shih Kwang,
D.S. Yoshimaga, C.D.O. 21 and 84 and the undersigned
at 12.20 a.m. 12-11-41. Gordon Road Station and U.S.M.C.
Headquarters were informed of the intended visits. A
party of the latter attended.

The first address the party was led to was, 557A
**〔此处转录不清〕**

（左侧手写批注：S.J / 12.11.41）
（左侧椭圆印章：CRIME BRANCH）
（左下角方框印章：INDEXED BY (S.B.) REGISTRY DATE 18/11/41）
pages.zh:
副督察（特务科）。

总部
C.l. M nc .259/41    刑事科
                      1941年11月12日

1

<u>应日本海军陆战队（J.V.L.Party）要求，
协助日本宪兵队逮捕涉嫌参与
袭击日本海军陆战队的人员。</u>

1941年11月11日午夜12点，宪兵队总部的
佐佐木（Sasaki）警长来到日本租界巡捕房总部（J.R.H.Q.）（中央捕房），
代表日本海军陆战队总部的佐佐木（Sasaki）准尉
请求协助，前往两个地址，以逮捕涉嫌于
1941年5月5日左右在石桥（教堂街/Chapel）袭击
日本海军陆战队的人员。

他们已拘留了一名名为 Wang Sien Foo（王仙福）的人，
此人是他们此前在其控制区域内逮捕的。

由侦探警长杨世光（Yang Shih Kwang）、
侦探员 Yoshimaga、刑事侦缉警官（C.D.O.）21号和84号
以及签署人于1941年11月12日凌晨12点20分
提供了协助。戈登路（Gordon Road）警局和美国海军陆战队（U.S.M.C.）
总部获悉了拟进行的搜查行动。后者
派出了一组人员参加。

该组人员被带往的第一个地址是，557A
**〔此处转录不清〕**

（左侧手写批注：S.J / 1941年11月12日）
（左侧椭圆印章：刑事科）
（左下角方框印章：索引由（特务科）登记处办理，日期 1941年11月18日）

pages.en:
1/2

The party was next led to W460 Moji Road where,
2) Mao Tsung Ching (祁現章) alias Mo S (祁十)
35, Kompo, M/firewood dealer.
(C.l.Number 269/41)
was pointed out and taken into custody.

A visit was then paid to W317 Moji Road where
the brother of second named was located,
3) Mao Tsung Chung (祁長發) alias Mao Chu
(祁九), 39, Kompo, M/firewood dealer.
(C.l.Number 270/41)

Nothing of an incriminating nature was found.

On the three being brought to Crime Branch
Headquarters (C.l.) they denied being concerned in
crimes as alleged but stated the male in custody of
the J.W.L.Party was a friend of theirs and also a
firewood dealer and that at about 11 a.m. 11-11-41, he
and two others named Tsung Tung Dien (陳登弟) and
Siao Tsung (小忠) had been forced to accompany six
male Chinese, five of them armed with military-type
mausers, from Soochow near Penang Road and about 5
yards from the edge of Soochow Creek. The three were
made to get into a small boat and were then conveyed
across the creek to Chapei where they disappeared from
view.

The foregoing episode was witnessed by the 2nd
and 3rd named who however did not recognize any of the
pages.zh:
1/2

随后，该组人员被带往莫利哀路西460号，在那里，
2) Mao Tsung Ching (祁現章)，别名 Mo S (祁十)，
35岁，苦力，男/柴火商。
（中央捕房编号 269/41）
被指认并拘留。

接着前往莫利哀路西317号，
找到了第二个人的兄弟，
3) Mao Tsung Chung (祁長發)，别名 Mao Chu
(祁九)，39岁，苦力，男/柴火商。
（中央捕房编号 270/41）

未发现任何具有定罪性质的物品。

当这三人被带到刑事科
总部（中央捕房）时，他们否认涉嫌
被指控的罪行，但称被日本海军陆战队（J.W.L.Party，原文如此，应为 J.N.L.P.）拘留的男子
是他们的朋友，也是一名柴火商，并且在
1941年11月11日上午11点左右，他和另外两名名为
Tsung Tung Dien (陳登弟) 和 Siao Tsung (小忠) 的人
被迫跟随六名中国男子，其中五人持有军用型
毛瑟枪，从靠近槟榔路的苏州河畔，距离
苏州河边缘约5码处离开。这三人被
强迫登上小船，随后被摆渡过河至闸北（Chapei），
在那里他们消失在视线中。

上述事件由第二和
第三名男子目击，但他们不认识任何

pages.en:
1/3

armed men.

As a result of a report by them to the first
named he called upon two others Tsung Ching San (陳金山
(who was also a witness) and Poo Tai San (卜太山) to
make a report to Gordon Road Station. This however
was not done until about 5.30 p.m. D.S.I. Kynstone
took over investigations and, as a result of a tele-
phonic conversation between him and the undersigned
it became apparent that the male Mang Sien Yoo in
custody of the J.N.L.Party was one of the three persons
who had been taken away and the cause of his enquiries.

To substantiate this, the two males Tsung Ching
San and Poo Tai San were brought to C.B.H.Q. (C.I.) by
D.S.I. Kynstone and they immediately identified the
male in custody of the J.N.L.Party as Mang Sien Yoo.
Tsung Ching San also identified him as one of the
three males taken away at about 11 a.m. in the circum-
stances already described.

As a result of these disclosures it was learned
from Warrant Officer Sasaki that several Chinese
attached to the J.N.L.Party had gone, per boat across
the Soochow Creek, to the vicinity of Soochow-Penang
Roads and had enticed the male in custody and two
others onto the boat whereupon they were taken to the
pages.zh:
1/3

武装人员。

由于他们向第一名男子报告，
第一名男子随即叫来另外两人 Tsung Ching San (陳金山
（也是证人）) 和 Poo Tai San (卜太山) 向戈登路
警局报案。然而，直到下午5点30分左右才
完成报案。侦探警长 Kynstone 接手调查，
鉴于他与签署人之间的电话交谈，
明显看出被日本海军陆战队（J.N.L.Party）拘留的男子
Mang Sien Yoo 就是被带走的三人之一，也是
其查询的原因。

为了证实这一点，侦探警长 Kynstone 将
Tsung Ching San 和 Poo Tai San 两名男子带到
刑事科总部（中央捕房），他们立即指认
被日本海军陆战队（J.N.L.Party）拘留的男子为 Mang Sien Yoo。
Tsung Ching San 还指认他是前述情况下
上午11点左右被带走的三名男子之一。

根据这些披露，从佐佐木（Sasaki）准尉处得知，
几名隶属于日本海军陆战队（J.N.L.Party）的中国人
乘船穿过苏州河，前往苏州路-槟榔路
附近区域，诱使被拘留男子和另外两人
上船，随后将他们带至

pages.en:
1/4

J.N.L. Party Headquarters and placed under arrest on
suspicion of being concerned in attacks on Japanese
Marines on Stone Bridge in Chapei about May 5, 1941.

In view of the unorthodox procedure adopted
in taking persons into custody within Settlement limits
and that a report of kidnapping had been made to
Gordon Road Station, D.C. (Crime & Special Branches )
was communicated with and the facts briefly explained.
He ordered the detention of the three males arrested
as a result of the assistance rendered and also the
detention at C.B.H.Q. (C.I.) of the male in custody
of the J.N.L. party when the matter would be gone into
fully at a later hour.

Warrant Officer Sasaki agreed to this but
stated he would also remain with the prisoner. This
was agreed to pending more later developments.

The incident involving the taking away of the
three males by the party of armed Chinese is the subject
of Gordon Road Misc. 380/41. The males making the
report there are being detained at that station pending
later instructions and developments.

Statements are being taken from the three males
arrested with assistance of S.M. Police.

〔签名〕
D. S. I.

日本海军陆战队（J.N.L. Party）总部，并以涉嫌参与
1941年5月5日左右在闸北石桥袭击
日本海军陆战队的嫌疑将其逮捕。

鉴于在租界范围内采取非正规程序
拘留人员，且已向戈登路警局报告了
绑架案，遂与副督察（刑事科及特务科）
取得联系，并简要说明了事实。他命令拘留
因提供协助而逮捕的三名男子，并将
被日本海军陆战队拘留的男子也拘押在
刑事科总部（中央捕房），以便稍后对此事进行
全面调查。

佐佐木（Sasaki）准尉同意此举，但
表示他也将留在囚犯身边。在等待
后续发展期间，对此表示同意。

关于一群武装中国人带走三名男子的
事件，详见戈登路杂项档案 380/41。
在此案中报案的男子正被拘留在该警局，
等待后续指示和发展。

正在上海公共租界警务处的协助下，
对这三名被捕男子进行笔录。

〔签名〕
侦探警长

Officer in Charge.

Sir,

At 5.30p.m. 11/11/41 the informants namely Tsung
Ching ui ( 陳金ui ), age 45 years, native of Kompo,
M/Firewood merchant residing O.O.L. and Pur Tuh Foo
( 潘德富 ), age 4.. years, native of Kompo, M/Fire-
wood merchant residing O.O.L. visited Gordon Road
Police Station and reported that at about 11.15a.m.
11/11/41 whilst they were selling firewood on Soochow
Road near Penang Road together with three other male
Chinese named
(1) Wang Ah e ( 孟阿四 ), 30, Kompo, Married,
O.O.L.,
(2) Cheng Tun Kyi ( 陳鄧義 ), 33, Chenkiang,
Married, O.O.L.,
(3) Foo Fang Liang ( 傅方良 ), 30, Kompo,
Married, O.O....,

the latter three mentioned individuals were pulled
from Soochow Road by 6 male Chinese 3 of whom were
armed with Mauser pistols onto a boat situated on the
Soochow Creek and conveyed to Chapel a distance of
about 40 yards from the International Settlement.
The informants however raised no alarm and eventually
reported the offence as outlined above.

D.C.I. Smith, D.C. Meuye, C.D.S. 293 and the
undersigned made enquiries at the scene of the crime
but no definite information as to the identity of the
kidnappers could be obtained.

At 7.10p.m. 11/11/41 having obtained assistance
from the W.S.A.S.P. Force C.D.S. 991 and the under-
signed visited the homes of the victims and in the
residence of Cheng Tun Kyi located **〔此处转录不清〕**

关于：线人或日本海军陆战队（J.N.A.）成员的非法活动……
副督察长 Bynstone。
**〔签名：Eroda〕**
主管警官。

先生，

1941年11月11日下午5时30分，线人宗金ui（陳金ui），45岁，高邮籍，男，柴商，居住于O.O.L.，以及潘德富（潘德富），4..岁，高邮籍，男，柴商，居住于O.O.L.，前往戈登路警察局报案称，1941年11月11日上午11时15分左右，当他们与另外三名华籍男子在靠近槟榔路的苏州路上售卖木柴时，这三名男子分别是：
(1) 孟阿四（孟阿四），30岁，高邮籍，已婚，居住于O.O.L.，
(2) 陈邓义（陳鄧義），33岁，镇江籍，已婚，居住于O.O.L.，
(3) 傅方良（傅方良），30岁，高邮籍，已婚，居住于O.O ____ ，

上述后三名男子被6名华籍男子从苏州路上强行拉走，其中3人持有毛瑟手枪，并将他们带至位于苏州河上的一艘船上，随后被运往距公共租界约40码的 Chapel（音译）。然而，报案人并未发出警报，最终按上述情况报告了该罪行。

副督察长 Smith、警探 Meuye、刑事侦缉警员 293号及本人在犯罪现场进行了调查，但未能获得关于绑架者身份的确切信息。

1941年11月11日晚上7时10分，在获得西区特别巡捕队（W.S.A.S.P.）的协助后，刑事侦缉警员 991号及本人走访了受害者的住所，在陈邓义的住所 **〔此处转录不清〕**

named Pur Tuk An (潘德恩), age 4 years, native
of Kompo, a Firewood merchant who alleged that he
observed the three male Chinese kidnap ed and escorted
to the Japanese Naval Landing Party Barrack Kwungfu
Road (光復路), Chapel.

At 9.00 a.m. 1/11/41 D. . Inouye, C.D. . 293,
C.D. . 350 and D. . . Kynstone visited the above
mentioned Barrack and therein interviewed Special
Sergt. Major Hifata who incidently denied that any
members of Chinese informer of the Japanese Naval
Landing Party had arrested three male Chinese named
Mang, Cheng and Foo in Gordon Road district or the
International Settlement.

At 1.30 a.m. 1/11/41 D. .I. Fowler Crime Branch
Headquarters (C. 1) communicated with the undersigned
and stated that he had arrested 3 male Chinese firewood
merchants in Gordon Road district for being concerned
in the shooting of a Japanese sentry on the stone
Bridge, several weeks previous.

It was further learned that the arrests were made
at the request of members of the Japanese Naval Landing
Party attached to the Kwungfu Road barracks, Chapel
and the information was obtained from a prisoner of
the latter.

At 5 a.m. 12/11/41 C.D. . 293, C.D. . 350, D.S.I.
Kynstone accompanied by the three informants visited
Crime Branch Headquarters (C.1) where the latter
identified the male Chinese prisoner in the custody
of members of the Japanese Naval Landing Party attached
pages.zh:

名为潘德恩（潘德恩），4岁，高邮籍，柴商，他声称目睹这三名华籍男子被绑架并护送至光復路（Kwungfu Road）的日本海军陆战队兵营，Chapel（音译）。

1941年11月1日上午9时，D. . Inouye、刑事侦缉警员 293号、刑事侦缉警员 350号及 D. . . Kynstone 访问了上述兵营，并在那里讯问了特务曹长 Hifata，后者顺便否认日本海军陆战队有任何华籍线人或成员在戈登路辖区或公共租界逮捕了名为孟、陈和傅的三名华籍男子。

1941年11月1日凌晨1时30分，刑事调查科总部（C. 1）的副督察长 Fowler 与本人联系，并表示他已在戈登路辖区逮捕了3名华籍柴商，因为他们涉及数周前在石桥枪击一名日本哨兵的案件。

进一步获悉，这些逮捕是应驻扎在 Chapel（音译）光復路兵营的日本海军陆战队成员的要求进行的，相关信息是从后者的一名囚犯处获得的。

1941年11月12日凌晨5时，刑事侦缉警员 293号、刑事侦缉警员 350号、副督察长 Kynstone 在三名线人的陪同下访问了刑事调查科总部（C.1），在那里，线人们指认了被关押的华籍男囚犯，该囚犯由驻扎在

pages.en:
388/41.

to the Kwungfu Road bar acks Chapel as being Meng Ah
e, age 30 years, native of Kempo, M'Firewood merchant
who was kidnapped from the confines of the International
settlement together with two other male Chinese as
mentioned above.

The whole offence appears to have been instigated
by a loafer named Faung Tuh Hoong (方德洪) residing
in Ching hue Lee (錦秀里) off Penang Road who
incidentally is a member and has influence with other
members of No. 76 Jessfield and his ulterior motive
appears to be that of monopolizing S.M.C. landing permits
on the Soochow Creek.

This loafer in question also possesses a S.M.C.
landing permit for the Markham Road Jetty.

D.O.B. informed.

〔此处转录不清〕
D.S.I.

这名无业游民还持有马克姆路码头的工部局登陆许可证。

pages.en:
Won Dzun Yoong (黃子榮)
Ningpo // J.S.I. Lieu Sheng Tsah
23-11-41 translated C.Y. Chien

My name is Wong Dzung Yoong alias Zau Yoong Ching,
age 21, Ningpo, M/U employed, residing at No.7 Mei Foh Li,
Park Road.

As a result of frequenting gambling dens operated in
Nantao since September, I lost all my money and in order to
remedy my financial condition I planned to extort money from
my uncle named Zau Soong Ngoh (曹松鶴), proprietor of Zung
Tai Iron Works at 1356 Penang Road with the following persons;
Woo Ts Ming, Woo Zing An and Ying Heng Sung by pretending
ourselves to be interpreters of the Japanese Gendarmerie.
The three persons mentioned above agreed to my plan.

At about 9 a.m. 2-10-41 I accompanied by Woo Ts Ming, Woo
Zing An and Ying Heng Sung proceeded to the Zung Tai Iron
Works at 1356 Penang Road where I claimed to be an interpreter
of the Japanese Gendarmerie and requested, on behalf of the
former authorities, my uncle Zau Soong Ngoh to raise a sum
of $1,500.00. My uncle however agreed to pay $100 which we
readily accepted.

The sum of money extorted being insufficient for us to
spend, we (Woo Ts Ming, Woo Zing An and Ying Heng Sung) at
about 9 a.m. 3-10-41 proceeded to No.7 Mei Foh Li, Park Road
where we attempted to borrow $10,000.00 from one named Zau
Yeu Kwei (my uncle) by producing a name card on which were
printed characters indicating Zung Kuo Liang, Chief of the
Secret-agent Squad of the Japanese Gendarmerie, but this was
not successful. (We got these name cards printed only for
the purpose of extorting money from others).
pages.zh:
黄子荣（Won Dzun Yoong）
宁波 // J.S.I. 刘生则（Lieu Sheng Tsah，音译）
1941年11月23日 翻译 C.Y. Chien

我叫黄子荣，又名曹荣清（Zau Yoong Ching，音译），21岁，宁波籍，男，无业，居住于公园路梅福里7号。

由于自9月以来频繁光顾南市开设的赌场，我输光了所有钱，为了改善财务状况，我计划与以下人员一起，假装我们是日本宪兵队的翻译，向我叔叔曹松鶴（Zau Soong Ngoh，音译，即曹松鹤）勒索钱财，他是彭亨路1356号中泰铁厂（Zung Tai Iron Works，音译）的老板；上述三人同意了我的计划。

1941年10月2日上午9点左右，我在伍子明（Woo Ts Ming，音译）、伍正安（Woo Zing An，音译）和应恒松（Ying Heng Sung，音译）的陪同下，前往彭亨路1356号的中泰铁厂，我声称自己是日本宪兵队的翻译，并代表当局要求我叔叔曹松鶴筹集1,500.00美元。然而，我叔叔同意支付100美元，我们欣然接受。

由于勒索到的金额不足以供我们花费，我们（伍子明、伍正安和应恒松）于1941年10月3日上午9点左右前往公园路梅福里7号，试图通过出示一张印有表示日本宪兵队特工队队长陈国梁（Zung Kuo Liang，音译）字样的名片，向一名叫曹豫貴（Zau Yeu Kwei，我叔叔）的人借款10,000.00美元，但未成功。（我们印制这些名片仅是为了向他人勒索钱财）。

pages.en:
At about 9.30 a.m. 4-10-41 I in company with Woo Ts Ming,
Woo Zing An and Ying Heng Sung went to the home of my uncle
Zau Ah Yeu at No.38 Tou Pon Li, Avenue Roch and demanded a
loan of $10,000.00 from my uncle by producing the same name
card previously used. My uncle Zau Ah Yeu however promised
to lend us $1,000.00 which sum he would produce at 9 a.m.
on October 8th inside the Great Eastern Tea Room, Wing On Co.
Nanking Road. At the appointed time and place we received
from one Zau Kung Kwei, nephew of Zau Ah Yeu the sum of $1,000.
The money was divided among three of us and I have already
spent my share.

I was arrested at 7.30 a.m. 14-11-41 in Room No.212 of
the Ching Wo Lodging House, 108/11 Chakienp Road.

This is my true statement.

Signed :
pages.zh:
1941年10月4日上午9点30分左右，我与伍子明、伍正安和应恒松一起前往霞飞路头盆里38号（Tou Pon Li，音译）我叔叔曹阿友（Zau Ah Yeu）家，通过出示之前使用过的同一张名片，向我叔叔要求借款10,000.00美元。然而，我叔叔曹阿友答应借给我们1,000.00美元，他将于10月8日上午9点在南京路永安公司大东茶室交出这笔钱。在约定的时间和地点，我们从曹阿友的侄子曹庚贵（Zau Kung Kwei）那里收到了1,000美元。这笔钱在我们三人之间分配，我已经花掉了我的那份。

我于1941年11月14日上午7点30分在乍浦路108/11号清和旅馆212房被捕。

这是我的真实供词。

签名：

A search of this room resulted in the seizure

Gendarmerie Headquarters.

All four accused on being questioned at Crime
Branch Headquarters denied having represented themselves

John Caplin

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 12.10 a.m. on the 15th November 1941, Sub-Lieut.
Katoda and three other members of the Japanese Gendar-
merie Headquarters came to H.Q.C.B. (C.I.) offices and
requested assistance to visit Room 242 New World Hotel,
Yu Ya Ching Road wherein to arrest, if possible, alleged
members of a terrorist organisation namely :-
Lee Tuh Chong (李德昌) and
Mau Foh Foo (马福富).

The necessary assistance was rendered by D.S. Sugi-
moto, C.D.S. 40, D.S.I.s Konovaloff and Zia Vai Faung
and the address noted visited at 12.40 a.m. but the
room in question was found to be unoccupied it was
learned that the occupants of this room left the premises
at 12 m.n.

At the request of the Gendarmerie C.D.S. 40 was,
together with 2 gendarmes, left in the room to maintain
a watch.

U.S.M.Corps and Chengtu Road Station were informed
of this action and a party of the Marines attended the
scene.

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 1 a.m. 14-11-41 Sergeant Sakai accompanied by
other members of the Japanese Gendarmerie came to Crime
Branch Headquarters and requested assistance to visit
Lane 175, House 81 Alabaster Road, for purpose of , if
possible; effecting the arrest of one named Sih(施)
age 30, native of Shanghai, height 5' 4", round face,
medium build, allegedly concerned in the attempted
assassination of one Wong Tsoong Ding (王正廷) in
Nantao in October 1941.

Necessary arrangements having been made with W.
Hongkew Station the desired assistance was rendered by
D.I. Crighton, D.S. Yamahara, D.S.I. Lieu Shang Tsah,
and C.D.S. 40, however on arrival at the Lane in question
it was ascertained that there were four houses bearing
the number 81.

All four were visited and from the occupants of
81G it was ascertained that such a person as described
by the Gendarmerie had previously occupied the upstairs
back room, but on the evening of 12-11-41 had along with

going to Nanking and that in all probability he would
not returned.

A search of the said room proved abortive.

Hyieu Tsau Kwei (徐兆貴)
Kompo                                  ///    C.D.S. 69
                                       translated
C. B. H. Q.       23-11-41             xxxxxxx      Y.C. Chang

My name is Hyieu Tsau Kwei, age 31, native of Kompo,
N.F.A. .

Formerly I dealt in iron barrels and have never been
educated. In December 1940 through the introduction of one
Tsu Kwang Yuan, being a friend of mine, I was assigned to the
national salvation work with a monthly salary of $60.00 . In
the meantime he gave me $20.00 for my expenses during the
Lunar Chinese New Year's days.

In May 1941 Tsu Kwang Yuan gave me $20.00 again, and
instructed me to assassinate a Japanese soldier. This I refused
to do, but later I introduced one Liu Ching Zung to act on
this work.

In July or August 1941 I together with Tsu Kwang Yuan
went to an old woman's (name unknown) home, situated in a lane
on Tibet Road, and received from her two pistols, one of which
I then handed to Liu Ching Zung, while Tsu Kwang Yuan took
hold of the other one. All three of us proceeded to a Kao Sung
Theater, located in the Western District, where we met a
Japanese soldier, however we dared not fire at him. The follow-
ing day, the three of us, on arrival at the same place, met
a Japanese soldier again, but this time we still dared not
shoot at him.

Liu Ching Zung, being unwilling to do this work, left
us and secured a job in No. 62 Jessfield Road, Western Area.

Tsu Kwang Yuan and I had further met Japanese soldiers
in the Western Area on two occasions, but we never dared fire
our pistols. Henceforth we returned the two pistols to the
pages.zh:
徐兆貴 (Hyieu Tsau Kwei)
高邮                                  ///    C.D.S. 69
                                       译本
中央捕房总部       1941年11月23日             xxxxxxx      Y.C. Chang

本人名为徐兆貴，31岁，籍贯高邮，
新法租界。

本人以前经营铁桶生意，从未受过教育。1940年12月，经朋友朱廣元介绍，本人受派从事救国工作，月薪60.00美元。其间，他给了本人20.00美元，作为农历新年期间的开销。

1941年5月，朱廣元又给了本人20.00美元，并指示本人刺杀一名日本士兵。本人拒绝执行，但后来介绍了刘景宗（音译）来执行此项工作。

1941年7月或8月，本人与朱廣元一同前往西藏路某弄堂内一位老妇人（姓名不详）家中，从她那里接收了两支手枪，其中一支随后交给了刘景宗，另一支则由朱廣元持有。我们三人随即前往位于西区的高松大戏院（音译），在那里遇到了一名日本士兵，但我们不敢向他开枪。次日，我们三人再次到达同一地点，又遇到了一名日本士兵，但这次我们仍然不敢向他射击。

刘景宗因不愿从事此项工作，离开了我们，并在西区杰斯菲尔德路62号找到了一份工作。

此后，朱廣元与本人在西区又有两次遇到日本士兵，但我们始终不敢开枪。于是我们将两支手枪归还给了

- 2 -
aforementioned old womnn.
On 18-11-41 I was arrested on Wuting Road.
This statement is similar to that I made in the Japanese
Gendarmerie Headquarters.

Signed:

前述老妇人。

pages.en:
Tsu Kwang Yuan (朱廣元)
Zeechow, Kiangsu // D.S. 69
C.BH.Q. 23-11-41 translated Y.C. Chang

My name is Tsu Kwang Yuan, age 24, native of Zeechow,
Kiangsu Province, and residing 1606 Robison Road.

At the age of 7 years, I attended the Zeechow Commercial
School in my native place. At the age of 14 years, I was an
apprentice in the Yue Phong Dry Goods Shop. When I was 17 years
old, I together with my whole family came to Shanghai, and I
then became a coolie in the Power Company at Chapei.

During the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities in
Shanghai, My whole family and I returned to Zeechow, my native
place, but later at the end of the same year all of my family
came to Shanghai again, dealing in cloth business.

In October 1940 a friend of mine named Koo introduced me
to one named Zung, being the captain, who than assigned me to
do National Salvation work. My monthly salary was $50.00 which
was paid to me by "Zung" every month.

One day in January 1941 I accompanied "Zung" to walk
along the Bund. On arrival at the entrance of the Central
Reserve Bank, "Zung" entered the gate to exchange for money,
and told me to wait for him outside the bank. After a moment
I saw many members of the said bank were rushing out of its
gate, while I immediately left there and returned to my home
on Robison Road.

The following day I read from the News Paper that the
Central Reserve Bank was bombed, and in the meantime "Zung"
told me that this bombing case was carried on by two men named
"Chiang" and "Lieu".

In April 1941 "Zung" introduced me to be acquainted with
pages.zh:
朱廣元 (Tsu Kwang Yuan)
江苏泰州 // D.S. 69
中央捕房总部 1941年11月23日 译本 Y.C. Chang

本人名为朱廣元，24岁，籍贯江苏省泰州，现居住罗宾逊路1606号。

7岁时，本人在家乡就读于泰州商业学校。14岁时，本人在悦丰百货店当学徒。17岁时，本人随全家来到上海，随后在闸北电力公司做苦力。

上海中日战事爆发期间，本人与全家返回家乡泰州，但同年年底，全家人又回到上海，经营布匹生意。

1940年10月，一位姓顾的朋友将本人介绍给一位姓宗的队长，随后指派本人从事救国工作。本人月薪50.00美元，由“宗”每月支付。

1941年1月的一天，本人陪同“宗”在外滩散步。到达中央储备银行门口时，“宗”进入大门兑换货币，并让本人在银行外等候。片刻后，本人看到该银行的许多职员冲出大门，本人随即离开那里，返回罗宾逊路的家中。

次日，本人从报纸上读到中央储备银行被炸的消息，同时“宗”告诉本人，这起爆炸案是由两名分别名为“蒋”和“刘”的人实施的。

1941年4月，“宗”介绍本人认识

pages.en:
- 2 -

both "Chieng" and "Lieu". I then returned Zeechow, my native
place, where I became a hawker dealing in cloth business, but
in July 1941 I came to Shanghai again.

One day in August 1941 "Zung" gave me a hand grenade
and instructed me to throw it at a Chinese in a Motor Car,
at the Great Clock, Robison Road. I then proceed to the said
place, and threw the hand grenade accordingly, which, however,
was not exploded.

At the end of August 1941, Hyleu Tsau Kwei and I, each
armed with a pistol, were dispatched to the mouth of Kiaochow
Road off Robison Road, where we met a Japanese soldier. As
Hyleu Tsau Kwei could not fire his pistol, I dared not shoot
at the said Japanese soldier also. Both of us then returned
the two pistols to the old woman, living at House 11, Ong
Ziang Li, Tibet Road.

Later as I knew that "Zung" had been arrested, I then
became dealing in cloth business again.

On 18-10-41 I was arrested on Wuting Road.

This is my true statement and is similar to that I
made in the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters.

Signed:
pages.zh:
- 2 -

“蒋”和“刘”。随后本人返回家乡泰州，成为了一名贩卖布匹的小贩，但在1941年7月，本人再次来到上海。

1941年8月的一天，“宗”给了本人一枚手榴弹，并指示本人在罗宾逊路大钟处将其扔向一辆汽车里的中国人。本人随即前往该地点，并按指示投掷了手榴弹，但该手榴弹并未爆炸。

1941年8月底，本人与徐兆癸各持一把手枪，被派往罗宾逊路附近的胶州路口，在那里遇到了一名日本士兵。由于徐兆癸无法开枪，本人也不敢向该日本士兵射击。随后，我们两人将两支手枪归还给了居住在西藏路翁张里11号的老妇人。

后来，因得知“宗”已被捕，本人便重新从事布匹生意。

1941年10月18日，本人在武定路被捕。

此为本人真实供词，且与本人在日本宪兵队总部所作供词一致。

协助日本宪兵队

1941年11月11日，日本宪兵队总部司法科的中村军曹口头请求安排下述人员前往上述办公室，就涉及一名日本国民的某案件提供证词。

陵养悟 (Liang Yang Ngo)，居住爱多亚路274号，系万泰公司名下的一家华资油行的业主。

犯罪科科长同意了此请求，1941年11月11日下午4时，署名人与副侦探长杨世光前往上述地址（爱多亚路274号5楼），经查实他确为该行老板，但造访时他不在办公室。因此，告知首席会计师，要求其主人于1941年11月12日上午9时前往犯罪科总部刑事调查处。然而，截至目前，他既未出现在其办公室，也未出现在刑事调查处总部。

调查显示，其住所位于天平路附近的天平里15号，但住户称陵养悟现已离开上海。然而，从可靠来源获得的消息表明，

as he is afraid of detention.

and only require his testimony, which is very important
in connection with a certain Japanese subject under
investigation.

M. V. Obayashi
D. I.

At 1 a.m. on the 28th November 1941, Sergeant Asano
and four other members of the Japanese Gendarmerie
accompanied by their prisoner named Tso Dung Kwei 曹冲锥

terroristic organization. The prisoner was arrested by
the Gendarmerie in Ningpo whilst making his way to
Shanghai from Kiangsu Province and had had to report
his arrival to the wanted man at Shanghai at the address
noted.

The necessary assistance was rendered by D.S.
Ameshima, D.I. Seong Ping Tsung, C.D.C: 206 and the
undersigned and the address given was visited at 1.30 a.m.
No wanted man could be located but his sister and her
husband were, at the request of the Gendarmes, taken
into custody. Their particulars are as follows :

(段当经), age 24, native of Soochow, N/Smith.
(C.I. Prisoner No. 26641)

Soochow.

They stated that the wanted man left Shanghai
in 1936 and since no communication has been received.

The Japanese Gendarmerie, however, made a request

the whereabouts of the wanted man is known to him.

This request was acceded to and the first arrest
was handed over to the Japanese Gendarmerie for a period

Headquarters
C.I. Misc. 267/41 Crime Branch
December 20, 41
1

Assistance to Foreign Section of the Japanese
Gendarmerie Headquarters

At 6 a.m. 20-12-41 Sgt. Major Yamamoto, accompanied
by other officers of the Foreign Section, Japanese
Gendarmerie Headquarters, called at Crime Branch
Headquarters and requested assistance to conduct
thirteen raids at various addresses in the International
Settlement for purpose of effecting the arrest of eight
British subjects, three Americans, one Russian and
two Chinese, all of whom were alleged to be engaged in
anti-Japanese activities.

This request to arrest British and American
subjects was referred to Mr. T. Robertson, D.C. Crime &
Special Branches, who gave instructions to the effect
that assistance to arrest the Chinese be granted, but
that the other be withheld pro-tem, inasmuch as that it
placed the Police in a very embarrassing position, and
that he would take the matter up later.

These instructions were conveyed to Sgt. Major
Yamamoto, who immediately conveyed them by telephone
to his senior officer, Lieut. Ikeda, who after
consulting Colonel Inouye, requested that the matter
be referred to Supt. Smith, Commissioner of Police, for
his decision.

（左侧手写批注：S! / EL / 20.12.41）
（左下角印章：INDEXED BY (S.B.) REGISTRY DATE 21/12/41）

协助日本宪兵队总部外事科

1941年12月20日上午6时，山本（Yamamoto）军曹长在日本宪兵队总部外事科其他官员的陪同下，来到刑事科总部，请求协助在国际租界内的多个地址进行十三次突击搜查，目的是逮捕八名英国臣民、三名美国人、一名俄国人和两名中国人，这些人均被指控从事反日活动。

这项逮捕英美臣民的请求被转交给刑事科及特务科副主管 T. Robertson 先生，他作出指示，同意协助逮捕中国人，但暂时拒绝协助逮捕其他人，因为这会使警方处于非常尴尬的境地，他稍后将处理此事。

这些指示已传达给山本军曹长，他随即通过电话向其上级池田（Ikeda）中尉汇报，池田中尉在与井上（Inouye）大佐协商后，请求将此事项提交警务处处长史密斯（Smith）警司裁决。

（左侧手写批注：S! / EL / 1941年12月20日）

This was communicated to Sgt. Major Yamamoto who
then explained that in requesting this assistance he
had only done so in order to avoid any untoward incident,
but as such assistance had been refused, he would now
conduct the raid on his own accord.

Sgt. Major Yamamoto and his party left the
office at 7.15 a.m. 20-12-41.

During the above negotiations the following
assistances were rendered :-

At 6.25 a.m. December 20, 1941, D.S.I. Fowler,

Sakai of the Foreign Section of the Japanese
Gendarmerie Headquarters visited Lane 299, House 20,
Seymour Road, for purpose of effecting the arrest of
one named Lau (    ).

A search of the premises proved fruitless in
locating the wanted man who had left the house as the

鉴于后一项请求，再次与 Robertson 先生联系，在向他解释前述情况后，他给出了与之前相同的指示，
as toohighsodower（原文不清/乱码），并补充说他已经将原始请求转达给警务处处长，后者也给出了类似的裁决。

此情况已传达给山本军曹长，他随后解释说，他请求协助只是为了避免发生意外事件，但既然协助被拒绝，他现在将自行进行突击搜查。

山本军曹长及其随行人员于1941年12月20日上午7时15分离开办公室。

在上述谈判期间，提供了以下协助：-

从主要租户处获悉，被通缉者曾受雇或正受雇于一家美国公司。

1

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 1.30 p.m. December 19, 1941, Sergeant Major
Ikeda of the Japanese Gendarmerie attended Headquarters
C. I. Office and requested assistance to effect the arrest
of a Chinese wanted by the Japanese Gendarmerie Head-
quarters.

Assistance was rendered by C. D. I. Tabrum and D. S.
Yamahara and three uniformed Japanese officers from
Central Station. At 2.20 p.m. the party proceeded to
201 Tientsin Road, Liang Yien Bank, and therein effected
the arrest of Pan San Sing (潘三新), 46, native of
Shanghai, married, residing at 10 Kinnear Road, the
owner of the said bank.

No reason is given for the arrest by the Japanese
Gendarmerie who state they are acting upon the instruct-
ions of Major Ohtsuka.

At the request of the Japanese Gendarmerie three of
the armed licensed bodyguards of Pan San Sing namely:
1) Yang Tsung Foo, Lic. No. A1421
2) N. E. Voskiesensky, Lic. No. A1450
3) B. Sinchenko, Lic. No. A1599
present at the time of the raid were instructed to hand
over their arms at Headquarters. These arms have been
placed in the Arms Licensing Section for safekeeping
pro-tem.

刑事调查处侦探塔布鲁姆（Tabrum）、侦探警佐山原（Yamahara）以及来自中央巡捕房的三名日制制服警官提供了协助。下午2时20分，一行人前往天津路201号两宜银行，并在该处逮捕了该银行老板潘三新，46岁，上海籍，已婚，居住于金尼尔路10号。

日本宪兵队未说明逮捕理由，仅称其行动系遵照大冢（Ohtsuka）少校的指示。

1) 杨宗福（Yang Tsung Foo），执照号 A1421

3) B. Sinchenko，执照号 A1599
上述武器已暂存于枪械执照科保管。

Further to : Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie
re alleged dubi us transaction re wood oil

As a result of telephoning the home of Chen
Chi Mein (陳啟銳), Lane 56 House 3 Route Prelupt, F.C.
on the afternoon of December 23rd, it was learned he
had returned home on the evening of December 19th and
would attend Crime Branch Headquarters (C.I.) on the
morning of December 24th. This he did.

He related that after being loaned to the
Gendarmerie for a period of three days on the morning
of December 19th he was escorted from C.B.H.Q. (C.I.)
by three members of the Gendarmerie in uniform to the
office of the Chu Hwa Yoke, Room 257 Hamilton House,
where he remained for about two hours and was taken to
a Gendarmerie branch office on North Goodhow Road near
North Fukien Road.

After being a short time there, Wong Kang Dong
himself appeared and negotiated with the Gendarmerie
finally agreeing to supply to the Tang Wei Trading Co.,
a further 300 tins of wood oil or, in the event of this
not being possible, to pay $18,000. Chen Chi Mein was
allowed to go together with Wong Kang Dong after he had
signed a paper guaranteeing the oil or payment on or
before the 26th December.

陈启锐陈述称，约三个月前，通惠（Tung Wei）贸易公司经理张惠宗（Chang Wei Tsong，该公司位于江苏路176号哈密大楼120室）接触了一位名叫王公东（Wong Kung Dong）的人，王是宁波人，虽在上海，但是舟山沈家门一家大型鱼行的老板，张要求他供应

wood oil. A verbal agreement was reached between them,
through the medium of a clerk in the Tung Wei Trading
Co. named Shing who is a relative of Wong Kung Dong.
The exact quantity or quality agreed upon is unknown
to Chen Chi Shein, but he was told by Wong Kung Dong
that a price of $600.00 per 100 catties was agreed-upon
verbally.

About 10th November, Wong Kung Dong delivered to
the Tung Wei Trading Co.; 700 tins of wood oil value
approximately $160,000 per M.V. Tientsin Maru from
Chusan Island.

On the verbal agreement being made, Chang Wei
Tsang gave Wong Kung Dong cash and cheques amounting
to $155,000.00. Of this amount however a cheque for
$25,000 on the Shanghai Commercial & Savings Bank
and signed by Chang Wei Tsang was not cashed due to
there being insufficient funds standing to the credit
of the Tung Wei Trading Company.

Prior to the $155,000 in cash and cheques being
paid to Wong Kung Dong, that person approached Chen
Chi Shein and asked him to guarantee him in the sum of
$50,000. He agreed inasmuch they have known each other
for the past ten years and, at the request of Wong Kung
Dong, signed a paper to the effect that "Chen Chi Shein
pages.zh:
1/2

桐油。双方通过通惠贸易公司一名名叫Shing的职员（系王公东的亲戚）作为中介达成了口头协议。陈启锐不知晓商定的确切数量或质量，但王公东告诉他，口头商定的价格为每百斤600.00美元。

11月10日左右，王公东通过MV“天津丸”号从舟山向通惠贸易公司交付了700桶桐油，价值约160,000美元。

达成口头协议后，张惠宗向王公东支付了现金和支票共计155,000.00美元。然而，其中一张由张惠宗签发、付款行为上海商业储蓄银行、金额为25,000美元的支票，因通惠贸易公司账户存款不足而未能兑现。

在向王公东支付155,000美元现金和支票之前，王公东找到陈启锐，请他为50,000美元提供担保。鉴于两人相识已有十年，陈同意了这一请求，并应王公东的要求签署了一份文件，内容为“陈启锐

pages.en:
1/3

had received $50,000 from the Tung Wei Trading Co."
Wong Kung Dong explained that on delivery of the wood
oil he would obtain the receipt and return it to him.
On the 700 tins of wood oil value approximately
$160,000 being delivered to and receipt signed by the
Tung Wei Trading Company, that company told Wong Kung
Dong that the oil was not of the proper quality and
due to this and the fact of "other losses" (these not
explained) they demanded that Wong Kung Dong pay them
$200,000 in cash as compensation. This he refused to
do and was then told the wood oil was for the Japanese
Navy. He replied that because of the cheque for $25,000
given by them which he was not able to cash, he had only
received $130,000 and had delivered wood oil to the
value of $160,000 there for they owed him $30,000.
They refused to pay him and arguments ensued which
eventually resulted in Wong Kung Dong disappearing and
making attempts to obtain the assistance of some high
Japanese personage who would clear the whole case up.
As a result of Wong Kung Dong disappearing,
Chang Wei Tseng, manager of the Tung Wei Trading Co.
called Chen Chi Hsin to his office on the 10th or 11th
December and asked what was being done. Chen agreed to
do all in his power to clear up the mess and made to
pages.zh:
1/3

已从通惠贸易公司收到50,000美元”。王公东解释说，交付桐油后，他会拿到收据并归还给陈。
当价值约160,000美元的700桶桐油交付并由通惠贸易公司签收后，该公司告诉王公东，这批油质量不合格，鉴于此以及“其他损失”（未作解释）的事实，他们要求王公东支付200,000美元现金作为赔偿。王拒绝这样做，随后被告知这批桐油是供日本海军使用的。他回答说，由于他们给他的那张25,000美元支票无法兑现，他只收到了130,000美元，而他交付了价值160,000美元的桐油，因此他们欠他30,000美元。他们拒绝付款，双方发生争执，最终导致王公东失踪，并试图寻求某位日本高层人物的帮助以澄清整个案件。
由于王公东失踪，通惠贸易公司经理张惠宗（Chang Wei Tseng）于12月10日或11日将陈启新（Chen Chi Hsin，原文如此，应为陈启锐）叫到办公室，询问正在采取什么措施。陈同意尽力清理这一烂摊子，并准备

pages.en:
1/4

leave. He was not allowed to do so before signing a
paper to the effect that "if Wong Kung Dong did not
settle the present case involving him and the Tung
Wei Trading Co. before December 25th, he (Chen) would
pay them the $50,000 he had signed the receipt for".
He was then allowed to go.

At 2.30 p.m. December 18th, a Japanese employed
by the Chu Nwa Yoko, Room 257 Hamilton House, Chang
Wei Tsong and one other Chinese of the Tung Wei Trading
Company went to the office of Chen Chi Shein and demanded
that he go and explain everything to the manager of the
Chu Nwa Yoko and attempted to force him to do so. He
refused, saying his business was only with the Tung Wei
Trading Co. and in any case he had until December 25th
to settle the matter. He eventually persuaded them to
accompany him to Louisa Station where he made a report
which subsequently resulted in his being handed over
to C.B.H.Q. (C.I.)

He is being detained in C.I. Detective Offices
pending further instructions. He denies being concerned
in any way in the transaction re the wood oil other
than signing a receipt for $50,000 which he did to
accommodate his friend Wong Kung Dong.

〔签名〕
D. S. I.
pages.zh:
1/4

离开。但在签署一份文件之前，他不获准离开，该文件内容为“如果王公东在12月25日前不解决涉及他和通惠贸易公司的当前案件，他（陈）将支付他已签收据的那50,000美元”。随后他获准离开。

12月18日下午2时30分，受雇于哈密大楼257室“中和洋行”（Chu Nwa Yoko）的一名日本人、张惠宗以及通惠贸易公司的另一名华人前往陈启锐的办公室，要求他去向“中和洋行”经理解释一切，并试图强迫他这样做。他拒绝了，称他的事务只与通惠贸易公司有关，而且无论如何他都有直到12月25日的时间来解决此事。他最终说服他们陪同他前往老闸捕房（Louisa Station，原文如此，应为Louza），他在那里做了报案，这随后导致他被移交给刑事科总部（C.I.）。

他正被拘留在刑事调查处侦探办公室，等待进一步指示。他否认以任何方式参与桐油交易，除了为迁就朋友王公东而签署了一张50,000美元的收据外。

〔签名〕
D. S. I.

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 10.45 a.m. 17/1/42, Sergeant Major Sano of
the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters came to C.I. Office
C.B.H.Q. and requested an assistance to conduct a search
at No.154 Hwakes Avenue, Bubbling Well Road which had
been occupied by Tsu Ming Tsung (朱鳴春) who was arrest-
ed on 17/12/41 in connection with the case at the same
address.

Necessary assistance rendered by D.S. Sugimoto,
D.S.I. Lieu Shang Tsah, and C.D.C. 211 and the ground
floor front room of the said address was visited. A
search was conducted and the following articles which
had been concealed behind the upper part of the wooden
partition by the prisoner were seized.

1. 8 small wireless code books.
2. 2 photographs.
3. 2 Japanese passes.
4. 1 chop.

On instructions of C.D.I. Tabrum, the abovementioned
seizures were handed over to Sergeant Major Sano.

Bubbling Well Station informed.

K. Sugimoto

1. 8本小型无线电密码本。
2. 2张照片。
3. 2张日本通行证。
4. 1枚印章。

根据塔布鲁姆（Tabrum）首席侦探督察的指示，上述缴获物品已移交给佐野警曹长。

已通知静安寺捕房。

K. 杉本（Sugimoto）

第341号中国侦探警长和三轮岛（Samushima，音译）副督察提供了所需的协助，并与佐野警曹长及另外两名日本宪兵队总部成员一同前往上述地址。

到达后，在楼下后屋发现以下两名中国男子在场：-

(6) 朱鸣春（Tsu Ming Tsang），别名陈兴裕（Zung Shing Yue），28岁，苏州人，男/无业，居住于静安寺路1025/154号，（囚犯编号 370/41）。

对房间的检查发现了与本案有关的几封信件和杂项文件。

经讯问，第6名嫌疑人朱鸣春承认是上海地区蓝衣社行动队队长，而第7名嫌疑人王淳兴是该队的会计，两人随即被拘留。

1941年12月16日下午2时30分，一名名为 Zung Yang Vung (陳楊文 ) 的中国男子，19岁，松江籍，受雇于北京路230号国家商业银行担任初级职员，居住于镇州路22号，来到上海公共租界警务处刑事科/刑事科/分部办公室。

需指出的是，1941年12月16日凌晨12时30分，刑事科/刑事科/分部成员在日本宪兵队总部成员的陪同下曾走访 Zung Yang Vung 的住所，但他当时不在，因此向其家人留信，告知其返回后前往上海公共租界警务处刑事科/刑事科/分部报到。（见日记第6号）

随即与 Katoda 少尉取得联系，他要求将 Zung Yang Vung 借调给他们以供查询。

在获悉上述情况后，Zung Yang Vung 表示愿意前往日本宪兵队总部接受讯问。

他于1941年12月16日下午4时20分被带往日本宪兵队总部。

协助日本宪兵队

1941年12月16日上午6时，接到日本宪兵队总部松本（Matsumoto）警曹长的电话留言，请求立即协助逮捕张风白（Tsang Fong Bah），此人被江国酱（Kong Kuo Shiang，音译）指控为同一组织成员。江国酱，20岁，福建籍，女性，学生，居住在法租界领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）24号。江国酱因身为某反日共产主义团体成员，于1941年12月16日凌晨在法租界被日本宪兵队成员逮捕，对该团体的搜捕即为本卷宗的主题。

中央巡捕房第211号及本报告人提供了协助，由上述女犯带路，包括上述警官以及松本警曹长、浅野（Asano）警士和另外两名日本宪兵队成员组成的小组，前往北四川路与百老汇路（B'well）转角新世界旅馆二楼118室，并将下述人员拘留。

张风白（TSANG FONG BAH），26岁，上海籍，戏剧演员，无固定职业，刚从华北天津抵沪。（C.l. 囚犯编号 367/41）

旅馆房间内未查获任何物品。

1941年12月16日上午9时20分，日本宪兵队总部的松本警曹长连同上述囚犯张风白来到中央巡捕房办公室，请求协助前往南京路大陆商场大楼（Continental Emporium Bldg.）539室，目的是接管存放在该房间（其朋友一位医生的办公室）内的囚犯财物。
中央巡捕房第69号及本报告人于上午9时30分提供了协助。到达该房间后，查明该房间是魏克旦（Wei Kwang Tan，〔此处转录不清〕）的办公室，魏克旦，30岁，嘉定籍（C.l. 囚犯编号 355），于当日凌晨因涉及本案被捕。在负责管理办公室的一名华人助理在场的情况下，从办公室内搬走了一只装有衣物、内衣和私人信件等的皮箱，以及一个装有棉被等囚犯个人物品的布包。
应松本警曹长的要求，这些财物于1941年12月16日上午10时30分移交给日本宪兵队。
中央捕房获悉即将进行的查访。

第7组由斋藤（Saito，特别股）侦探副督察、中央巡捕房第341号、中央巡捕房第252号、佐藤（Sato）警士以及日本宪兵队（J.G.M.Q.）的其他三名成员组成，首先搜查了山海关路248号务实（Voo Zah）小学，并在该宿舍内将下述人员拘留，并查获大量共产主义文献。

冯射影（Vong Su Ying，音译），别名冯射光（Vong Su Kwang，音译），21岁，浙江萧山（Siu Shan）籍，女教师，居住于上述地址。
（C.I. 囚犯编号 364）

该组随后走访了西摩路629/10弄粤东（An Tong）中学，并在此逮捕了

pages.en:
6/6

Lieu Shui Ying (刘碧鳳), 22, Ningpo,
S/Employee of Tien Tsang (天章)
Paper Factory.
(C.I.Prisoner No.363)

and also seized a quantity of letters.

The party next visited Lane 431/9 Chang Yu
Loong (醬油弄) Silka Road and House No.3 Shing Yue Tsung
(新餘邨) Lane 256 Changping Road for the purpose of
arresting two Chinese named Tsau Tuh Yong (趙德芳) and
Tseu Yuen Lai (周元賴) respectively, but no arrest was
made at either place.

----------------------------------------

No.7 party comprising of D.S. Saito (Special
Branch), C.D.S. 341, C.D.C. 252, Sergeant Sato and three
other members of the J.G.M.Q. first raided Voo Zah (務實)
Primary School, No.248 Shanhaikwan Road and in the dor-
mitory of the said school, the undermentioned person was
taken into custody and a large quantity of communistic
literatures were seized.

Vong Su Ying (馮射影) alias Vong Su Kwang
(馮射光), age 21, native of Siu Shan (蕭山)
Chekiang Province, S/Female teacher,
residing above address.
(C.I.Prisoner No.364)

The party next visited An Tong (粵東) Middle
School, Lane 629/10 Seymour Road and therein effected

通缉男犯，一名

陈宝珍（Zung Pao Tsnung，音译），29岁，广州籍，
学校教师，居住于上述地址。
（C.I. 囚犯编号 365）

该组随后走访了福煦路（Avenue Foch）740/24弄，并在此逮捕了通缉人员，一名

华敬堂（Hwa Ching Dong），24岁，上海籍，
无业，居住于上述地址。
（C.I. 囚犯编号 366）

在后两个地址，查获了大量文件和照片。

14名被捕人员连同查获的财物一并移交给日本宪兵队，条件是经审讯后查明无罪者，应交还工部局警务处羁押处理。

Gendarmerie Headquarters visited J.I. Office and requested

Concession in this morning in connection with this case.
Immediate assistance was rendered by C.D.S.40 and
the undersigned visited the National Commercial Bank,
Peking Road where ascertained that the wanted person had
already left the employment to House 3, Lane 280 Myburgh
Road.
The party proceeded immediately to the above
address where the undermentioned male Chinese was iden-
tified by Hu Show Tsang as the wanted person and he was
taken into custody,
Ghui Kong Nyi (瞿公宜), age 22, native
of Chekiang, a/Clerk of the National
Commercial Bank.
(J.I. prisoner No. 360/41)
A search was conducted and a quantity of corres-
ponding letters were seized.
On the instructions of Supt. Mamuya, the arrested
person was handed over to Japanese Gendarmerie together

续报：协助日本宪兵队

1941年12月15日下午4时，日本宪兵队总部的浅野军曹（Sergeant Asano）造访情报处办公室，请求协助逮捕一名名为瞿公宜（Ghui Kong Nyi）的中国男子，据称其与胡茂章（Hu Show Tsang）有关联。胡茂章，22岁，浙江人，已于今晨在法租界因本案被宪兵队逮捕。刑事侦缉处第40号探员（C.D.S.40）及本人立即提供协助，并前往北京路中国国货银行，经查实该通缉人员已离职，现居迈尔西爱路（Myburgh Road）280弄3号。

小队立即前往上述地址，胡茂章指认下列中国男子为通缉对象，遂将其拘捕：

瞿公宜 (Ghui Kong Nyi)，22岁，浙江人，中国国货银行职员。
（情报处囚犯编号 360/41）

按照马姆亚警司（Supt. Mamuya）的指示，被捕者连同证物一并移交

3

Further to : Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 3.50 p.m. on 15-12-41, Sergeant Major Nishi
and two other members of the Japanese Gendarmerie
Headquarters came to C.l. Crime Branch Headquarters,
and requested further assistance to visit Carlton
Theatre, No.21 Park Road to arrest, if possible, one
male Chinese named Woo Shih (吳擇 ), Actor, who is
alleged to be a member of the anti-Japanese organisation.

Assistance was rendered by D.S.I. Lee Shu Fah
and D.S. Yamahara, and the given address visited,
however, upon arrival it was ascertained that the
wanted man Woo Shih was not connected with the Shanghai
Professional Actor's Association (上海職業劇團) which
is displaying a Stage-play at the Carlton Theatre.

No seizure was made.

Sinsa station informed.

D. S.

1941年12月15日下午3时50分，日本宪兵队总部的西军曹长（Sergeant Major Nishi）及另外两名成员来到刑务处犯罪科总部，请求进一步协助，前往派克路（Park Road）21号卡尔登大戏院（Carlton Theatre），尽可能逮捕一名名为吴择（Woo Shih）的中国男子，演员，据称系反日组织成员。

李树发副巡官（D.S.I. Lee Shu Fah）和山原副巡官（D.S. Yamahara）提供了协助，并前往指定地址，但抵达后经查明，通缉人员吴择与正在卡尔登大戏院演出舞台剧的上海职业剧团并无关联。

未缴获任何物品。

新闸分局已获悉。

副巡官

At 11 a.m. 15-12-41, Sergeant Morishita of
the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters attended C. l.
Office and requested an assistance in effecting the
arrest of a Chinese female named Tsaung Sih Juen
(章雪芹) who was alleged to have been connected with
this case.

Necessary assistance was rendered by C.D.C. 89
and the undersigned, House 9, Lane 850, Peking Road
was visited where the undermentioned female was taken
into custody :-

Tsaung Sih Juen (章雪芹), age 15, native of
Ningpo, school girl, residing
850/9 Peking Road.
(C.l. prisoner No. 349/41).

A search was conducted and a quantity of
corresponding letters were seized.

On the instruction of Supt. Nakamura the
arrested person was handed over to Japanese Gendarmerie
together with the seized letters on condition that she
be returned to S.M.P. if found not guilty.

Louza Station informed.

明宏
Stevendine
D. S. 699

刑事侦缉处第89号探员（C.D.C. 89）及本人提供了必要协助，前往北京路850弄9号，将下列女子拘捕：

章雪芹 (Tsaung Sih Juen)，15岁，宁波人，女学生，居住于北京路850/9号。
（刑务处囚犯编号 349/41）。

老闸分局已获悉。

明宏
Stevendine

协助日本宪兵队

1941年12月14日下午3时，日本宪兵队总部的加藤少尉（2nd Sub-Lieut. Katoda）通过电话请求工部局警务处协助，自1941年12月15日上午5时30分起，在公共租界各处逮捕反日组织成员，并要求组织9个小队协助他们。

工部局警务处人员安排如下，并从无线电侦测组（R.A.D.）调出三辆摩托卡车供各小队运输使用。

arrested at Lane 340/5a Yu Ya Ching Road.
(1) Chiang Zung Kung(蔣誠耕), age 22, Shanghai,

上述人员于1941年12月15日上午5时30分至9时之间提供了协助，突击行动结果如下：

第1小队。
在余姚路340弄5a号逮捕。
(1) 蔣誠耕 (Chiang Zung Kung)，22岁，上海人，男职员，受雇于外滩印度商业银行。未缴获物品。（刑务处囚犯编号 318）
在余姚路东方饭店608室。

(3) 徐宗氏 (Zee Tsung Sz)，20岁，太阳（音译，Taiyang）人，上述华人之妻。未缴获物品。（刑务处囚犯编号 320）

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 2.30 p.m. 21-12-41, Sergeant [此处转录不清] of the
Japanese Gendarmerie at ended Crime Branch, Headquarters
(C.I.) and requested assistance to visit one named
Chang Tseu Yung (〔此处转录不清〕), 38, Footung, a proof reader
employed by the Ta Mei Wan Pao Newspaper for past four
years and residing on the premises of the Mercantile
Printing Company, 255 Weihaiwei Road.

Assistance was rendered by J.P. Yamahara and the
undersigned and the above described person located at
255 Weihaiwei Road.
                                (C.I. Number 377/41)

Also located there was

                Miao ZungTseng (缪成昌), 37,
                Kiangying, M/printing press
                engineer employed and residing
                on the premises at 255 Weihaiwei
                Road.
                        (C.I. Number 378/41)

    Both were alleged to have been concerned in anti-
Japanese activities and then handing over was requested.
This was acceded to on the instructions of Officer i/c
C.I. on the understanding they be returned to C.M.H.Q.
(C.I.) if nothing be proved against and in the event of
proof being found, their final disposal be communicated
to the S.M. Police.

1941年12月21日下午2时30分，日本宪兵队的警长 [此处转录不清] 来到总部刑事科（中央捕房），请求协助拜访一名名为 Chang Tseu Yung（〔此处转录不清〕）的人，38岁，福建人，过去四年受雇于《大美晚报》担任校对员，居住在威海卫路255号美商印刷公司 premises 内。

由 J.P. Yamahara 和签署人提供协助，并在威海卫路255号找到了上述人员。
                                （中央捕房编号 377/41）

同时在该处找到的还有

                Miao ZungTseng (缪成昌), 37,
                江阴人，M/印刷厂
                工程师，受雇并居住
                在威海卫路255号的 premises 内。
                        （中央捕房编号 378/41）

    两人均被指控参与反日
活动，随后日方请求移交。根据中央捕房负责人的指示，同意了这一请求，条件是如果查无实据，需将他们交回中央捕房总部（中央捕房）；如果发现证据，则将其最终处置情况通报给上海公共租界工部局警务处。

Between 4 p.m. and 5.30 p.m. further assistance
was rendered to Sergeant Major Nambu and two other
members of the Japanese Gendarmerie by D.S.I.s Konovaloff
Yong Shiu Kwang, D.I.s Sugimoto and Yamahara and two
addresses i.e. 526/1 Chengtu Road to arrest one named
Chang (張) and 27 Tsingtao Road to arrest one named
Yih (葉), were visited but the wanted men could not
be located. They are implicated by the first arrest who
accompanied the Gendarmes on the raids.

At the request of Sergeant Major Nambu a watch
is being maintained at the addresses visited.
-------------------------

At 6 p.m. the wanted man Yih was arrested at
27 Tsingtao Road. He was taken to C.I. Offices and upon
being questioned he gave the following particulars :-

Yih San Pao (葉三寶), 33, native of Pootung,
M/mechanic, employed by the Shun Pao Newspaper
(C.I. Prisoner No.380/41)

He was handed over to the Gendarmerie for
questioning, as requested by them, on the same conditions
as those regarding the handing over of the previous
arrests.
-------------------------

Sinsa Station was informed accordingly.

（签名）
D. S. I.

M/技工, 受雇于《申报》
(中央捕房囚犯编号 380/41)

Further to : Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

Acting on instructions received from Officer i/c
of C. I, the accused one named Zai Yong Shing (谢永祥)
was set free at 2 p.m. on the 5-1-42.

Regarding remaining prisoners namely Sing Yong
Shi and Tau Yee Fah (朱义发) verbal request for handing

12 noon on the 10-1-42 they were handed over to the
Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters against the usual
receipt.

The sum of $400.00 recovered from the person of
the accused will be returned to the complainant.

M. Narayashi

Headquarters
I.I. Sec. 273/41 Crime Branch
January 4, 42

Aid as to : assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

During the period of detention and interrogation
of the three accused in this case, namely :-

1. Si Bong Chin (谢邦芹)
2. Ting Tiang Sai (丁廷仕)
3. Tsu Noc Wah (朱义华)

it has been definitely ascertained that the 2nd and
3rd concerned together with one other male Chinese and
a Japanese named Shindo, were concerned together in
laying CERTAIN false information before the Japanese
Gendarmerie Headquarters and also extorting from the
complainants in this case the sum of $7,000.00.
Of this amount $400.00 was RECOVERED from the
persons of the 2nd and 3rd accused at the time of
their arrests.

Statements have been obtained from the 2nd and
3rd accused and are herewith attached for information.

Regarding the 1st accused it has now been
ascertained that beyond engaging room No. 308 of the
Grand Hotel he was in no way concerned in this crime,
in view of which it is respectfully suggested that he
be released, whilst the other two be handed over to
the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters to be summarily
dealt with.

John Cyples

总部
I.I. Sec. 273/41 刑事科
1942年1月4日

事由：协助日本宪兵队

在本案三名被告拘留和审讯期间，即：-

1. Si Bong Chin (谢邦芹)
2. Ting Tiang Sai (丁廷仕)
3. Tsu Noc Wah (朱义华)

已明确查明，第2和第3名被告与另一名中国男子及一名名叫 Shindo 的日本人共同串通，向日本宪兵队总部提供某些虚假信息，并向本案投诉人勒索7,000.00美元。
其中400.00美元是在逮捕第2和第3名被告时从他们身上搜获的。

已从第2和第3名被告处取得供词，随函附上以供参考。

关于第1名被告，现已查明，除了在大饭店租用308号房间外，他与本罪行毫无关联。鉴于此，谨建议将其释放，而将另外两人移交给日本宪兵队总部予以即决处理。

John Cyples

C.l.Misc.27/41.    Crime Branch
                   _________      41.
B. l

Further to: assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie
            and others.

    At 10.30a.m. on 26-12-41, Foh Tsa Zee (許渣仔)
and Ling Mau Ching (林茂清) were returned to the
custody of the S. M. Police. Sergeant Jno. Okamoto
who escorted the above two persons stated that as little
evidence was resultant from their enquiries been found
against them, their disposal is left to the discretion of
the S. M. Police and thanks to this effect will be
sent in due course.
                                [Signature]
    On the instructions of C.D.I.Tehrum, officer i/c C.l.
Foh Tsa Zee and Ling Mau Ching were allowed to go at 2p.m.
on 26-12-41.

    At 3p.m. the same day, information was obtained by
Supt. Nakamura to the effect that a party of self-styled
Japanese Gendarme is visiting Room 308 of Grand Hotel,
No.120 Yu Ya Ching Road for the purpose of extorting the
families of Foh Tsa Zee and Ling Mau Ching in connection
with their arrest.

    Acting on this information, at 3.30p.m. the same day,
a party of detectives consisting of D.I. Kobayashi, D.S.
Yamahara and C.D.C.83, after obtaining assistance of
D.S.I.Rhodes, C.D.S.8 and C.D.C.72 of Louza Stat'
proceeded to the given address where took '
undermentioned 4 persons:-

副总监 (特别科)

C.l.Misc.27/41.    刑事科
                   _________      41.
B. l

续：协助日本宪兵队
            及其他方面。

    1941年12月26日上午10时30分，许渣仔 (Foh Tsa Zee)
和林茂清 (Ling Mau Ching) 被交还至上海公共租界工部局警务处羁押。护送上述两人的警长 Jno. Okamoto 表示，由于调查后未发现针对他们的确凿证据，对他们的处置留待上海公共租界工部局警务处酌情决定，并将适时发送致谢函。
                                [签名]
    根据 Tehrum 首席侦探督察的指示，中央捕房负责人允许许渣仔和林茂清于1941年12月26日下午2时离开。

    同日下午3时，中村警司获得情报，称一群自称日本宪兵的人正在访问亚尔培路120号大饭店308室，目的是就许渣仔和林茂清被捕一事向其家属进行勒索。

    根据这一情报，同日下午3时30分，由小林督察、山原巡官和中央捕房侦探83号组成的侦探小组，在获得老闸捕房的 Rhodes 副督察长、中央捕房侦探8号和中央捕房侦探72号的协助后，前往指定地址，在那里抓获了下列4人：-

pages.en:
2/2

1. Zia Yong Chin (謝芳芬), alias Zia Foo (謝印),
age 28, native of Shanghai, M/building contractor,
residing at Lane 526 House 4 Taku Road,

2. Sing Ziang Zei (辛祥培), alias Tsen Ziang Zei
(張祥培), age 30, native of Footung, M/building
contractor, residing at Lane 31 House 1 Tientsing Rd.,

3. Tsu Nee Fah (朱舞發), alias Cheu Nee Fa (周舞發),
age 39, native of Ningpo, M/unemployed, residing at 350
Tong Shing Li, Rue Vincent Mathieu, F.C.

4. Takao Hironaka (高中隆丸), age 36, Japanese merchant,
residing at No. 102 Tienlong Road.

When questioned by Detectives, the 1st, 2nd and 3rd
named Chinese admitted being concerned, in some way or
other, in the alleged extortion and their statement will
be taken, while 4th named Japanese was found to be a mere
visitor and have nothing to do with this case, so he was
allowed to go at 4.30 p.m. on 26-12-41.

On the instructions of Supt. Nakamura, the three male
Chinese are detained in the Central Station Cell pending
further enquiries.

M. Kobayashi.
D. I.

根据中村警司的指示，这三名中国男子被拘押在中央捕房拘留所，以待进一步调查。

M. Kobayashi.
督察 (D. I.)

Further to : resistance to Japanese military
At 9.30 a.m. 24-12-41, officers accompanied
by other members of the Japanese Military Police Headquarters
called at Prime Branch Headquarters and requested further
assistance to visit the office of W. H. Lin at the Astoria Hotel
for purpose of arresting one named Ling Mou Ching (林懋勤)
whom it was alleged was on friendly terms with the
wanted man Lee Shu Yung, said to be a guerrilla leader
in the New Territories Area.

The desired assistance was rendered by D.I. Brighton
and Detective Constable Mashima, S.N. 290 and on visiting Room 620 of
the Astoria Hotel one named,

1. Foo Tsa Tao (傅醉僊), 50, Nanchow,
Merchant, residing Lane 423, House 20
Rue du Consulate, French Concession.
(C.I. Number 390/41)

was arrested.

This man on being questioned admitted that he
had called at this address for purpose of interviewing
Ling Mou Ching, but that on his arrival there at 9 a.m.
he found the latter absent.

Sergeant Major Mmbu at this stage requested
that detectives be left in this room alone with the
arrested man, whilst a second raid was being carried

1941年12月24日上午9时30分，军官在日本军事警察总部其他成员的陪同下，来到主要部门总部，请求进一步协助，前往阿斯托里亚酒店 W. H. Lin 的办公室，目的是逮捕一名名为林懋勤 (Ling Mou Ching) 的人，据称此人与通缉犯李树荣 (Lee Shu Yung) 关系友好，后者据说是新界地区的游击队首领。

布莱顿督察 (D.I. Brighton) 和警员 Mashima (编号 290) 提供了所需的协助，在访问阿斯托里亚酒店620室时，逮捕了一名名为：

1. 傅醉僊 (Foo Tsa Tao), 50岁, 南浔人,
商人, 居住于法租界领事馆路423弄20号。
(中央捕房编号 390/41)

此人受讯时承认，他曾前往该地址旨在采访林懋勤，但当他上午9点到达那里时，发现后者不在。

此时，南布少佐 (Sergeant Major Mmbu) 要求侦探单独留在房间内看守被捕者，同时进行第二次突击搜查

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH DEC 3 1941）
（批：Pay 24/a）

(中央捕房编号 392/41)

南布少佐解释说，鉴于上述三人都承认认识李昂荣 (Lee Ong Yung)，他别无选择，只能请求拘留他们以进行调查。

Headquarters
J.1.Misc.273/41 Crime Branch
December 22nd 41

1

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 10.30 a.m. 22-12-41 Sergeant Manguma of the
Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters called at Crime Branch
Headquarters and requested assistance to visit Room 610
of the Dollar Building, Canton Road, for purpose of
effecting the arrest of two persons namely Lee Ong Vung
and Ching, both of whom are alleged to be members of a
Chinese guerilla unit operating in the Yenchow Area.
The desired assistance was rendered by D.I.Crighton
D.I. Kobayashi, and C.D.Cs 84 and 89, however on
arrival at the address in question, the wanted persons
were found to be absent, also a search revealed nothing
of an incriminating nature.

In view of this Sergeant Manguma further requested
first, that detectives be posted at this address to
await the return of these men and secondly to conduct
two further raids at the undermentioned addresses wherein
these persons might be located :-

1. Room No.39, Y.P.S. Hotel, Yu Ya Ching Road.
2. Room No.611 of the Pacific Hotel, B'well Road.

Both requests were acceded to, however on the
addresses in question being visited it was ascertained
that the wanted persons had vacated the rooms some time
ago.

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH POLICE）
（批：22/12）
（批：RY 22/12）

1941年12月22日

1

协助日本宪兵队

1941年12月22日上午10时30分，日本宪兵队总部的 Manguma 警长来到刑事科总部，请求协助前往广东路元利大楼610室，目的是逮捕两人，即李昂荣 (Lee Ong Vung) 和郑某 (Ching)，据称两人都是在温州地区活动的中国游击队成员。
克里顿督察 (D.I.Crighton)、小林督察 (D.I. Kobayashi) 以及中央捕房侦探84号和89号提供了所需的协助，然而，当到达相关地址时，发现通缉犯不在，搜查也未发现任何具有定罪性质的物品。

鉴于此，Manguma 警长进一步提出两项请求：第一，在该地址部署侦探等待这些人回来；第二，对下列两个可能藏有这些人的地址进行另外两次突击搜查：-

1. 亚尔培路益平山酒店39号房间。
2. 北四川路太平洋酒店611号房间。

两项请求均获准许，然而，在走访相关地址后，查明通缉犯已在不久前搬离这些房间。

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH POLICE）
（批：22/12）
（批：RY 22/12）

续前：应日本海军陆战队请求借出已定罪囚犯以协助调查

应日本海军陆战队之请求，经副督察长（刑事科及特务科）批准，延长借出囚犯王拱保（Wong Kung Pao），以便该队完成调查。

该犯于1941年11月8日下午1时被送回刑事科总部（中央捕房），并羁押于中央捕房拘留所，直至11月10日，当日将其解回提篮桥监狱。

据悉，日本当局已满意地完成对王拱保涉嫌案件的调查，并处以罚款。

（印：1941年11月10日 / 刑事及特务科）

（批注：5' / 8L / 10" H）

〔签名〕
D. S. I.

Headquarters
Crime Branch
September 15th    41
2

Assistance to Japanese Naval Landing Party

Reference attached report submitted by Supt.
Nakamura, the prisoner Wong Kung Poo (王根宝) was removed
from Ward Road Gaol on the 15-9-41 and handed over on
loan to the Japanese Naval Court Martial, for a period
of ten days, against the usual receipt.

Regarding the 2nd prisoner Tau Foong Kyi (陶鳳岐)
this man is at present charged with Armed Robbery and
will appear before the S.S.D. Court on the 16-9-41 when
he may be sentenced to a term of imprisonment. If such
be the case he will be removed from gaol in due course
and loaned to the Japanese Authorities.

John Caples

1941年9月15日
2

协助日本海军陆战队

参照附呈的中村警司提交的报告，囚犯王根宝（Wong Kung Poo）于1941年9月15日从提篮桥监狱提出，并按惯例出具收据，借给日本海军军事法庭，为期十天。

关于第二名囚犯陶鳳岐（Tau Foong Kyi），此人目前被控持械抢劫，将于1941年9月16日出庭受审于特别市政法庭（S.S.D. Court），届时可能被判处监禁。若情况属实，他将在适当时候从监狱提出，并借给日本当局。

John Caples

pages.en:
3.1. Misc. 196/41.

O.l. S.M.P.
Dept. 12, 41.

Re the attached letter received from the Japanese Naval Court-
Martial requesting a loan of prisoners under the custody of
S.M. Police.

Sir,

On the 11.9.41, the attached official letter was received
from the Chief Prosecutor Kikuo Yufu of the China Seas Fleet
Naval Court-martial, 80 Hannen Road requesting a loan of two
prisoners who are now under the custody of S.M.P. for a period
of 10 days to enable them to complete enquiries on prisoners
under their custody.

It is explained by the Prosecutor Yufu that the 1st named
prisoner Yong Kung Pao (王根宝) is found to have been connected
with one male Chinese named Dang Yoong Tsung (邓荣春), who was
recently arrested by the Japanese authorities on a charge of
murder of Mr. and Mrs. Takahashi at their residence on Dixwell
Road on the 5.11.40. It was ascertained that the man Yong Kung
Pao alias Dah Wan Ts (大腕子) had been arrested by members of
Kashing Road Station on the 13.1.41 in connection with a burglary
case and is now serving a sentence of 1 year and 3 months at
the Ward Road Gaol.

Regarding the 2nd named prisoner Dau Voong Ji (陶凤岐)
it was revealed that on the 26.8.41 two armed robbers were
arrested in Pootung by the Japanese authorities and one pistol
seized and they made a confession to the effect that the leader
of the gang was one named Dau Voong Ji (陶凤岐), residing at
Room 34 of the Pacific Lodging House on Tientsin Road and that he
had committed several offence of similar nature together with
them prior their arrest.

3.1. Misc. 196/41.

O.l. S.M.P.
Dept. 12, 41.

事由：收到日本海军军事法庭来函，请求借出由工部局警务处羁押的囚犯。

先生：

1941年9月11日，收到中国方面舰队海军军事法庭首席检察官菊雄由布（Kikuo Yufu，音译）从汉密尔顿路80号发来的附呈公函，请求借出两名现由工部局警务处羁押的囚犯，为期10天，以便他们完成对在押囚犯的调查。

检察官由布解释说，第一名囚犯王根宝（Yong Kung Pao，原文如此，应为王拱保或王根宝）被发现与一名叫邓荣春（Dang Yoong Tsung）的中国男子有关联，后者近期被日本当局逮捕，罪名是于1940年11月5日在狄思威路（Dixwell Road）高桥夫妇（Mr. and Mrs. Takahashi）寓所谋杀高桥夫妇。经查实，这名化名“大腕子”（Dah Wan Ts）的王根宝曾于1941年1月13日因一起入室盗窃案被嘉兴路捕房成员逮捕，目前正在提篮桥监狱服刑一年三个月。

关于第二名囚犯陶凤岐（Dau Voong Ji），据透露，1941年8月26日，日本当局在浦东逮捕了两名持械劫匪，缴获手枪一支，他们供认团伙头目名叫陶凤岐（Dau Voong Ji），住在天津路太平洋旅馆34号房间，并在被捕前与他们共同犯下数起类似性质的罪行。

pages.en:
- 2 -

In respect of the above case, an assistance was requested
by Sergeant Sato of the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters
on the 26.8.41 to visit the above described address to
effect the arrest of one named Yau Yoong Ji who was wanted in
connection with an armed robbery committed at Kau Ka Loong
Village, Footun at about 8 a.m. on the 25.8.41. The
desired assistance was rendered by members of C.l. C.B.H. . but
the wanted man was found to have left the room (Vide C.l. Misc.
170/41).

However, the accused further confessed at the Court-martial
that their accomplice had been arrested by members of Central
Police Station in front of the Eastern Hotel on the 25.8.41
on suspicion of being concerned in an armed robbery and are
under the custody of S.M.P. for interrogation.

The undersigned respectfully suggest that the request
made by the Prosecutor Yufu be complied with to enable them
to complete enquiries on the prisoners under their custody.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

就上述案件而言，日本宪兵总部佐藤军曹于1941年8月26日请求协助，前往上述地址逮捕一名叫姚永吉（Yau Yoong Ji，音译）的通缉犯，该人涉嫌参与1941年8月25日上午8时许在复旦（Footun）顾家龙村（Kau Ka Loong Village，音译）发生的一起持械抢劫案。刑事科中央捕房总部（C.l. C.B.H.）成员提供了所需协助，但发现通缉犯已离开该房间（参见 C.l. Misc. 170/41）。

然而，被告在军事法庭上进一步供认，他们的同伙已于1941年8月25日因涉嫌参与持械抢劫，被中央捕房成员在东方饭店门前逮捕，并正由工部局警务处羁押审讯。

卑职谨建议满足检察官由布的请求，以便他们完成对在押囚犯的调查。

C.I. Case.276/41
Headquarters
Crime Branch
23rd December
41.

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie
re alleged Military Materials stored
at 126 Mokanshan Road

At 6 a.m. December 23, 1941, Sergeant Major
Ikeda of Japanese Gendarmerie attended Crime Branch
Headquarters (C.I.) and requested assistance to visit
an address off Mokanshan Road where military materials
were being stored by a Chinese.

Assistance was rendered by D.S. Shimashima, D.I.
Soong Ping Tsung, C.D.S. 40 and C.D.C. 212 and the
undersigned when the combined parties were led to the
You Foong Flour Mill Co. Ltd., 126 Mokanshan Road.

A small godown was visited but this was learned
to have been sealed by the Western Gendarmerie on
December 15th after they had visited and inspected the
premises.

It was also learned that one Tau Yang Woo (陶养吾)
had, a few days prior to the U.S. 4th Marines leaving
Shanghai, purchased from them unwanted furniture, steel
safes etc for which he obtained a receipt. Knowing
some of the management of the You Foong Flour Mill he
was permitted to store the stuff in one of the not-
used godowns.

C.I. Case.276/41
总部
刑事科
1941年12月23日

协助日本宪兵队
关于莫干山路126号涉嫌储存军用物资一事

1941年12月23日上午6时，日本宪兵队池田军曹（Sergeant Major Ikeda）来到刑事科总部（中央捕房），请求协助前往莫干山路附近一处地址，那里有一名中国人正在储存军用物资。

副督察岛岛（Shimashima，音译）、探员宋秉宗（Soong Ping Tsung，音译）、华籍侦探警长40号及华籍侦探警员212号以及卑职提供了协助，联合队伍被带至莫干山路126号友丰面粉有限公司。

视察了一间小仓库，但得知该仓库已于12月15日由西方宪兵队查封，此前他们曾到访并检查过该处所。

还获悉，在美国海军陆战队第四团撤离上海前几天，一名叫陶养吾（Tau Yang Woo）的人从他们那里购买了废弃的家具、钢制保险箱等物品，并取得了收据。由于认识友丰面粉厂的一些管理人员，他被允许将物品存放在一间未使用的仓库中。

pages.en:
1/2

Mr. C.F. Tien, factory manager, explained to
Sergeant Major Ikeda the full facts regarding the pre-
vious visit, on December 15th, of the gendarmerie and
with this Sergeant Major Ikeda was satisfied. The party
then withdrew.

Pootoo Road Station informed of the visit.

D. S. I.

**〔此处转录不清〕**
pages.zh:
1/2

工厂经理田先生（Mr. C.F. Tien，音译）向池田军曹详细解释了12月15日宪兵队此前来访的全部情况，池田军曹对此表示满意。随后队伍撤离。

已通知普陀路捕房此次视察事宜。

D. S. I.
